english:
At the mouth of the Onega, a Pomor settlement stood where the river meets the cold waters of the White Sea. Its people fished the coast and traded along the river, which led inland to Kargopol and Lake Lacha. Salt works on the shore supplied a valuable cargo for that route.

A survey of 1555–1556 records the Ust-Onega churchyard with churches of the Assumption and St Nicholas. Its lands included fishing grounds across the river and saltworks on Kiy Island near the mouth. People from the Onega country carried coastal salt to Kargopol for sale to merchants from Vologda and Beloozero. In 1780 Ust-Onega became the town of Onega, retaining the river name that tied its history to the sea and the northern interior.
simp_chinese:
在奥涅加河口，一座波莫尔聚落坐落于河流与白海交会之处。居民在海岸捕鱼，并沿通往内陆卡尔戈波尔与拉恰湖的河流贸易。岸边盐场为这条水路提供了宝贵货物。

1555—1556年的调查记载了乌斯季奥涅加教堂村及其圣母安息和圣尼古拉教堂。所属土地包括河对岸的渔场，以及河口附近基伊岛上的盐场。奥涅加地区居民将海岸盐运到卡尔戈波尔，卖给沃洛格达和别洛奥泽罗的商人。1780年，乌斯季奥涅加成为奥涅加城，保留的河名将它的历史与大海和北方腹地联系起来。

english: Villaines-la-Juhel lies in the uplands of northern Maine, where a medieval keep stood above the settlement. The town's name recalls Juhel of Mayenne, to whom the land was granted in the twelfth century. During the Hundred Years' War English forces seized the town in 1420 and returned in 1446. In later centuries the countryside supplied flax and hemp for textile production in Mayenne and Alençon, linking this small market centre to the linen manufacture of the wider region.
simp_chinese: 维莱讷—拉瑞埃勒位于曼恩北部高地，中世纪主塔曾高出聚落。镇名让人想起十二世纪获授此地的马耶讷领主瑞埃勒。百年战争期间，英军于1420年占领城镇，1446年再次返回。此后数世纪，周围乡村为马耶讷和阿朗松的纺织业供应亚麻与大麻纤维，使这座小市镇与更广地区的亚麻布生产相连。

english: Villalba stands in the Terra Chá, the broad inland plain of northern Galicia. Its castle marked the authority of the Andrade family, who acquired the lordship in the fourteenth century. The harsh rule of Nuño Freire de Andrade helped provoke an Irmandiño rising in 1431, during which the original castle was destroyed. A later revolt again struck the family's fortifications. In 1486 Diego de Andrade became count of Villalba; through marriage the town subsequently passed into the possessions of the house of Lemos.
simp_chinese: 比利亚尔瓦坐落在加利西亚北部广阔的内陆平原特拉查。城堡象征着安德拉德家族的权威，他们在十四世纪取得了此地的领主权。努尼奥·弗雷雷·德安德拉德的严酷统治促成了1431年的伊尔曼迪尼奥起义，原有城堡在起义中被毁。后来的另一次起义再次打击了家族的堡垒。1486年迭戈·德安德拉德获封比利亚尔瓦伯爵；此后通过婚姻，城镇转入莱莫斯家族的领地。

english:
Villalpando lies in the open agricultural country of Tierra de Campos. Its walls and castle date back to its position near the medieval frontier between León and Castile, overlooking a crossing of the Valderaduey.

By 1466 Villalpando belonged to the Fernández de Velasco, constables of Castile. In that year the town and villages under its jurisdiction made a collective vow in support of the Immaculate Conception. During the Revolt of the Comuneros the castle was burned in 1521; a later fortress served as a residence for the constables.
simp_chinese:
比利亚尔潘多位于坎波斯地区开阔的农田之中。它的城墙和城堡源于中世纪的边境地位：这里邻近莱昂与卡斯蒂利亚的边界，扼守巴尔德拉杜埃河的渡口。

到1466年，比利亚尔潘多已属于担任卡斯蒂利亚统帅的费尔南德斯·德·贝拉斯科家族。这一年，城镇与其辖下村庄共同立誓，支持圣母无原罪始胎的信念。1521年，城堡在公社起义期间被焚毁；后来建起的堡垒成为历任统帅的住所之一。

english: Villandro, known in German as Villanders, stands on a slope above the Eisack valley. Recorded as Filandres in 1070, it gave its name to a family of lords whose influence spread through medieval Tyrol. They served the bishops of Brixen and Trent and held judicial and administrative offices under the counts of Tyrol. Their possessions reached from Sterzing to Bolzano and into neighbouring valleys. One branch received Trostburg Castle and became the ancestors of the Wolkenstein family.
simp_chinese: 维兰德罗的德语名为菲兰德斯，坐落在艾萨克河谷上方的山坡上。1070年的文献将它记作菲兰德雷斯；以此地为名的领主家族后来在中世纪蒂罗尔广有影响。他们为布里克森与特伦托主教效力，并在蒂罗尔伯爵治下担任司法和行政职务，产业从施泰青延伸至博尔扎诺及邻近谷地。家族的一支获得特罗斯特堡，成为沃尔肯施泰因家族的祖先。

english: Villanueva de la Serena began as a settlement of farmers from nearby Medellín. In 1303 Ferdinand IV gave it to the Order of Alcántara for resettlement, and it became known by several names as its administrative ties changed. A privilege granted by the order's master in 1423 freed the town from dependence on Magacela and recorded its present name. The order moved its priory here from Magacela in 1504, and Villanueva became the principal town of the lands of La Serena.
simp_chinese: 比利亚努埃瓦德拉塞雷纳起初是附近麦德林农民建立的聚落。1303年，费尔南多四世将它赐给阿尔坎塔拉骑士团以招募移民；随着行政隶属关系变化，聚落也先后使用过多个名字。1423年骑士团团长颁发特许状，使城镇摆脱对马加塞拉的依附，并记载了现在的名称。1504年，骑士团将修院驻地从马加塞拉迁来，比利亚努埃瓦遂成为拉塞雷纳地区的主要城镇。

english: Villanueva del Fresno lies close to the Portuguese frontier in western Extremadura. Its castle formed part of the chain of strongholds that guarded the border, but proximity to Portugal also exposed the town to invasion. During the Portuguese Restoration War its garrison surrendered to Portuguese forces in 1643. Three years later the fortress and the town were destroyed, leaving a lasting mark on the settlement and its defences.
simp_chinese: 比利亚努埃瓦德尔弗雷斯诺位于埃斯特雷马杜拉西部，紧邻葡萄牙边境。当地城堡是守卫边境的一系列据点之一，但靠近葡萄牙也使城镇容易遭到入侵。葡萄牙王政复辟战争期间，守军于1643年向葡萄牙军队投降。三年后，堡垒与城镇遭到摧毁，这场战事给聚落及其防御工事留下了长久印记。

english: Villapalacios lies in the Sierra de Alcaraz, where it became the centre of the lordship of the Five Towns. The Manrique family, counts of Paredes, governed the district for centuries, linking Villapalacios with neighbouring Bienservida, Villaverde, Cotillas and Riópar. The town's buildings and local records preserve the memory of this noble jurisdiction, which made a small mountain settlement the administrative heart of a wider group of communities.
simp_chinese: 比利亚帕拉西奥斯位于阿尔卡拉斯山地，曾是“五镇领地”的中心。帕雷德斯伯爵曼里克家族统治这一地区数百年，将比利亚帕拉西奥斯与邻近的比恩塞维达、比利亚韦尔德、科蒂利亚斯和里奥帕尔联系起来。城镇建筑与地方文书保存了这段贵族管辖的记忆：一座小小的山间聚落由此成为周边多个社区的行政中心。

english: Villarcayo lies beside the Nela in the Merindades of northern Castile. In 1560 Philip II chose it as the administrative centre of the district, and the general assemblies of the Merindades began meeting there instead of at Miñón. Each merindad sent representatives of both the lesser nobility and the taxpayers. A tower built in 1566 and an archive protected by three separate keys reflected the town's new role in the government and justice of the surrounding country.
simp_chinese: 比利亚尔卡约坐落在卡斯蒂利亚北部梅林达德斯地区的内拉河畔。1560年，费利佩二世选择此地为辖区行政中心，梅林达德斯总会遂从米尼翁迁来开会。每个辖区都派出小贵族和纳税居民的代表。1566年修建的塔楼，以及须用三把不同钥匙开启的档案柜，体现了城镇在周边地区行政和司法中的新地位。

english: Forests surround the volcanic mountains and lakes of the southern Chilean Andes near Villarrica. The snow-covered Villarrica volcano rises above the wooded slopes, while other peaks and glaciers overlook the linked lakes farther south. Rivers thread their way through the valleys between them. This is Mapuche country, where mountain, forest and water form a landscape of closely connected places rather than isolated summits.
simp_chinese: 比亚里卡附近的森林环绕智利南部安第斯山脉的火山和湖泊。积雪覆盖的比亚里卡火山高出林木山坡，其他山峰和冰川俯瞰更南面的相连湖泊。河流穿过群山之间的河谷。这里是马普切人的土地，山地、森林与水域共同构成彼此紧密联系的景观。

english:
Villarica Lake lies in southern Chile's volcanic lake country, where water, woodland, and mountain slopes support diverse indigenous resources. Fishing complements cultivation and the use of forests, while the lake offers routes between shore communities. Heavy rain and seasonal weather affect movement, and nearby volcanic terrain gives the wider landscape both fertile ground and potential danger. Safe landing places and known paths connect water travel with inland activity.

The lake lay within Mapuche territory. In 1552 Spanish forces founded Villarrica on its western shore, seeking to establish control and exploit regional resources. Mapuche resistance and warfare culminated in the abandonment of the Spanish town in 1602, after which the area remained under Mapuche control for a long period. The lakeshore thus formed part of an inhabited political landscape where colonial ambitions encountered sustained Indigenous resistance.
simp_chinese:
比亚里卡湖位于智利南部火山湖区，水域、森林和山坡提供多样原住民资源。捕鱼补充耕作、林地利用，湖面提供沿岸社区之间路线。大雨、季节天气影响移动，附近火山地形既形成肥沃土地，也带来潜在危险。安全登陆点、熟悉小路连接水上旅行与内陆活动，使湖泊成为生产、交通共同组成的生活空间。

湖泊位于马普切人的土地之中。1552年西班牙人在湖西岸建立比亚里卡，意图控制当地并开发区域资源。马普切人的抵抗与战争最终使西班牙城镇于1602年被放弃，此后该地区长期处于马普切人控制之下。湖岸因此是有人生活和组织政治的土地，殖民扩张在这里遭遇持久的原住民抵抗。

english: Villarrobledo grew on the plains of La Mancha and became known for the great clay jars made by its potters. Local families worked clay before the sixteenth century, making household vessels and later large tinajas for the storage and production of wine. The town also asserted its independence from the Marquis of Villena: after its inhabitants supported the Catholic Monarchs in 1475, the monarchs restored the privileges of a town that the marquis had taken away.
simp_chinese: 比利亚罗夫莱多在拉曼恰平原上发展，以陶工制作的大型陶罐闻名。十六世纪之前，当地已有制陶家庭，用泥土制作家用器皿，后来又制造用于酿造和储存葡萄酒的大陶罐。城镇还争取摆脱比列纳侯爵的控制：居民于1475年支持天主教双王后，君主恢复了此前被侯爵剥夺的城镇特权。

english: Villars lies amid the ponds and low hills of the Dombes. The castle of its lords stood on a raised mound, a poype, and was recorded as early as 1030. By marriage the lordship passed to the house of Thoire, whose descendants held lands across this border country. In 1402 Humbert VII disposed of his possessions as the houses of Savoy and Bourbon extended their influence in the region. A road between Lyon and Bourg passed through Villars by the later Middle Ages.
simp_chinese: 维拉尔坐落在东布的池塘与低丘之间。领主城堡建在称为“普瓦普”的土丘上，早在1030年已有记载。通过婚姻，领地转入图瓦尔家族，其后裔在这片边地拥有土地。1402年，安贝尔七世处置其领地，萨伏依与波旁家族也在此扩大影响。中世纪后期，里昂至布尔的道路经过维拉尔。

english: Villatoro lies in a valley west of Ávila, guarded by the remains of a castle belonging to the Dávila family. Alfonso XI established the lordship for Sancho Dávila in the fourteenth century, and the fortress was later adapted to the weapons of a new age. The parish church was rebuilt during the sixteenth century. In 1531 its unfinished chapel hosted a wedding attended by the young Teresa of Ávila, before she became famous for her religious reforms.
simp_chinese: 比利亚托罗位于阿维拉以西的山谷，达维拉家族城堡的遗迹守望着聚落。阿方索十一世于十四世纪为桑乔·达维拉设立领地，堡垒后来经过改建，以适应新时代的武器。教区教堂在十六世纪重建；1531年，尚未完工的礼拜堂举行了一场婚礼，年轻的阿维拉的德肋撒曾到场，那时她尚未因宗教改革而闻名。

english: Villaviciosa lies at the head of an inlet on the Asturian coast. Founded by Alfonso X in 1270 as the Puebla de Maliayo, it received the laws of Benavente, a weekly market and permission to build walls. In 1517 the young Charles of Ghent arrived on this coast to take possession of his Iberian kingdoms. After anchoring near the fishing village of Tazones, he came up the inlet to Villaviciosa, where he stayed before continuing his journey inland.
simp_chinese: 比利亚维西奥萨坐落在阿斯图里亚斯海岸一处海湾的内端。阿方索十世于1270年建立马利亚约新镇，授予贝纳文特法、每周集市及修建城墙的许可。1517年，年轻的根特的查理来到这片海岸，准备接掌他的伊比利亚诸王国。他在渔村塔索内斯附近停泊后，沿海湾来到比利亚维西奥萨，在此停留数日，再继续前往内陆。

english: Villefranche-de-Rouergue is a bastide on the Aveyron, laid out around a market square and its arcades. As an administrative and commercial centre, it drew the people of the surrounding countryside to its streets. In 1643 resentment over taxation helped provoke the revolt of the Croquants. Rebels entered Villefranche in June, but the rising was suppressed; its leaders were captured and punished, while a royal pardon followed in 1644.
simp_chinese: 鲁埃格地区自由城是一座阿韦龙河畔的新城，街道围绕带有拱廊的市场广场规划。作为行政与商业中心，它吸引周围乡村的人们来到城中。1643年，对赋税的不满促成克罗康起义。起义者于六月进入自由城，但叛乱最终被镇压，领袖遭到逮捕和惩处；1644年，国王又颁布赦令。

english: Villemaur-sur-Vanne lies on the River Vanne between Sens and Troyes. Its collegiate church preserves a remarkable work of Champagne sculpture: a carved wooden rood screen, traditionally dated to 1521. The screen separated the nave, where the congregation gathered, from the choir used by the clergy. Fifteen scenes of the Passion face the nave, while eleven scenes from the life of the Virgin look towards the choir. The church itself combines work from the thirteenth and sixteenth centuries.
simp_chinese: 旺讷河畔维勒莫尔位于桑斯与特鲁瓦之间。当地同修教堂保存着一件出色的香槟雕刻作品：传统上断代为1521年的木雕唱经楼。它将信众聚集的中殿与教士使用的唱诗席隔开；朝向中殿的一面刻有十五幅基督受难场景，朝向唱诗席的一面则有十一幅圣母生平场景。教堂本身包含十三世纪和十六世纪的建筑。

english: Villemur stands beside the Tarn north of Toulouse, beneath the site of a feudal castle. During the Wars of Religion it became a Protestant stronghold and endured a prolonged siege by the Catholic League. On 19 October 1592 relief forces attacked the besiegers, who were defeated. Their commander Scipion de Joyeuse drowned in the Tarn while attempting to escape, and the town remained in the hands of its defenders.
simp_chinese: 维尔米尔坐落在图卢兹以北的塔恩河畔，旧时封建城堡曾高踞其上。宗教战争期间，它成为新教据点，经历了天主教同盟的长期围攻。1592年10月19日，援军进攻围城部队并将其击败。指挥官希皮翁·德·茹瓦耶兹逃亡时溺毙于塔恩河，城镇仍由守军掌握。

english: Villena stands beneath the Castle of Atalaya, a stronghold that dominated routes across southeastern Iberia. The town gave its name to a powerful marquisate created in the fourteenth century. In 1476 its inhabitants rose against the marquis and besieged the castle; forces supporting the Catholic Monarchs took the fortress after hard fighting. Its walls recall both seigneurial power and the resistance it provoked.
simp_chinese: 比列纳坐落在阿塔拉亚城堡下方，这座要塞控制着伊比利亚东南部的道路。城镇为14世纪建立的强大侯爵领命名。1476年，居民起兵反对侯爵并围攻城堡；支持天主教双王的军队经过激战夺取要塞。城墙见证着领主权势，也见证了它激起的反抗。

english:
Villingen lies on the Brigach at the edge of the Black Forest and the Baar plateau. The dukes of Zähringen laid out the town on the river's right bank in 1119, with the crossing streets characteristic of their foundations. Villingen later became an imperial city, but lost that status when the counts of Fürstenberg received it as a fief in 1283. Wool weaving was an important occupation, and a guild charter regulated its civic government in 1324.

The town was sold to Austria in 1326 and remained part of the Habsburg lands for nearly five centuries. Plague struck severely in 1349, and the University of Freiburg later took refuge here during several epidemics. Villingen resisted repeated sieges during the Thirty Years' War, including a Swedish attempt to flood the town in 1634. In 1806 it passed to Baden, ending its long association with Further Austria.
simp_chinese:
菲林根位于布里加赫河畔，处在黑森林和巴尔高原的边缘。策林根公爵于1119年在河右岸规划新城，街道相交的布局体现其所建城镇的特色。菲林根后来成为帝国城市，但1283年菲尔斯滕贝格伯爵获得它作为封地，城镇遂失去这一地位。毛织业是重要行业，1324年的行会章程规定了城市的治理方式。

1326年，菲林根被出售给奥地利，此后近五个世纪属于哈布斯堡领地。1349年瘟疫重创城镇，弗赖堡大学后来也多次在疫情期间迁来避难。三十年战争中，菲林根抵御了数次围攻，包括1634年瑞典军试图以水淹城。1806年，它归入巴登，结束了与前奥地利的长期联系。

english:
Villmanstrand, called Lappeenranta in Finnish, stands on a peninsula at the southern edge of Lake Saimaa. Founded in 1649, it grew at a meeting place of inland routes and became an important centre for the tar trade. The heights above the lake offered a natural position for a fortress, and after the Treaty of Nystad in 1721 the town found itself close to Sweden's new frontier with Russia.

Swedish engineers began fortifying the peninsula in the 1720s. In 1741 Russian troops defeated a Swedish army at Lappeenranta, captured the defences and devastated the town. The Treaty of Åbo in 1743 placed it under Russian rule. Late in the century General Alexander Suvorov strengthened the fortress as part of a broader defensive system, adding bastions and outworks and making the town a base for the Russian Saimaa rowing fleet.
simp_chinese:
威尔曼斯特兰德的芬兰语名为拉彭兰塔，坐落在塞马湖南端的半岛上。城镇创建于1649年，位于内陆交通交汇处，成为重要的焦油贸易中心。湖畔高地天然适合设防；1721年《尼斯塔德条约》后，此地靠近瑞典与俄国的新边界。

瑞典工程师于1720年代开始加固半岛。1741年俄军在拉彭兰塔击败瑞典军队，占领防御工事并破坏城镇。1743年《奥布条约》使这里归属俄国。世纪末，亚历山大·苏沃洛夫将军将堡垒纳入更广泛的防御体系，增筑棱堡和外围工事，并使城镇成为俄国塞马划桨舰队的基地。

english:
Vilnius stands where the small Vilnia meets the Neris, under Gediminas Hill, whose wooden castle made it the seat of the Lithuanian grand dukes. Gediminas called it his royal city in a letter of 1323 and invited German merchants, craftsmen and Jews to settle, while the Orthodox and Catholic churches of his Ruthenian and German subjects stood beside the pagan sanctuary of the old Lithuanians. The Teutonic Knights repeatedly raided and burned the town, until Grand Duke Jogaila's baptism in 1386 and the conversion of Lithuania in 1387 brought a cathedral, a bishopric and Magdeburg rights.

In the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries Vilnius became a capital in stone. The city wall was raised in the early 1500s, and the Gate of Dawn with its icon of Our Lady is one of its surviving gates. Grand Duke Sigismund the Old and his Italian queen Bona Sforza brought Renaissance builders, and the Jesuits founded Vilnius University in 1579. The city's council was split evenly between Catholics and Orthodox, and Poles, Ruthenians, Germans, Jews and Tatars lived side by side.

Russian troops took and burned the capital in 1655, and the court moved away; plague and war emptied it again in the early 1700s. Even so, Jewish scholarship made it a learned city, and Baroque churches rose across it. Russia annexed Vilnius in 1795, and in 1812 Napoleon's Grand Army passed through it on the road to Moscow and back.
simp_chinese:
维尔纽斯坐落在小河维尔尼亚与内里斯河交汇处，背靠格迪米纳斯山，山上的木堡使它成为立陶宛大公的驻地。格迪米纳斯在1323年的信中称它为自己的王城，并邀请德意志商人、工匠和犹太人前来定居；信奉东正教的罗斯臣民和德意志人的天主教堂，与古立陶宛人的异教圣所并立。条顿骑士团多次劫掠并焚烧这座城镇，1386年大公约盖拉受洗、次年立陶宛皈依基督教之后，这里有了主教座堂、主教区和马格德堡法权。

15至16世纪，维尔纽斯成为石头筑成的首都。城墙在16世纪初修起，供奉圣母像的黎明之门是留存的城门之一。大公“老”西吉斯蒙特和他的意大利王后博娜·斯福尔扎请来文艺复兴的工匠，耶稣会在1579年创办维尔纽斯大学。市议会由天主教徒和东正教徒各占一半，波兰人、罗斯人、德意志人、犹太人和鞑靼人比邻而居。

1655年俄军攻占并焚烧了这座首都，宫廷随后迁走；18世纪初的瘟疫和战争又使它人口锐减。即便如此，犹太学者的研习仍使它保有学术之城的声望，巴洛克教堂遍布城中。1795年俄国吞并维尔纽斯，1812年拿破仑大军往返莫斯科时都经过这里。

english: Vilshana lies near the meeting of the Vilshanka and Sula, in the wooded river country west of Sumy. Local tradition connects its foundation with Cossacks and gives its name a meaning tied to the love of freedom. In the seventeenth century Vilshana and nearby Nedryhailiv lay on a contested frontier: during the conflicts surrounding Hetman Ivan Vyhovsky, Tatar forces attacked both settlements, and Cossacks and townspeople resisted them.
simp_chinese: 维尔沙纳位于维尔尚卡河与苏拉河汇合处附近，属于苏梅以西林木繁茂的河谷地带。当地传说将村庄的建立与哥萨克联系起来，并把地名解释为珍视自由。十七世纪，维尔沙纳与附近的涅德里海利夫处于争夺中的边疆；在盖特曼伊万·维霍夫斯基时期的冲突中，鞑靼军队袭击了两处聚落，哥萨克和镇民奋起抵抗。

english: Viluco denotes an archaeological tradition of southern Mendoza, associated with the Indigenous peoples of the region around the time of Spanish arrival. Pottery and burial finds distinguish it within the valleys and arid lands east of the Andes. The name connects this country with a history extending from before the conquest into the early colonial period, when Indigenous communities faced new pressures and influences.
simp_chinese: 维卢科指门多萨南部的一种考古文化传统，与西班牙人到来前后这一地区的原住民有关。陶器与墓葬发现使它在安第斯山东侧的山谷和干旱地带中具有鲜明特征。这个名称将此地与从征服前延续到殖民初期的历史联系起来，当时原住民社区面临新的压力与影响。

english:
Bülüü stands on the Vilyuy, the great western tributary of the Lena. The river flows through a broad country of forests and lakes, where Sakha communities lived alongside the waterways of the northern interior. Long winters and a short summer mark the rhythm of life in the valley.

In 1634 Russian Cossacks established a winter quarters on the Vilyuy as a base for collecting yasak, the fur tribute demanded from local peoples. The settlement became an administrative centre for the surrounding country. The authorities later moved downstream to the site of Vilyuysk, and the name Olensk came into use after an administrative transfer from the Olenyok. Its status changed more than once in the early nineteenth century: it lost its town status in 1805 and regained it in 1822.
simp_chinese:
维柳伊城坐落于维柳伊河畔。维柳伊河是勒拿河西侧的一条大支流，流经森林和湖泊广布的辽阔地带。萨哈人的聚落分布在北方内陆的水道沿岸，漫长的冬季与短暂的夏季主宰着河谷的生活节奏。

1634年，俄国哥萨克在维柳伊河畔设立冬营地，作为向当地各族征收毛皮贡赋的据点。聚落逐渐成为周围地区的行政中心；此后行政机构迁往下游，与今日的维柳伊城相联系。奥列尼奥克河口的行政机构迁来后，此地也被称作奥连斯克。十九世纪初，其地位数度变化：1805年失去城市地位，1822年又得以恢复。

english: The Vilyuy crosses the northern Central Siberian Plateau on its long journey to the Lena. Its headwaters lie in a forested country of lakes and tributaries, close to the divide separating waters flowing towards the Yenisei. Larch taiga and patches of tundra cover the uplands, while ice holds the rivers through a long winter. With the spring thaw, meltwater swells the streams that feed the eastward-flowing Vilyuy.
simp_chinese: 维柳伊河穿过中西伯利亚高原北部，长途流向勒拿河。它的源头位于湖泊和支流众多的森林地带，接近流向叶尼塞河水系的分水岭。落叶松泰加林与苔原地段覆盖高地，河流在漫长冬季被冰封住。春季解冻时，融水使注入东流维柳伊河的溪流上涨。

english: The Vilyuychan flows through the wooded country of western Yakutia to join the Vilyuy from the right. Its mouth lies below Khordogoy, almost opposite the entrance of the Agdary. The larger river continues through the great Suntar bend and eastward to the Lena. Lakes, streams and forest fill the surrounding lowlands, where the long winter freezes the water and the summer thaw is brief.
simp_chinese: 维柳伊昌河流经雅库特西部森林地带，从右岸注入维柳伊河。河口位于霍尔多戈伊下游，几乎面对阿格达雷河汇入口。大河继续穿过孙塔尔大弯，向东流入勒拿河。湖泊、溪流与森林遍布周围低地，漫长冬季水面冻结，夏季融冻期短暂。

english: Vindeln lies on the Vindel River, upstream from Umeå. The older village of Degerfors stood above the riverbank, in a poor and sparsely populated district whose inhabitants faced a long journey to church. A chapel parish was approved in 1738, but construction took decades. Around thirty farmers and as many settlers built the small wooden church, which was completed in 1769. Its cross-shaped plan gave the scattered community a place to gather for worship.
simp_chinese: 温德伦位于温德尔河畔，在于默奥的上游。较古老的德格福什村坐落在河岸上方，所在地区贫穷、人口稀少，居民前往教堂路途遥远。1738年，当局批准设立礼拜堂区，但建设拖延了数十年。约三十户农民和同样数量的移民共同建造了这座小木教堂，于1769年完工。十字形教堂为分散居住的社群提供了聚集礼拜的场所。

english: Vingur lies in the sandy Tharparkar country of southeastern Sindh, north of the Great Rann of Kutch. The settlement stands amid dunes and sparse scrub, where pastoral communities depended on wells and seasonal rain. Routes across this frontier connected the desert villages with the salt marsh and the lands of Kutch. Its position belongs to a landscape shaped by long journeys between scattered sources of water.
simp_chinese: 温古尔位于信德东南部塔尔帕卡尔沙地、卡奇大盐沼以北。聚落周围遍布沙丘和稀疏灌丛，牧民社群依靠水井与季节降雨。穿越边区的道路将沙漠村庄与盐沼及卡奇地区相连。这里的景观受往返零散水源之间的漫长旅程塑造。

english: Vinnitsy stands on the Oyat amid the wooded hills south of the Svir, in a district long inhabited by Vepsian communities. A place called Vyunitsy appears among tribute-collecting points in a thirteenth-century addition to Prince Svyatoslav Olgovich’s charter. The Vinnitsy church district later embraced villages scattered across the lakes and forests of the Oyat basin. Its inhabitants belonged to the northern countryside linked to Novgorod through tribute and the administration of its pogosts.
simp_chinese: 温尼齐坐落在斯维里河以南林丘之间的奥亚季河畔，所在地区长期有维普斯人居住。十三世纪对斯维亚托斯拉夫·奥利戈维奇亲王敕书的补记，把名为维尤尼齐的地方列为收贡地点。后来温尼齐教堂辖区涵盖了散布于奥亚季河流域湖泊与森林之间的村落。居民生活在北方乡村，通过贡赋和教堂辖区的管理与诺夫哥罗德相连。

english:
Vinnytsia stands on the Southern Bug in Podolia. A fortress built in the fourteenth century guarded the river settlement against Tatar raids, while the town developed into a centre of trade and administration. Its position made it one of the principal towns of the contested Bratslav region.

Under Lithuanian rule Vinnytsia received Magdeburg rights; in 1566 it became part of Bracław Voivodeship, which passed to the Polish Crown after the Union of Lublin. The voivodeship's courts moved here from Bratslav in 1598. During Bohdan Khmelnytsky's uprising the town became a Cossack stronghold. In 1651 Ivan Bohun's men defended it against a Polish army, and Vinnytsia served as a regimental centre of the Hetmanate. Ottoman occupation followed between 1672 and 1699, before the town returned to Polish rule. In 1783 Antoni Protazy Potocki established the Polish Trade Company here. A decade later, the second partition of Poland placed Vinnytsia under Russian rule.
simp_chinese:
文尼察坐落在波多利亚的南布格河畔。十四世纪修建的要塞保护河畔聚落免受鞑靼袭击，城镇逐渐发展为贸易和行政中心。它所处的位置使其成为屡遭争夺的布拉茨拉夫地区的主要城镇之一。

文尼察在立陶宛统治下获得马格德堡法权，1566年成为布拉茨拉夫省的一部分；卢布林联合后，该省归入波兰王冠。省法院于1598年从布拉茨拉夫迁来。博赫丹·赫梅利尼茨基起义期间，文尼察成为哥萨克据点。1651年，伊万·博胡恩的部队守城击退波兰军，文尼察也成为哥萨克酋长国的团驻地。1672至1699年奥斯曼人占领此地，之后城镇重归波兰。1783年，安东尼·普罗塔齐·波托茨基在此设立波兰贸易公司。十年后，第二次瓜分波兰使文尼察转归俄国统治。

english: Vinukonda stands near a hill whose shape is likened to a tortoise. Temples stand upon its heights, where a fortress guarded the town in medieval times. Dolmens and other megalithic remains in the neighbourhood attest to a much older past, while inscriptions from about the eleventh to fifteenth centuries survive in local temples. The town's Jamia Masjid was built in 1640.
simp_chinese: 维努贡达附近有一座形似龟背的山丘，山顶有数座神庙，中世纪时还有堡垒守护城镇。附近的石棚和其他巨石遗迹见证了更早的历史，当地寺庙中则保存着约十一至十五世纪的铭文。城中的聚礼清真寺建于1640年。

english:
Viranşehir stands on the upper Mesopotamian plain at the site of ancient Tella, later called Constantina and Tell Mawzan. Among its remains is an octagonal Christian martyrion, built in late antiquity to honour a saint and once decorated with mosaics. The town was on a route between Urfa and the eastern cities of the Jazira, and passed through the hands of Roman, Byzantine and Islamic rulers.

Mongol and Timurid attacks devastated the district in the thirteenth and fifteenth centuries. After Mamluk, Aq Qoyunlu and Safavid rule, the Ottomans incorporated it into their empire in the early sixteenth century. The name Viranşehir, meaning ruined city, recalls the destruction and the older remains amid which the later settlement stood. The surviving columns of the martyrion were a visible reminder of Tella's Christian past.
simp_chinese:
维兰谢希尔位于上美索不达米亚平原，坐落在古代泰拉的旧址，后来又称君士坦丁纳和泰勒毛赞。当地遗迹包括一座古代晚期为纪念圣人而建的八角形殉道者纪念堂，原有镶嵌画装饰。城镇处于乌尔法通往杰济拉东部城市的道路上，先后由罗马、拜占庭和伊斯兰政权统治。

十三至十五世纪，蒙古人与帖木儿军队的袭击使这一地区遭到破坏。经历马穆鲁克、白羊和萨法维统治后，奥斯曼人于十六世纪初将其纳入帝国。维兰谢希尔意为“废墟之城”，使人想起后来的聚落周围那些遭毁的古老遗存。殉道者纪念堂残存的石柱，见证着泰拉的基督教历史。

english: Vire stands on the river of the same name in the wooded, pastoral bocage of southern Normandy. In 1123 Henry I, king of England and duke of Normandy, had a fortress built on a rocky height beside the river; additional walls were completed in the early fourteenth century. During the Hundred Years' War, military companies plundered Vire in 1368, and the town came under English occupation from 1418 to 1450. In the later Middle Ages leatherworking and then textiles brought prosperity. Under Louis XIII, Cardinal Richelieu ordered the medieval castle and its defences dismantled, reflecting royal concern about fortified places during internal rebellions.
simp_chinese: 维尔坐落在同名河流旁，周围是诺曼底南部林地与牧场交错的博卡日乡村。1123年，英格兰国王兼诺曼底公爵亨利一世命人在河边岩丘上修建堡垒，外围城墙于十四世纪初完成。百年战争期间，维尔在1368年遭武装军团劫掠，1418年至1450年又处于英军占领之下。中世纪后期，皮革业和随后发展的纺织业带来繁荣。路易十三在位时，黎塞留枢机命令拆除中世纪城堡及其防御设施，反映王权对内乱中设防据点的担忧。

english: The Virgin Passage opens between eastern Puerto Rico and the Virgin Islands, linking the Atlantic approaches with waters leading into the Caribbean. Vieques and Culebra lie among the islands and shoals to its west, while Saint Thomas and its neighbours mark the eastern side. Ships approaching the passage must reckon with the islands and banks that break up the sea between the larger shores.
simp_chinese: 维尔京海峡位于波多黎各东端与维尔京群岛之间，连接大西洋航路和通往加勒比海的水域。别克斯岛与库莱布拉岛位于西侧众多岛屿和浅滩之中，圣托马斯岛及其邻岛则标示着东侧。船只驶近海峡时，须留意散布在两岸之间的岛屿与沙洲。

english:
Virkgarh belongs to the Majha region of the Punjab, where river plains and cultivated land support villages connected by roads and markets. Water and seasonal weather shape farming, while livestock provide resources and transport. Rural production and exchange link these communities with administrative centres and the commercial networks of northwestern India.

Majha formed an important part of the Punjab's political and cultural landscape. Sultanate and Mughal rulers drew on its resources, while families and religious institutions helped organise social life. The development of Sikh traditions and later Sikh political power profoundly affected the wider region. Warfare, migration and changing revenue demands could disrupt village life, even as agriculture remained central to many households.
simp_chinese:
维尔克格尔属于旁遮普的马贾地区，河流平原与耕地养育着由道路和集市相连的村庄。水源与季节变化影响农事，牲畜既提供物产，也承担运输。乡村的生产和交换与行政中心及印度西北的商业网络相联系。

马贾是旁遮普政治和文化的重要地区。苏丹国及莫卧儿统治者汲取当地资源，家族和宗教机构也参与组织社会生活。近代早期，锡克传统的发展以及随后锡克政治力量的兴起，深刻影响了更广阔的旁遮普。战争、迁徙和赋税变化会改变村落生活，而耕作仍是许多家庭的生计基础。

english:
Virovitica lies south of the Drava, at the foot of the Bilogora hills. A medieval market and the seat of a small county, it was long connected with the queens of Hungary, who held its estate. In 1242 King Béla IV issued the Golden Bull of Zagreb here, granting privileges to the town of Gradec after the Mongol invasion.

In the fifteenth century the Marczaly brothers built a fortress around the former royal palace. Ottoman raids threatened Virovitica from the 1530s, and in 1552 the town surrendered to the forces of Ulama, the sanjakbey of Požega. Under Ottoman rule it served as a frontier fortress and an administrative centre. Habsburg forces captured it in 1684, and a town magistracy was established in 1698. The estate passed to the Pejačević family in 1750, during a period of renewed settlement and recovery.
simp_chinese:
维罗维蒂察位于德拉瓦河以南、比洛戈拉山丘脚下。它曾是中世纪的集市和一个小郡的中心，长期与持有此地庄园的匈牙利王后们相联系。1242年，国王贝拉四世在此颁布萨格勒布金玺诏书，在蒙古入侵后给予格拉德茨城镇特权。

十五世纪，马尔察利兄弟围绕旧王宫修建了一座堡垒。自1530年代起，奥斯曼袭击威胁维罗维蒂察；1552年，城镇向波热加桑贾克贝伊乌拉马的军队投降。奥斯曼统治时期，这里成为边防要塞和行政中心。哈布斯堡军队于1684年攻占此地，1698年设立了城镇行政机构。1750年，在重新定居和恢复发展的时期，庄园转入佩亚切维奇家族手中。

english: Virudhunagar, formerly known as Virudupatti, lies south of Madurai in the Tamil plains. It belonged to the country ruled by the Nayaks of Madurai until their dynasty ended in 1736. During the following decades, rival commanders and the nawab of Arcot contested authority in the region. In 1801 the East India Company assumed direct control.
simp_chinese: 维鲁杜讷格尔旧称维鲁杜帕蒂，位于马杜赖以南的泰米尔平原。它曾属于马杜赖纳亚克王朝的领土，直到该王朝于1736年终结。此后数十年，敌对将领与阿尔科特纳瓦卜争夺这一地区的统治权。1801年，东印度公司取得直接控制。

english: Viry lies in the forest country of Polesia, west of the Ubort basin. The region is a low expanse of woods, marshes and rivers draining towards the Pripyat. Its villages stood among forests that supplied timber and other woodland resources, while streams and wetlands gave the landscape its distinctive character. The lands passed from the Grand Duchy of Lithuania into the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth.
simp_chinese: 维雷位于波列西亚的森林地带、乌博尔季河流域以西。这里是低洼的林木、沼泽与河流交织之地，水流最终汇向普里皮亚季河。村庄坐落在提供木材和其他林产的森林之间，溪流与湿地塑造了当地独特的地貌。这片土地曾属于立陶宛大公国，后来归入波兰立陶宛联邦。

english:
Visakhapatnam lies between the Eastern Ghats and the Bay of Bengal, on a coast long visited by merchants and mariners. Ships anchored offshore and took cargo from small boats crossing the surf. A temple inscription of 1068 mentions a merchant of the town, and by the twelfth century it was a fortified trading settlement managed by a guild. Buddhist monasteries and stupas on nearby hills recall an older sacred landscape.

The coast passed among the rulers of Kalinga, Vijayanagara and Jeypore before the Qutb Shahi kings of Golconda appointed governors here. In 1674 Vishwambhar Dev of Jeypore defeated their governor and asserted his sovereignty. European merchants traded through the port in textiles and other goods, and the Northern Circars later came under French and then British influence. In September 1804 British and French squadrons fought a naval battle near the harbour.
simp_chinese:
维沙卡帕特南位于东高止山脉与孟加拉湾之间，商人和水手长期往来于这片海岸。船只停泊在外海，由小船穿过浪涛运送货物。1068年的一则神庙铭文提到当地商人；到十二世纪，这里已是由商人行会管理的设防城镇。附近山丘上的佛教僧院与佛塔，则留下了更早的宗教遗迹。

这片海岸先后归羯陵伽、毗奢耶那伽罗和杰伊普尔统治，后来戈尔康达的库特布沙希诸王在此任命总督。1674年，杰伊普尔的维什万巴尔·德夫击败总督，宣示自己的主权。欧洲商人通过港口买卖纺织品等货物，北方沿海诸地区后来先后受到法国和英国的影响。1804年9月，英国和法国舰队在港湾附近展开海战。

english: The Visayan Sea lies among Panay, Negros, Cebu and Masbate in the central Philippines. Its waters connect with the Samar and Sibuyan seas, and the Tañon Strait leads south between Cebu and Negros. The sea is a rich fishing ground, enclosed by many islands yet linked to neighbouring waters through channels between their shores.
simp_chinese: 维萨亚斯海位于菲律宾中部的班乃、内格罗斯、宿务和马斯巴特诸岛之间。海水与萨马海、锡布延海相通，塔尼翁海峡则在宿务与内格罗斯之间向南延伸。这片海域渔产丰富，虽然被众多岛屿环绕，仍通过岛间水道与邻近海域相连。

english:
Rising behind formidable stone walls on the western coast of Gotland, Visby grew in the 12th and 13th centuries into one of the wealthiest cities of the Baltic, its harbor a meeting place for the fur traders of Novgorod, the cloth merchants of Flanders, and the iron and herring shippers of the German Hansa. The Gotland Farmers' Republic that ruled the island for centuries shared the city with a privileged German merchant quarter, and the parallel rule of the two communities gave the city its peculiar wealth and complexity. Its limestone churches, of which two dozen rose within the walls by 1300, proclaimed a prosperity that made Visby for a generation the most important entrepôt of the Baltic trade.

The two communities parted ways in 1361. When Valdemar IV of Denmark landed on Gotland, the townsmen stayed behind their walls while the island's farmers were cut down outside them, and Visby then opened its gates and had its privileges confirmed. Its trade was already drifting to Lübeck, and pirates soon made the island their base. The Teutonic Order held Gotland from 1398 to 1408, and in 1411 Eric of Pomerania began Visborg Castle at the south end of the town, where in his last years as king and after his fall he lived for more than a decade by raiding Baltic shipping.

In 1525 Lübeck's troops fell on the town at dawn, and the defenders, fleeing to the castle, set fires that burned three churches; with the Reformation nearly all the rest were abandoned. Visby passed to Sweden at the Treaty of Brömsebro in 1645, and when the Danes withdrew after reoccupying it in 1676–79, they blew up Visborg behind them. From the 16th to the 18th century the town stayed so poor that few could afford to pull down its old stone houses, and so medieval Visby survived within its walls.
simp_chinese:
维斯比坐落于哥得兰岛西海岸坚固的石墙之后，在12至13世纪发展成为波罗的海最富庶的城市之一，其港口是诺夫哥罗德的毛皮商、佛兰德的布商以及德意志汉萨同盟的铁器与鲱鱼航运商的汇聚之地。统治该岛数世纪的哥得兰农民共和国与城中拥有特权的德意志商人社区共同治理着这座城市，两种社群的并行统治赋予了该城独特的财富与复杂性。至1300年，已有二十多座石灰岩教堂拔地而起，彰显着使维斯比在一代人的时间里成为波罗的海最重要的贸易中转港的繁荣。

两个社群在1361年分道扬镳。丹麦国王瓦尔德马四世登上哥得兰岛时，市民守在城墙后面，任由岛上的农民在城外被杀，随后维斯比开城投降，换来特权的确认。此时它的贸易已在流向吕贝克，不久海盗又把岛当作据点。条顿骑士团在1398至1408年占据哥得兰；1411年，波美拉尼亚的埃里克在城南动工修建城堡，他在位的最后几年和被废黜之后，在那里住了十多年，靠劫掠波罗的海航运为生。

1525年，吕贝克军队在黎明突袭城镇，守军退往城堡时放火阻敌，烧毁了三座教堂；宗教改革之后，其余教堂也几乎全被弃置。1645年《布伦瑟布鲁条约》使维斯比归入瑞典；丹麦人在1676至1679年短暂重占此地，撤离时炸毁了那座城堡。16至18世纪，城市穷得几乎没人拆得起旧石屋，中世纪的维斯比因此完整地留在了城墙之内。

english:
Višegrad lies on the Drina, where the river emerges from a narrow gorge among the mountains of eastern Bosnia. The great stone bridge across the river bears the name of Mehmed Paša Sokolović, an Ottoman grand vizier born in the surrounding region. Its eleven masonry arches carry a road that linked the Danube lands with Sarajevo and the Adriatic coast.

Taken from his family as a boy under the Ottoman devshirme, Mehmed rose to the highest offices of the empire. As grand vizier he commissioned a bridge in his native region, entrusting its design to the celebrated court architect Sinan. Built between 1571 and 1577, the crossing joined a monumental work of imperial patronage to a road of considerable importance through the Balkans. Inscriptions on the bridge commemorate its patron and construction; repairs to its piers are recorded in 1625.
simp_chinese:
维舍格勒坐落在德里纳河畔，河水从波斯尼亚东部群山中的狭谷流出，在此转弯。跨河的宏伟石桥以奥斯曼大维齐尔穆罕默德帕夏·索科洛维奇命名，他便出生在附近地区。大桥的十一个石拱支撑着道路，将多瑙河流域与萨拉热窝及亚得里亚海沿岸连接起来。

穆罕默德幼时依照奥斯曼的德夫希尔梅制度被带离家人，后来升至帝国的最高官位。他担任大维齐尔时，在家乡捐建这座桥梁，并将设计交给著名宫廷建筑师锡南。大桥建于1571年至1577年，将帝国的宏伟建筑与一条穿越巴尔干的重要道路结合起来。桥上的铭文纪念了捐建者和工程，1625年则有修缮桥墩的记载。

english:
Kladovo lies on the Danube near the Iron Gates, where the river passes through a narrow gorge before reaching broader lowlands. The Danube linked settlements along its banks, while currents and constricted channels made navigation demanding.

In 1524 the Ottoman commander Bali Bey built the smaller fortress of Fetislam on the river near Kladovo, providing a base for campaigns against Hungarian-held territory. A larger outer fortification was added during the Austro-Ottoman conflicts of 1717–1739.
simp_chinese:
克拉多沃位于多瑙河铁门附近，河水穿过狭窄峡谷后进入较宽阔的低地。多瑙河连接两岸聚落，但急流与狭窄水道也使航行颇具挑战。

1524年，奥斯曼将领巴利贝伊在克拉多沃附近的河畔修建费蒂斯拉姆小堡，作为进攻匈牙利控制地区的据点。1717至1739年的奥地利—奥斯曼战争期间，堡外又增建了规模更大的防御工事。

english:
Viseu stands on a plateau in the Beira Alta, where Roman roads once joined Mérida, Lisbon and Galicia. Local tradition ties the area to Viriathus, the Lusitanian chief who held out against Rome. A bishop sat here by the 560s, and in the twelfth century Count Henry and Countess Teresa made Viseu their court and gave it a charter in 1123. Some chronicles name it as the birthplace of their son Afonso Henriques, Portugal's first king. A new charter followed in 1187.

The Gothic cathedral, begun in the Middle Ages, gained a cloister around 1352. During the succession crisis of 1383–85 the city was besieged by Juan I of Castile, and John I of Portugal began the walls that were finished only in 1472. Prince Henry the Navigator became Duke of Viseu in 1415. The painter Vasco Fernandes, called Grão Vasco, was born here in 1475. Around 1501–1506 he and Francisco Henriques worked on an altarpiece for the cathedral; who painted which panels has been debated.
simp_chinese:
维塞乌坐落在上贝拉的高原上，罗马时代的道路曾在此连接梅里达、里斯本和加利西亚。当地传说把这一带同抵抗罗马的卢西塔尼亚首领维里亚托联系起来。6世纪60年代前后这里已有主教驻节；12世纪，亨利伯爵与特蕾莎女伯爵以维塞乌为宫廷所在，并于1123年授予特许状。有些编年史称他们的儿子、葡萄牙首位国王阿方索·恩里克斯生于此地。1187年颁发了新的特许状。

哥特式主教座堂始建于中世纪，约1352年增建回廊。1383至1385年王位继承危机期间，卡斯蒂利亚的胡安一世围攻此城，葡萄牙的若昂一世开始修筑城墙，到1472年才全部完工。航海家亨利王子于1415年受封维塞乌公爵。画家瓦斯科·费尔南德斯，人称格朗·瓦斯科，1475年生于此地，约1501至1506年他与弗朗西斯科·恩里克斯一起为主教座堂绘制祭坛画，各块画板出自谁手一直有争议。

english:
Visnupura belongs to the northern Cham country in the coastal plain of Thuận Hóa, where rivers run from the Annamite foothills across low rice land to the lagoons and sea. Scholarship identifies the Cham town and fortified place called Viṣṇupura, known from inscriptions, with a site near Nhan Biều in what is now Quảng Trị, north of Huế.

The frontier here moved in 1306, when the Cham king Chế Mân gave the prefectures of Ô and Lý to the Trần rulers of Đại Việt in return for marriage with the princess Huyền Trân. They were renamed Thuận and Hóa, and settlers from the north spread south into the Cham villages. After 1558 the Nguyễn lord Nguyễn Hoàng governed Thuận Hóa from bases at Ai Tử, Trà Bát and Dinh Cát, and the Nguyễn lords later moved their seat to Kim Long in 1636 and to Phú Xuân in 1687.

The later city of Đông Hà lies here.
simp_chinese:
毗湿奴补罗属于占婆北部，位于顺化沿海平原上，河流自长山山脉山麓流出，穿过低地稻田，注入潟湖和大海。学术资料认为，碑铭中出现的占婆城镇和城垒毗湿奴补罗，应在今顺化以北广治省的仁表附近。

边界在1306年发生变动：占婆国王制旻把乌、里两州送给大越陈朝，换取与公主玄珍成婚。两州改称顺州和化州，北方移民陆续南下，进入占人的村落。1558年起，阮潢以顺化总镇的身份治理这里，先后以爱子、茶钵、营碣为据点，后来阮氏又在1636年迁到金龙，1687年迁到富春。

后来的东河市即位于此地。

english: Visokoye lies in the lake and bog country near the headwaters of the Polist. The river leaves Lake Polisto and flows northeast through the extensive Polist–Lovat marshes. Farther downstream it passes Staraya Russa before joining the Lovat's delta at Lake Ilmen, carrying water from the Valdai uplands toward the old Novgorod heartland.
simp_chinese: 维索科耶位于波利斯季河源头附近的湖泊与沼泽地带。河流由波利斯托湖流出，向东北穿过广阔的波利斯季—洛瓦季沼泽。更下游，河水经过旧鲁萨，最终在伊尔门湖畔汇入洛瓦季河三角洲，将瓦尔代高地的水流送向诺夫哥罗德旧日腹地。

english: The Vistula Lagoon is a shallow body of water sheltered from the Baltic by a long sandy spit. The Nogat, Elbląg and Pregel rivers bring water to its shores, while a passage near Pillau connects it to the sea. In medieval times channels farther west also gave Elbing access to the Baltic; their closing altered the routes by which its merchants could reach open water. Fishing and navigation remained central to life around the lagoon.
simp_chinese: 维斯图拉潟湖是一片浅水水域，由狭长沙嘴与波罗的海外海隔开。诺加特河、埃尔布隆格河与普雷格尔河流入潟湖，皮劳附近的通道则将它与大海相连。中世纪时，更西面的水道也让埃尔宾能够通往波罗的海；这些水道的淤闭改变了商人抵达外海的路线。捕鱼与航行仍是潟湖周围生活的重要部分。

english: Viswema is an Angami village in the southern Naga hills, among ridges overlooking the routes towards the Manipur valley. Its oral history begins with the founding of Kipizwü by an ancestor named Viswe. The village belongs to a network of Angami communities linked by kinship and marriage: genealogies recorded at Viswema trace ties to neighbouring Momi and Kezama as well as to Khonoma. Terraced fields and wooded slopes form the setting of these hill settlements.
simp_chinese: 维斯韦马是南那加丘陵的一座安加米村落，周围山脊俯瞰通往曼尼普尔河谷的道路。口述历史从一位名叫维斯韦的祖先建立基皮祖讲起。村落属于以亲属和婚姻联系的安加米社群网络；当地记录的家谱显示，维斯韦马与邻近的莫米、凯扎马以及科诺马都有联系。梯田与林坡构成了这些山地聚落的环境。

sources.title: 1921 The Angami Nagas--with some notes on Neighbouring Tribes by Hutton s.pdf

english:
Vitebsk grew at the mouth of the Vitba, where it joins the Western Dvina. Its river harbour lay on routes between the Baltic and Black Sea basins. A chronicle mentions the town in 1021, when Yaroslav of Kyiv ceded it to Bryachislav of Polotsk; by the twelfth century it was the centre of a principality of its own. The town passed into the Grand Duchy of Lithuania in 1320, and stone upper and lower castles and a princely palace guarded its riverbanks.

Vitebsk became the centre of a voivodeship in 1508. Its religious divisions erupted in 1623, when townspeople protesting the imposition of the church union killed the Uniate archbishop Josaphat Kuntsevych. Commonwealth authorities punished the city by executing leading townsmen, withdrawing its Magdeburg rights and destroying the town hall. Catholic monasteries also shaped the city: in 1676 the voivode Jan Chrapowicki founded a Bernardine monastery and church of Saint Anthony. During the Great Northern War, Vitebsk was burned on the orders of Peter I.

In 1772 the first partition of the Commonwealth brought Vitebsk under Russian rule. Four decades later Napoleon occupied the city during his invasion of Russia. In July 1812 he contemplated halting his campaign there and giving his army rest, but the concentration of Russian forces at Smolensk persuaded him to advance again. The old river city thus became a stopping place in a campaign that carried the conflict far beyond the Dvina.
simp_chinese:
维捷布斯克兴起于维季巴河汇入西德维纳河之处，河港位于连接波罗的海与黑海流域的水路上。编年史在1021年提及这座城镇，当时基辅的雅罗斯拉夫将其让给波洛茨克的布里亚奇斯拉夫；到12世纪，它已是一个独立公国的中心。1320年城镇归入立陶宛大公国，石造的上城堡、下城堡和亲王宫邸守卫着河岸。

1508年，维捷布斯克成为一个省的中心。1623年，反对推行教会联合的市民杀死了联合教会大主教约萨法特·昆策维奇，宗教分歧由此爆发。联邦当局处决了市民领袖，撤销城市的马格德堡权利，并拆毁市政厅。天主教修道院也塑造了城市：1676年，总督扬·赫拉波维茨基创建伯尔纳铎会修道院和圣安多尼堂。大北方战争期间，维捷布斯克奉彼得一世之命遭到焚毁。

1772年联邦第一次被瓜分，维捷布斯克归入俄罗斯。四十年后，拿破仑入侵俄罗斯时占领了这座城市。1812年7月，他曾考虑在此停止进军，让军队休整，但俄军在斯摩棱斯克集结促使他再次前进。这座古老河港于是成为一场远远超出德维纳河流域的战争中的驻足之地。

english:
Viterbo is the city of the popes: in the later thirteenth century the papal court lived in its palace for twenty-four years and several pontiffs were elected here, including Gregory X after the townspeople locked up the cardinals in 1268–1271. Its hot springs, the Bullicame, drew the sick. The popes never came to live in the city again, and the exile at Avignon brought decline and new feuds, until the Gatti family and the prefects of Vico imposed lordship over the town despite Cardinal Albornoz's fortress, built in 1354.

Urban V stayed for months in 1367–1370 while trying to take the papacy back to Rome. In 1454 Nicholas V had Bernardo Rossellino build a bathing palace at the Bullicame to cure his illnesses, and Julius II and Leo X were frequent guests in the early sixteenth century, thanks to the Augustinian cardinal Giles of Viterbo; the Albornoz fortress was reworked by Bramante in 1506 for Julius. Sebastiano del Piombo painted the Pietà for the city in 1516–1517, and the cathedral facade was redone in 1570 under Bishop Gambara. A Jewish community lived in Viterbo from the thirteenth century until its expulsion in 1569. In 1798 French troops under Championnet occupied it; the town rose when the Austrian and Neapolitan armies entered Rome, jailed its garrison, and surrendered to General Kellermann after he defeated 6,000 men of Roger de Damas nearby.
simp_chinese:
维泰博是教宗之城：13世纪后期教廷在它的宫殿里住了二十四年，多位教宗在这里选出，其中包括1268至1271年市民把枢机们关起来之后当选的格里高利十世。城里的布利卡梅温泉吸引着病人。教宗再没有回来常驻，阿维尼翁之囚使城市衰落，内斗重起，尽管枢机阿尔沃尔诺斯在1354年建了要塞，加蒂家族和维科的总督们仍在城里建立了领主统治。

1367至1370年，乌尔巴诺五世在试图把教廷迁回罗马期间在此停留数月。1454年，尼古拉五世命贝尔纳多·罗塞利诺在布利卡梅修建浴宫，为自己治病；16世纪初，尤利乌斯二世和利奥十世因奥斯定会枢机维泰博的埃吉迪奥而常来做客，1506年尤利乌斯二世又命布拉曼特改建了阿尔沃尔诺斯要塞。1516至1517年，塞巴斯蒂亚诺·德尔·皮翁博为这座城市绘制了《哀悼基督》，1570年主教堂在主教甘巴拉主持下重修了立面。一个犹太社区从13世纪起在维泰博生活，直到1569年被驱逐。1798年，尚皮奥内率领的法军占领此城；奥地利和那不勒斯军队进入罗马时，城里起义，囚禁了守军，克勒曼将军在附近击败了罗杰·德·达马的6000名流亡军人后，城市向他投降。

english: Vithold Hammami recalls a landmark on the Southern Bug associated by tradition with Vytautas, grand duke of Lithuania. Travellers described a stone bath and bridge in this river country, and attributed the bath to the duke. The lower Bug was a frontier between the Lithuanian, Tatar and Ottoman worlds before the Russian Empire established a shipbuilding settlement at the mouth of the Inhul in 1789. That settlement became Mykolaiv.
simp_chinese: 维特霍尔德·哈马米令人想起南布格河畔一处传统上与立陶宛大公维陶塔斯相联系的地标。旅行者曾记述这片河谷中的石桥和浴室，并将浴室归于大公。下布格河地区曾是立陶宛、鞑靼和奥斯曼势力之间的边疆；1789年，俄国在因胡尔河口建立造船聚落，后来发展为尼古拉耶夫。

english: The western coast of Viti Levu is bordered by reefs and shallow waters, with the Yasawa Islands extending northward beyond it. These coral formations stand against the open sea in marked contrast to the mountainous volcanic interior of Fiji’s largest island. Passages through the reefs connect the shore and its sheltered waters with the routes leading towards the neighbouring islands.
simp_chinese: 维提岛西岸分布着珊瑚礁和浅水区，亚萨瓦群岛从外海向北延伸。这些面向外洋的珊瑚构造，与斐济最大岛屿的火山山地内陆形成鲜明对照。穿过礁石的水道连接海岸及其庇护水域，也通向邻岛之间的航路。

english: The Vitiaz Strait separates New Guinea from New Britain and contains the Siassi Islands. Communities around the strait maintained a maritime exchange network connecting island and mainland shores. Archaeological pottery from Siassi and Sio records the movement of goods through this region.
simp_chinese: 维提亚兹海峡将新几内亚与新不列颠隔开，西亚西群岛位于其间。海峡周围社群维持海上交换网络，连接岛屿与大陆海岸。西亚西和西奥出土的陶器记录了物品在这一地区的流通。

english: Vitim lies on the Lena opposite the mouth of the Vitim River, where a great tributary descending from the mountains joins the northward-flowing river. A settlement was established here in the seventeenth century; local tradition gives the date as 1621, while a later encyclopaedia records its existence by 1661. The meeting of the waterways placed the Vitim settlement on an important route through the forests of eastern Siberia.
simp_chinese: 维季姆位于勒拿河畔，与维季姆河口隔河相望。一条从山地流来的大支流在此汇入向北流淌的勒拿河。这里的聚落建立于十七世纪：地方传统称其始于1621年，较晚的一部百科辞书则记载它在1661年已经存在。水道交汇的位置，使维季姆聚落处于穿越东西伯利亚森林的重要路线之上。

english: The wooded uplands west of the Lena lie between the headwaters of the Lower Tunguska and the tributaries of the Vitim country. They form part of the vast Central Siberian Plateau, where coniferous forest covers hills and river valleys. The Lower Tunguska takes a long course towards the Yenisei, while streams on the other side of the divide reach the Lena. Snow and ice dominate the landscape through the long winter.
simp_chinese: 勒拿河以西的森林高地，位于下通古斯卡河源头与维季姆地区的支流之间。它属于广阔的中西伯利亚高原，针叶林覆盖丘陵与河谷。下通古斯卡河长途流向叶尼塞河，分水岭另一侧的溪流则通向勒拿河。漫长冬季里，冰雪支配着这片土地。

english: Vitoria, or Gasteiz, rises on a hill in the plain of Álava. In 1181 Sancho the Wise of Navarre granted a charter to the older village and named the fortified town Nueva Vitoria. Roads linking the interior of the peninsula to France met here, encouraging trade beyond the walls. The town grew under Castilian rule and received the title of city in 1431. During the Peninsular War, the countryside around Vitoria became a battlefield: on 21 June 1813 Wellington’s allied army defeated French forces near the Zadorra, forcing Joseph Bonaparte to flee towards France.
simp_chinese: 维多利亚又称加斯特伊斯，坐落在阿拉瓦平原的一座山丘上。1181年，纳瓦拉国王智者桑乔授予旧村特许状，并将这座设防城镇命名为新维多利亚。连接半岛内陆与法国的道路在此交汇，促进了城墙内外的贸易。城镇在卡斯蒂利亚统治下发展，并于1431年获得城市称号。半岛战争期间，维多利亚周围的乡野成为战场：1813年6月21日，威灵顿率领的联军在萨多拉河附近击败法军，迫使约瑟夫·波拿巴向法国逃去。

english:
Vitoria Bay lies on the Brazilian Atlantic coast, where islands, channels, and sheltered water offered a valuable harbor behind exposed ocean approaches. Indigenous communities used fisheries, mangroves, and surrounding land long before Portuguese settlement. The bay linked coastal resources with river routes and nearby cultivated ground, making navigation and knowledge of tides important to local life.

Vasco Fernandes Coutinho established the Portuguese captaincy's first settlement at present-day Vila Velha in 1535. Amid conflict with Indigenous peoples, the colonists moved their centre to a nearby island, where the town of Vitória was established in the mid-sixteenth century. The port linked the captaincy to coastal shipping and the Atlantic, while colonization brought conflict and dispossession to the region's Indigenous inhabitants.
simp_chinese:
维多利亚湾位于巴西大西洋海岸，岛屿、水道和避风水面，在暴露外海入口后方形成宝贵港湾。葡萄牙定居以前，原住民已经利用渔场、红树林和周围土地。海湾将沿海资源同河流路线及附近耕地连接，航行和潮汐知识因此影响地方生活。水域既供应食物，也支持人员、物产和消息在不同聚落之间流通。

1535年，瓦斯科·费尔南德斯·库蒂尼奥在今日的旧维拉建立葡萄牙世袭领地的首个聚落。在与原住民的冲突中，殖民者将中心迁至附近岛屿，16世纪中叶建立了维多利亚镇。港口将这一领地与沿海航运及大西洋连接起来，殖民扩张也为当地原住民带来冲突和土地丧失。

english:
Vitré stands on the eastern frontier of Brittany, its castle overlooking the River Vilaine and streets of timber-framed houses. Merchants gathered the hemp cloth woven in the surrounding country and carried it to distant markets, making the fortified town a prosperous centre of trade.

The Reformation found influential supporters in Vitré, where a Protestant college flourished in the later sixteenth century and served the local Reformed community. During the Wars of Religion the town resisted the Catholic League: from March to August 1589 it endured a siege by the Duke of Mercœur's forces until royal troops brought relief. Protestant worship continued here when it had become clandestine in much of Brittany, leaving Vitré an important centre of the Reformed faith as well as commerce.
simp_chinese:
维特雷位于布列塔尼东部边境，城堡俯瞰维莱讷河与木结构房屋林立的街道。商人收集周边乡村织造的麻布，运往远方市场，使这座设防城镇成为繁荣的贸易中心。

宗教改革在维特雷得到有影响力的支持，十六世纪后期，一所新教学院在此兴盛，服务当地改革宗社群。宗教战争中，城镇抵抗天主教同盟：1589年3月至8月，居民忍受默克尔公爵军队围攻，直到王室军队解围。在布列塔尼大部分地区，新教礼拜已转入秘密状态，维特雷却仍可公开举行，使它既是商业中心，也是改革宗信仰的重要据点。

english: Vitry-aux-Loges lies amid the woods of the Orléanais, where a royal castle stood in the Middle Ages. The surrounding forest belonged largely to the king and was divided into districts supervised by foresters; Vitry gave its name to one of these forest guards. The old name of the woodland, the Forest of Loges, survived in the name of the village after it fell from wider use.
simp_chinese: 维特里欧洛日坐落在奥尔良地区的林地中，中世纪时这里曾有一座王室城堡。周围的森林大部分属于国王，分为数个由林务官管理的区段；维特里便为其中一处林区命名。这片林地原称洛日森林，旧名逐渐不再通用，却保留在村庄的名字里。

english:
Vitry-en-Perthois was an old centre of the Perthois in Champagne. Its castle passed to the counts of Champagne in 1077, and the settlement became the seat of a count's castellany, later a prévôté and bailiwick. The fortified town had suburbs, and in 1230 Count Thibaud IV granted its inhabitants a charter of liberties. Crafts and trade, including baking, shoemaking and textiles, were recorded there.

Fire destroyed Vitry in 1143, and imperial troops burned it again in 1544, giving it the name Vitry-le-Brûlé. King Francis I ordered a replacement town at nearby Maucourt; Vitry-le-François was founded there in 1545, while Vitry-en-Perthois remained on its original site. The two settlements thus preserve the memory of a major shift in the area's urban centre.
simp_chinese:
维特里昂佩尔图瓦是香槟地区佩尔图瓦的古老中心。1077年，当地城堡归香槟伯爵所有；聚落成为伯爵城堡辖区的中心，后来也是司法行政区所在地。设防城镇向外延伸出郊区，1230年香槟伯爵蒂博四世授予居民自由特许状。文献记载当地有面包、制鞋、纺织等行业和贸易。

维特里于1143年遭火焚毁，1544年又被皇帝军队烧毁，因此得名“被焚的维特里”。国王弗朗索瓦一世下令在附近莫库尔建立替代城镇，维特里勒弗朗索瓦于1545年建成；维特里昂佩尔图瓦则保留在原址。两个聚落的历史记录了当地城市中心的一次重大转移。

english: The mountains of Vivarais rise between the valleys of the Rhône and the Loire. Volcanic domes and high plateaux give the range its distinctive outline; among them are Mont Mézenc and the steep Gerbier de Jonc, where the Loire begins. Forests cover the slopes below the exposed heights, and streams descend towards opposite river basins. The high country forms a watershed as well as a barrier between the lands on either side.
simp_chinese: 维瓦赖山耸立在罗讷河与卢瓦尔河流域之间。火山穹丘和高原勾勒出山地独特的轮廓，其中包括梅藏峰和陡峭的热尔比耶德琼峰，卢瓦尔河便发源于后者山麓。森林覆盖着裸露高地以下的山坡，溪流分别流向不同流域。这片高地既是分水岭，也是两侧地区之间的屏障。

english:
Vivero, called Viveiro in Galician, lies at the estuary of the Landro on Galicia's northern coast. The town took shape in the twelfth and thirteenth centuries under the lordship of the bishops of Mondoñedo. After a long dispute with the bishops, Alfonso XI granted it royal-town status in 1346, while the bishops retained a levy on goods loaded and unloaded in the port.

In the early modern period, flax growing, linen manufacture and vineyards accompanied maritime trade. The port's commerce reached a high point in the sixteenth century, serving shallow-draught vessels and offering repair facilities. During the Peninsular War French troops occupied the town in 1809, and a local rising briefly challenged them.
simp_chinese:
比韦罗在加利西亚语中称维韦罗，位于加利西亚北岸兰德罗河口。城镇于12至13世纪在蒙多涅多主教的领主权下逐渐形成。居民与主教长期争执后，卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索十一世于1346年使其成为王室直属城镇，主教仍保留对港口装卸货物征收的费用。

近代早期，当地种植亚麻、制造亚麻布并经营葡萄园，海上贸易也十分活跃。港口商业在16世纪达到兴盛，接待吃水较浅的船只并设有修船设施。半岛战争中，法国军队于1809年占领城镇，当地起义曾短暂反抗。

english: Viviers rises above the Rhône, its cathedral of Saint Vincent crowning a rocky height. The bishops of Viviers governed a city whose merchants traded along the river; the town joined the kingdom of France in 1307. During the Wars of Religion Noël Albert, a wealthy salt merchant who had embraced Protestantism, seized control of Viviers. His troops damaged the cathedral, and many houses of its canons were destroyed in 1567.
simp_chinese: 维维耶高踞罗讷河之上，圣文森特主教座堂坐落在岩石高地顶端。维维耶主教统治着这座城市，商人沿河开展贸易；1307年，城镇归入法国王国。宗教战争期间，皈依新教的富裕盐商诺埃尔·阿尔贝控制了维维耶。他的部队破坏主教座堂，1567年许多教士住宅也被毁去。

english: Viwa lies among the Yasawa Islands west of Fiji’s main island, Viti Levu. Coral reefs and channels divide the island from its neighbours, whose inhabitants used canoes to travel between them. William Bligh passed through Fiji in 1789 and returned to chart its islands in 1792.
simp_chinese: 维瓦位于斐济主岛维提岛以西的亚萨瓦群岛。珊瑚礁和水道将它与邻岛隔开，居民乘独木舟往来其间。威廉·布莱于1789年穿越斐济，1792年返回绘制群岛海图。

english:
Vize lies in eastern Thrace, between the approaches to Constantinople and the Balkan interior. Its fortifications and religious buildings preserve traces of the town's Byzantine past, while surrounding fields and woodland supported rural communities.

During the later medieval centuries, Thrace was contested as Ottoman power expanded and Byzantine authority receded. Within Vize's walls stands a Byzantine church later converted into a mosque under Ottoman rule, now known as the Gazi Süleyman Paşa Mosque or Little Hagia Sophia. Its changing use preserves a tangible connection between the town's Byzantine and Ottoman periods.
simp_chinese:
维泽位于东色雷斯，处在君士坦丁堡入口与巴尔干内陆之间。城防和宗教建筑保存着城镇拜占庭时期的痕迹，周围田地与林地则支持乡村社群。

中世纪后期，奥斯曼势力扩张，拜占庭权威衰退，色雷斯成为双方争夺之地。维泽城墙内有一座拜占庭教堂，后来在奥斯曼统治时期改为清真寺，现称加齐苏莱曼帕夏清真寺或小圣索菲亚。建筑用途的变化留下了连接城镇拜占庭和奥斯曼时期的实物痕迹。

english: The Vizhas crosses the tundra south of the Chosha Gulf and empties into that inlet of the Barents Sea. Its waters support salmon and whitefish among other northern fish, while wetlands border the shallow coast. To the west, Pomor sailors used the Chosha portage between the Chizha and Chosha rivers in the sixteenth to eighteenth centuries, avoiding a long voyage around the exposed Kanin Peninsula.
simp_chinese: 维扎斯河穿过乔沙湾以南的苔原，注入这处巴伦支海海湾。河中有鲑鱼、白鲑等北方鱼类，浅海岸边则分布着湿地。在更西方，波莫尔水手于十六至十八世纪使用奇扎河与乔沙河之间的陆上转运道，避免绕行暴露于风浪中的卡宁半岛。

english:
Vizianagaram lies in northern Andhra, between the Eastern Ghats and the coast of the Bay of Bengal. Raja Vijayaram Raj of the Pusapati dynasty established it as the capital of his estate. In the eighteenth century its rulers played a prominent part in the politics of the Northern Circars, where neighbouring houses competed for power and European commanders sought influence.

In 1757 Vijayaramaraju joined the French commander Marquis de Bussy against the ruler of Bobbili. Their forces attacked Bobbili's fort on 24 January and destroyed it after fierce resistance. Tandra Paparayudu, whose family had perished in the fighting, entered Vijayaramaraju's camp and killed him in revenge. The fall of Bobbili and the death of its rival became a celebrated story in the region.
simp_chinese:
维济亚讷格勒姆位于安得拉北部，坐落在东高止山脉与孟加拉湾之间。普萨帕蒂王朝的维贾亚拉姆·拉杰王公以此为其领地的首府。十八世纪，当地统治者在北方沿海诸地区的政治中举足轻重；邻近家族争夺权力，欧洲将领也寻求扩大影响。

1757年，维贾亚拉姆·拉朱与法国指挥官比西侯爵联手，对抗博比利统治者。1月24日，两军进攻博比利堡，在激烈抵抗后将其摧毁。家人在战斗中丧生的坦德拉·帕帕拉尤杜潜入维贾亚拉姆·拉朱的营地，将他杀死以报仇。博比利的陷落和其对手的死亡，成为当地广为流传的故事。

english: Vizinga was recorded in 1585 as a pogost with two wooden churches and three households of church servants. One church was dedicated to Saint Athanasius of Alexandria and the other to Saint George. A proposed explanation of its Komi name is “place of metal.” In the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries iron ore was mined near Vizinga for the Nyuvchim foundry, linking the settlement's forested surroundings to the iron industry of the Sysola region.
simp_chinese: 维津加于1585年被记为一处波戈斯特，有两座木教堂和三户教会人员。一座教堂献给亚历山大的圣阿塔纳西，另一座献给圣乔治。对其科米语地名的一种解释是“有金属的地方”。十八至十九世纪，人们在维津加附近开采铁矿，供应纽夫奇姆铸铁厂，将聚落周围的林地与瑟索拉地区的铁业联系起来。

english: Viziru lies on the open plain southwest of Brăila, near the lower Danube. Local accounts place its foundation in the fifteenth century and associate its early inhabitants with families from Moldavia. During the Ottoman period the village lay in the country supplying the fortress of Brăila. An eighteenth-century account describes large flocks of sheep and obligations to provide hay and wood for the garrison's animals. The village's history reflects the close connection between pastoral life on the plain and the demands of the fortified river port.
simp_chinese: 维济鲁位于布勒伊拉西南方的开阔平原，靠近多瑙河下游。地方记载将它的建立追溯到十五世纪，并称早期居民来自摩尔达维亚的家庭。奥斯曼时期，村庄处在为布勒伊拉要塞提供物资的地区。十八世纪的记载描述了大群羊只，以及居民为驻军牲畜提供干草和木柴的义务。村庄历史体现了平原牧业与设防河港需求之间的紧密联系。

english:
Vizovice lies on the Lutoninka stream in the hills of eastern Moravia. It is first mentioned in 1261, when it belonged to the newly founded Smilheim monastery. The monastery and village were damaged during the Hussite Wars, and the Cistercian house was abolished in 1485.

In 1567 Zdeněk Kavka of Říčany bought the estate and built a Renaissance residence on the former monastery site. Emperor Maximilian II granted Vizovice town status in 1570, encouraging the development of crafts. A distillery is recorded in 1585, while the Baroque castle was built between 1749 and 1770 under Count Hermann Hannibal of Blümegen.
simp_chinese:
维佐维采位于摩拉维亚东部丘陵的卢托宁卡溪畔。1261年的最早文献记载称它属于新建的斯米尔海姆修道院。胡斯战争期间，修道院和村庄遭到破坏；熙笃会修院于1485年撤销。

1567年，兹德涅克·卡夫卡购得庄园，在旧修道院址建造文艺复兴式宅邸。皇帝马克西米利安二世于1570年授予维佐维采城镇地位，手工业随之发展。1585年已有蒸馏作坊的记载；1749至1770年，布吕梅根伯爵赫尔曼·汉尼巴尔主持修建巴洛克式城堡。

english:
Vladimir stands on the high bank of the Klyazma. Under Andrei Bogolyubsky it became the capital of north-eastern Rus', and its white-stone Dormition Cathedral, built in 1158–60 and enlarged after a fire in 1185–89, and the Golden Gate of 1158–64 dominate its skyline. In 1337 the title of Grand Prince of Vladimir was a prize that the khans of the Horde handed out, contested by Tver, Suzdal and Moscow. Metropolitan Peter moved his residence to Moscow in the 1320s, and Dmitry Donskoy won hereditary rights to the city in 1362–63, binding it to the Moscow princes for good.

Tokhtamysh's army ravaged Vladimir in 1382, and a Horde governor's estate stood in the city during the 14th century. When Tamerlane threatened in 1395 the Vladimir icon of the Mother of God was carried to Moscow and was never returned. In 1408 the painter Andrei Rublev decorated the Dormition Cathedral anew. In 1724 Peter I had the relics of Alexander Nevsky taken from Vladimir to St Petersburg, and in 1778 it became the seat of a governorate.
simp_chinese:
弗拉基米尔坐落在克利亚济马河的高岸上。安德烈·博戈柳布斯基使它成为罗斯东北部的都城，1158至1160年建造、1185至1189年火灾后扩建的白石圣母安息大教堂，以及1158至1164年的金门，主宰着它的天际线。1337年，弗拉基米尔大公的头衔由金帐汗国的汗王赐予，特维尔、苏兹达尔与莫斯科争夺不已。都主教彼得在1320年代把驻地迁到莫斯科，德米特里·顿斯科伊则在1362至1363年取得对这座城市的世袭权，使它永久归入莫斯科诸公之手。

1382年，脱脱迷失的军队蹂躏了弗拉基米尔，14世纪时城中设有汗国总督的宅院。1395年帖木儿逼近时，弗拉基米尔圣母像被送往莫斯科，此后再未归还。1408年，画家安德烈·鲁勃廖夫重新装饰了圣母安息大教堂。1724年，彼得一世下令把亚历山大·涅夫斯基的遗骨从弗拉基米尔迁往圣彼得堡；1778年，弗拉基米尔成为一个总督辖区的治所。

english: Vlasovo appears in the Vladimir district survey of 1637–1648 as Vlasovskaya, a village belonging to the Moscow nobleman Nikita Kaftyrev. By 1678 it had passed to Prince Mikhail Golitsyn, whose family also held neighbouring villages. A census of 1705 counted twelve households in Vlasovskaya under his heir. In 1776 Prince Pyotr Golitsyn built a wooden church of the Intercession on the estate, giving the village its own parish church amid the forests of the Meshchera country.
simp_chinese: 弗拉索沃在1637年至1648年的弗拉基米尔县土地清册中名为弗拉索夫斯卡亚，属于莫斯科贵族尼基塔·卡夫特列夫。到1678年，村庄已转归米哈伊尔·戈利岑亲王，其家族还拥有邻近村落。1705年的人口清册在他继承人的弗拉索夫斯卡亚村记载了十二户人家。1776年，彼得·戈利岑亲王在庄园建起一座木造圣母帡幪教堂，使梅肖拉林地中的村庄拥有了自己的教区教堂。

english: Vlitsy was a pogost in the countryside north of Velikiye Luki. A chronicle mentions it in 1488, and a wooden church had already been built there in the fifteenth century. At the end of the eighteenth century the old church was replaced by a stone Church of the Transfiguration. The parish continued to serve the surrounding villages, and its church appears in the surviving records of the Velikiye Luki district in 1828.
simp_chinese: 弗利齐是大卢基以北乡间的一处波戈斯特。编年史在1488年提到这里，十五世纪当地已建有一座木教堂。十八世纪末，年久失修的旧教堂被一座石造主显圣容教堂取代。教区继续服务周围村庄，大卢基县1828年保存下来的教会记录中也列有这座教堂。

english: Võ Nhai lies among limestone hills east of Thái Nguyên, on the way towards Lạng Sơn. Its mountains contain deep caves and springs, including Phượng Hoàng cave above the waters of Mỏ Gà. Stalactites fill the spacious chambers, while forested ridges rise around the valleys. The rugged country forms a transition between the lower Cầu River basin and the northern frontier hills.
simp_chinese: 武崖位于太原以东的石灰岩丘陵之间，通往谅山的道路经过这一地区。山中有深洞与泉水，其中凤凰洞俯瞰着磨鸡溪。宽阔洞室内钟乳石形态各异，谷地周围则是森林覆盖的山岭。这片崎岖土地连接梂河下游流域与北方边疆丘陵。

english: Vodable lies beneath the volcanic heights of the Puy d'Ysson in Auvergne. Its castle was the principal residence of the Dauphins of Auvergne in the thirteenth century. Among them was Robert, a knight and poet who wrote of his quarrels with Philip Augustus of France and Richard the Lionheart of England. The dauphins abandoned the castle in 1380; it later became a refuge for brigands and was destroyed on Richelieu's orders in 1633.
simp_chinese: 沃达布勒坐落在奥弗涅伊松火山高地下方。十三世纪，当地城堡是奥弗涅多芬的主要住所。多芬罗贝尔既是骑士也是诗人，曾在诗句中记述自己与法国国王腓力·奥古斯都及英格兰狮心王理查的争执。多芬们于1380年放弃城堡；它后来成为盗匪藏身之处，并于1633年奉黎塞留之命被毁。

english:
The Vodlozero country lies east of Lake Onega, around an island-studded lake surrounded by forest and marsh. Villages stood on its shores and islands, and the lake's waters fed the Vodla, which flows westward to Onega. The waterways also formed part of an old route toward the Onega River and the White Sea.

A survey of 1563 recorded villages and abandoned clearings in the Vodlozero parish district. The churchyard was a centre for communities scattered across the lake. In the seventeenth century the region also sheltered religious dissenters: hermitages opposed to Patriarch Nikon's reforms appeared around Vodlozero and in neighbouring districts. Their presence added another chapter to the religious life of a region whose wooden churches and chapels served settlements separated by water and forest.
simp_chinese:
沃德洛泽罗地区位于奥涅加湖以东，中心是一座岛屿众多、为森林和沼泽所环绕的湖泊。村庄坐落在湖岸和岛上；湖水流入沃德拉河，再向西抵达奥涅加湖。这些水道也是通往奥涅加河及白海的古老路线的一部分。

1563年的调查记载了沃德洛泽罗教区内有人居住的村庄及废弃开垦地。教堂所在地是湖区各社群的中心。17世纪，此地还成为宗教异见者的避难处：反对尼康牧首改革的隐修院出现在沃德洛泽罗和邻近地区。湖区的木教堂和礼拜堂服务于被水面与森林分隔的村落，异见者的到来为当地宗教生活增添了一段历史。

english: The Bird’s Head Peninsula forms the northwestern end of New Guinea. Its forested interior includes mountains and river valleys, between the Pacific coast and the great inlet of Bintuni Bay. Numerous Papuan and Austronesian languages are spoken across the peninsula; neighbouring communities occupy different valleys, coasts and islands.
simp_chinese: 鸟头半岛构成新几内亚西北端。森林内陆包括山地与河谷，位于太平洋海岸和深邃的宾图尼湾之间。半岛上分布着众多巴布亚语言与南岛语言，邻近社群居住在不同的河谷、海岸和岛屿。

english:
Voghera lies in the Po valley south of the river, near routes linking Lombardy with the Ligurian approaches and the hills of the Oltrepò. Fertile land supports grain, vines, livestock, and market exchange. The town gathers rural products and provides craft and administrative services, while roads draw travelers and merchants through the district. Its location between plains and uplands gives it access to resources from more than one environment.

Voghera came under Visconti rule in 1358, and its walls, moat and castle were strengthened in the following years. It remained part of the Duchy of Milan under the Sforza and Spanish rulers. In 1743 the Treaty of Worms brought the town into the Savoyard kingdom, and in 1748 it became the seat of a province covering part of the Oltrepò.
simp_chinese:
沃盖拉位于波河南侧平原，靠近连接伦巴第、利古里亚方向及奥尔特雷波丘陵的路线。肥沃土地支持谷物、葡萄、牲畜与市场交换。城镇汇集乡村产品，提供工艺及行政服务，道路则吸引旅人商人穿过辖区。平原与高地之间的位置，让这里取得不止一种环境的资源，地方生活与周围农业紧密结合。

沃盖拉于1358年转入维斯孔蒂家族统治，随后修筑城墙、壕沟和城堡。斯福尔扎及西班牙统治时期，它仍属于米兰公国。1743年《沃尔姆斯条约》使城镇归入萨伏依王国，1748年它成为辖有部分奥尔特雷波地区的省治。

english:
Vognema lies on the left bank of the Sheksna at the southern edge of the Beloozero lake country. Its name probably comes from a Finno-Ugric word for a headland. By the fifteenth century Vognema was both a village and a volost. A charter of Grand Prince Ivan Vasilyevich to Beloozero names its elders and peasants with nearby communities, showing that the settlement had a recognised place in the collection of dues and local administration.

The Sheksna connected these forest parishes with Novgorod, Beloozero and the upper Volga. Grain, timber, furs, boats and fish moved along the river, while roads and portages reached inland. A sixteenth-century survey called Vognema a fishing-weir volost and counted twenty-five villages and thirteen waste settlements. Catches from the river supplied the grand-princely court, and its weirs became the basis of property and obligation.

Vognema belonged to the working landscape of Muscovite Belozerye, where village communities, monasteries and officials competed for fish, woodland and labour. Its identity rests less on a famous event than on the river economy that made a modest northern village the centre of a parish and supply network.
simp_chinese:
沃格涅马位于舍克斯纳河左岸，处在白湖地区南缘，地名很可能源于芬兰-乌戈尔语中表示“岬角”的词。到十五世纪，沃格涅马已经是村庄和乡。大公伊凡·瓦西里耶维奇发给白湖的诏书将该地长老与农民同邻近社群并列，说明它在贡赋征收和地方行政中已有明确位置。

舍克斯纳河把这些森林乡社同诺夫哥罗德、白湖及伏尔加上游相连。粮食、木材、毛皮、舟船和鱼类沿河流通，道路与陆上转运线则通往内陆村落。十六世纪土地清查把沃格涅马列为以鱼梁捕捞为特色的乡，其范围内有二十五座村庄和十三处废弃地。河中的渔获供应大公宫廷，鱼梁也成为财产与劳役义务的重要形式。

沃格涅马因此属于莫斯科治下白湖地区的生产景观。村庄社群、修道院和官员围绕鱼类、林地与劳动力相互竞争。它的身份依靠的是河运经济，一座不大的北方村庄由此成为更大乡区与供应网络的核心。

english:
Vohemar, also known as Iharana, lies on Madagascar's northeastern coast. Its sheltered harbour and coastal settlements connected the island to the trading world of the Indian Ocean. Nearby graves preserve evidence of a community known as the Rasikajy, whose burial practices show Islamic influence and whose goods came from both Madagascar and distant shores.

Archaeologists have identified a substantial ancient port settlement dating to the fourteenth century and a cemetery used over many successive centuries. Graves contained Chinese ceramics, glass beads, gold and silver ornaments, and locally made stone vessels. These objects reveal the breadth of Vohemar's connections with eastern Africa, southern Asia and the wider ocean, as well as the wealth and craft traditions of the people buried there.
simp_chinese:
武海马尔又称伊哈拉纳，位于马达加斯加东北岸。受遮蔽的港湾和沿海聚落将岛屿同印度洋贸易世界联系起来。附近墓葬保存着拉西卡吉社群的遗迹：其葬俗显示伊斯兰影响，随葬物既来自马达加斯加，也来自遥远海岸。

考古学家辨认出一处十四世纪的大型港口聚落，以及使用了数百年的墓地。墓中有中国陶瓷、玻璃珠、金银饰物和本地制造的石器。这些物件显示武海马尔同东非、南亚及更广阔海洋世界的联系，也展现了墓主人拥有的财富与地方手工传统。

english:
Vohimasina lies in the highland country south of Antsirabe, associated with the Mananadona valley. Archaeological remains here preserve evidence of settlements on high ground overlooking the marshy valley, protected by surrounding ditches. Pottery decorated with intricate triangular impressions has been dated to the sixteenth century. These traces show communities established in the southern highlands during the centuries in which the Merina kingdoms were developing farther north.

The later city of Antsirabe lies here.
simp_chinese:
武希马西纳位于安齐拉贝以南的高地，与马南纳多纳河谷相联系。这里的考古遗迹保存了高地聚落的痕迹：村落俯瞰沼泽河谷，周围以沟壕防护。饰有复杂三角形压印的陶器被断代至十六世纪。这些遗迹显示，在更北方梅里纳诸王国发展之际，南部高地已有社群在此定居。

后来的安齐拉贝即位于此地。

english:
Vohipeno lies in the Matitanana River country of southeastern Madagascar, a centre of the Antemoro people. Here families of religious specialists preserved sorabe manuscripts, written in a form of Arabic script adapted to the Malagasy language. These texts recorded genealogies, ritual knowledge and accounts of origins, giving their custodians influence beyond the southeastern coast. The knowledge was transmitted within learned families as well as used in the service of rulers.

Antemoro scholars carried their learning to the courts of other Malagasy rulers. At the beginning of the nineteenth century, Andriamahazonoro and Ratsilikaina taught at the court of Andrianampoinimerina in Imerina. Sorabe learning thus travelled from the river valleys of the southeast to the central highlands, where it became part of the knowledge available to a rising kingdom.

The later city of Manakara lies here.
simp_chinese:
武希佩努位于马达加斯加东南部的马蒂塔纳纳河流域，是安泰莫罗人的一个中心。这里的宗教专家家族保存着索拉贝手稿；这种文字将阿拉伯字母改用于书写马达加斯加语。手稿记录谱系、仪式知识和起源故事，使其保管者在东南海岸以外也具有影响。这些知识既在学者家族内部传承，也用于为统治者服务。

安泰莫罗学者将他们的学问带往岛上其他统治者的宫廷。十九世纪初，安德里亚马哈祖努鲁和拉奇利卡伊纳在伊梅里纳的安德里亚南波伊尼梅里纳宫廷任教。索拉贝知识由此从东南河谷传入中央高地，成为这个正在兴起的王国所能运用的学问之一。

后来的马纳卡拉即位于此地。

english: The Voikar descends from the eastern side of the Polar Urals to the lower Ob. Near its mouth it spreads into the broad floodplain lake called Voykarsky Sor before joining the Malaya Ob. A settlement called Voikar stood on the river and was mentioned in seventeenth-century geographical descriptions. The river links mountain valleys and forested foothills with the fishing waters of the great Siberian plain.
simp_chinese: 沃伊卡尔河从极地乌拉尔山东侧流向鄂毕河下游。靠近河口时，河水展开为宽阔的沃伊卡尔索尔泛滥湖，然后汇入马拉亚鄂毕。河上曾有一座名为沃伊卡尔的聚落，十七世纪的地理文献已有记载。这条河将山谷、森林山麓与西伯利亚大平原的捕鱼水域连接起来。

english: Voitsberg grew beneath a castle above a narrow stretch of the Kainach in western Styria. In 1164 the Styrian ruler Ottokar IV ordered the castle built to watch the road between Graz and Judenburg, on land belonging to Saint Lambrecht Abbey. The settlement below had a market by 1196 and was described as a town in 1220. Jews are recorded in Voitsberg from 1358; they were forced to leave in 1497 under the order expelling Styria's Jewish communities.
simp_chinese: 福伊茨贝格在施蒂里亚西部卡伊纳赫河狭谷上方的城堡下发展起来。1164年，施蒂里亚统治者奥托卡尔四世下令在圣兰布雷希特修道院的土地上修筑城堡，以监视格拉茨与尤登堡之间的道路。1196年，城堡下方的聚落已有集市，1220年文献称其为城市。1358年起，文献记载当地有犹太人；1497年，施蒂里亚驱逐犹太人的命令迫使他们离开。

english: Vokeo lies off northern New Guinea among the Schouten Islands, where the Pacific meets a coast of river mouths and islands. Its inhabitants belonged to a maritime world already established when Willem Schouten and Jacob Le Maire sailed along the northern coast in 1616.
simp_chinese: 沃凯奥位于新几内亚北部肖滕群岛，太平洋在这里接近河口与岛屿组成的海岸。1616年威廉·斯豪滕和雅各布·勒梅尔沿北岸航行时，当地居民早已属于一个形成已久的海洋世界。

english: Vokhma takes its name from a river in the forested country of the upper Vetluga. The settlement developed as Voznesenye, at a meeting of old overland trading routes, and was named for a Church of the Ascension built in 1740. Merchants and peasants came to its fairs from towns including Nikolsk, Totma, Veliky Ustyug and Vyatka. In the later eighteenth century a landing near the Nikolsky pogost helped connect the district's trade with Kazan and the Vyatka.
simp_chinese: 沃赫马因韦特卢加河上游林地中的河流得名。聚落在古老陆路贸易路线交汇处发展，称为沃兹涅先尼耶，得名于1740年建成的升天教堂。尼科利斯克、托季马、大乌斯秋格和维亚特卡等城镇的商人与农民前来参加集市。十八世纪后半叶，尼科利斯基波戈斯特附近的码头帮助当地贸易与喀山及维亚特卡相连。

english:
Vokhna lies where the river of that name approaches the Klyazma, east of Moscow. The district is named in the will of Grand Prince Ivan Kalita, dated to 1339, among his hereditary possessions. Its forests and streams supported beaver hunting, an occupation associated with the grand prince’s people in the Vokhna lands.

The estate passed between members of the princely family. In his will of 1504 Ivan III left Vokhna to his son Andrey of Staritsa, and it later came to Andrey’s son Vladimir. By the late sixteenth century it belonged to the Trinity-St Sergius monastery. Sources of the sixteenth to eighteenth centuries also call the village Pavlovo, while the older name Vokhna continued to be used for the locality and its river.
simp_chinese:
沃赫纳位于莫斯科以东、同名河接近克利亚济马河的地方。约1339年大公伊凡·卡利塔的遗嘱将这一地区列入他的世袭领地。森林与溪流适于捕猎河狸，沃赫纳土地上为大公服务的人便从事这一营生。

领地在宗室成员之间转手。伊凡三世在1504年的遗嘱中将沃赫纳留给儿子斯塔里察的安德烈，后来又传给安德烈的儿子弗拉基米尔。到十六世纪末，它属于圣三一—谢尔盖修道院。十六至十八世纪的文献也称村庄为帕夫洛沃，而沃赫纳这个旧名仍用于当地及其河流。

english: Volchikha lies on the Kulunda steppe at the edge of the long Kasmalinsky pine forest. The river of the same name joins the Kasmala, which gives the forest its name. The village was founded in 1782, amid a landscape where open grassland, sandy soils and narrow belts of woodland alternate across the western Altai plain.
simp_chinese: 沃尔奇哈位于库伦达草原与狭长的卡斯马林松林交界处。同名河流汇入卡斯马拉河，森林也由后者得名。村庄创建于1782年，周围是阿尔泰西部平原开阔草地、沙土和狭长林带交替的景观。

english:
Volgsjö stands near the lake of the same name in the forested interior of Lapland. Forest Sámi families and settlers lived across a wide district that belonged to the parish of Åsele, far from its church. The settlement grew around a place of worship, where people arriving by water or forest paths needed somewhere to stay during church festivals.

On Daniel Danielsson's farm, established in 1774, visiting priests preached to Sámi people in a timber barn. Settlers and Forest Sámi asked for a chapel of their own, and permission was granted in 1783. Petrus Gavelin became the first resident preacher that year, but the small and poor community needed eleven years to finish its timber church. Volgsjö was renamed Vilhelmina in 1804 after Queen Frederica Dorothea Wilhelmina, and became a separate parish in 1812.
simp_chinese:
沃尔格舍位于拉普兰森林内陆，靠近同名湖泊。森林萨米家庭和移民散居在广阔地区，隶属远在外地的奥瑟勒堂区。聚落围绕礼拜地点发展起来，沿水路或林间小道前来的人们需要在教会节日期间找到住宿。

在丹尼尔·丹尼尔松1774年建立的农场里，来访牧师曾在木谷仓中向萨米人布道。移民和森林萨米人请求建造自己的礼拜堂，1783年获得许可。同年，彼得鲁斯·加韦林成为首位常驻传教士，但人数不多、生活贫困的社群用了十一年才完成木教堂。1804年，沃尔格舍以王后弗雷德里卡·多萝特娅·威廉明娜之名改称威廉明娜，1812年成为独立堂区。

english: Völkermarkt stands in the Drava valley of southern Carinthia, north of the Karawanken mountains. A trading post was established here around 1090 by the descendants of Count Siegfried of Sponheim, and a church followed at the direction of the archbishop of Salzburg. Duke Bernhard von Spanheim ordered a bridge over the Drava in 1217 and rebuilt the settlement in 1231. Granted town privileges in the thirteenth century, it became an important market for iron from the surrounding mines.
simp_chinese: 弗尔克马克特位于克恩滕南部的德拉瓦河谷，卡拉万克山脉以北。约1090年，施蓬海姆伯爵西格弗里德的后代在此建立贸易站；萨尔茨堡总主教随后命人在附近修建教堂。1217年，伯恩哈德·冯·施潘海姆公爵下令在德拉瓦河上架桥，1231年又重建聚落。城镇于十三世纪取得城市特权，并成为周边矿山铁产的重要市场。

english:
Volkona was the centre of a small principality on the river now called the Volkhonka, a tributary of the Upa. The Volkonsky princes took their name from this wooded district, one of the appanages that emerged from the lands of Tarusa. Archaeological sites near the river preserve traces of the fortified centre and settlements of the principality.

In the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries the Volkona district stretched along the Upa’s right bank and its smaller tributaries. Ivan III took the family’s old possession, but Boris Godunov later returned Volkona to one of the princes for service as an envoy to Crimea. The Volkonskys continued to serve as commanders and officials, carrying the name of their ancestral river far beyond their original estate.
simp_chinese:
沃尔科纳是一个小公国的中心，位于后来称沃尔洪卡河的河流上，后者是乌帕河的支流。沃尔孔斯基诸侯得名于这片林区，它是从塔鲁萨土地中分出的诸多分封领地之一。河边考古遗址保存着公国设防中心和聚落的痕迹。

十四至十五世纪，沃尔科纳辖区沿乌帕河右岸及其小支流分布。伊凡三世夺取了家族的旧领地；后来鲍里斯·戈东诺夫因一位沃尔孔斯基亲王出使克里米亚有功，将沃尔科纳归还给他。沃尔孔斯基家族继续担任军官与官员，将祖地河流的名字带到原有领地之外。

english:
Volodimerets was a hilltop fortress among the outlying strongholds that defended the Pskov Republic. Archaeology points to settlement here by the thirteenth century. In 1462 the people of Pskov founded a new fort on the hill where an older one had stood and built a church dedicated to Saint Nicholas. An earthen rampart and wooden towers protected the summit, while a separate settlement and church lay below.

The fortress guarded the Pskov lands against Lithuanian raids and retained that role after Pskov passed to Moscow in 1510. During the Livonian War, Russian forces operated from Volodimerets, but in 1580 Stephen Báthory's army destroyed the fort. It was not rebuilt, though the settlement below survived. A fire in 1790 was followed by the construction of a stone Church of Saint Nicholas.
simp_chinese:
沃洛季梅列茨是一座山顶堡垒，属于保卫普斯科夫共和国的外围要塞。考古发现表明，至迟在十三世纪这里已有聚落。1462年，普斯科夫人在旧城遗址所在的山上修建新堡，并建起圣尼古拉教堂。土垒和木塔保护山顶，下方则有独立的居民区和教堂。

这座堡垒守卫普斯科夫土地，抵御立陶宛人的袭击；1510年普斯科夫归入莫斯科后，它继续承担这一职责。利沃尼亚战争期间，俄罗斯军队曾以沃洛季梅列茨为出发点行动，但1580年斯特凡·巴托里的军队摧毁了堡垒。堡垒未再重建，山下的聚落却延续下来。1790年火灾过后，当地建起了一座圣尼古拉石教堂。

english:
Volodymyr stands on the Luha in western Volhynia. First mentioned in 988, it became a princely capital and an important ecclesiastical centre of Rus'. Its earthworks and the Dormition Cathedral, built under Prince Mstyslav in the twelfth century, recall the city's stature in the age of the Volhynian princes.

The city passed between Poland and Lithuania during the struggles for Galicia and Volhynia. A truce in 1431 left it under Lithuanian rule, and Volodymyr acquired Magdeburg rights. The Union of Lublin brought it under the Polish Crown in 1569. Orthodox, Catholic and Jewish communities shaped its civic and religious life, while its castle remained a centre of authority in the surrounding district. Wars of the seventeenth century devastated Volodymyr, especially in 1653 and 1658, and the city declined. Some recovery followed in the eighteenth century, when the Jesuits built a stone church in 1755. In 1795 the third partition of Poland placed Volodymyr in the Russian Empire.
simp_chinese:
沃洛德梅尔坐落在沃里尼亚西部的卢哈河畔。它首见于988年的记载，后来成为罗斯的诸侯首府和重要教会中心。城垒与姆斯季斯拉夫公爵在十二世纪修建的圣母安息主教座堂，见证了这座城市在沃里尼亚诸侯时代的地位。

争夺加利西亚与沃里尼亚的战争中，城市在波兰与立陶宛之间易手。1431年停战后它归立陶宛统治，并获得马格德堡法权。1569年卢布林联合使其划归波兰王冠。东正教、天主教和犹太社群塑造了当地的市民与宗教生活，城堡则始终是周围地区的权力中心。十七世纪的战争摧残沃洛德梅尔，1653年和1658年尤其严重，城市因而衰落。十八世纪有所恢复，耶稣会于1755年建造石教堂。1795年第三次瓜分波兰后，沃洛德梅尔归入俄罗斯帝国。

english: Volodymyrets lies in the forest country of northern Volhynia, among the rivers and wetlands of Polesia. A tax register of 1570 describes it as an old settlement in the Lutsk district. Its name and the surrounding villages belong to a landscape shaped by woods, marshes and the waterways leading towards the Styr and Horyn. The district formed part of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth during the early modern period.
simp_chinese: 弗拉基米列茨位于沃里尼亚北部的森林地带，周围是波列西亚的河流和湿地。1570年的税册将它记为卢茨克地区的一处古老居民点。这里与周围村庄共同构成林木、沼泽及通往斯特里河和霍伦河的水道交织的地貌。近世时期，这一地区属于波兰立陶宛联邦。

english:
Vologda lay on the river of that name in the forest country of the north, where the water roads from the Upper Volga ran towards the Sukhona and the White Sea. It was a Novgorod frontier district, named in a treaty of 1264 and attacked in 1273 by Prince Svyatoslav of Tver; the oldest birch-bark letter found in the town dates from about 1320 to 1340. Its place at the crossing of rivers made it a prize in the wars between Novgorod, Tver and Moscow. Vasily I took it by force for Moscow in 1397, Prince Andrei the Lesser held it as his own appanage from 1462, and in 1481 it passed to Ivan III.

Under Ivan IV, Vologda became the hub of Russia's trade with England and Holland along the Sukhona and Northern Dvina. English merchants opened a trading house there in 1555. In 1565 the tsar chose Vologda as the capital of his oprichnina, ordered moats dug and laid out a stone kremlin meant to be twice the size of Moscow's. In 1568–70 the Cathedral of St Sophia went up, copied from the Dormition cathedral of the Moscow Kremlin. In 1571 Ivan stopped the work and left for good. In 1608 the town swore to the Second False Dmitry, then rose against his governor, and in 1612 the Muscovy Company moved its head office here. By the end of the seventeenth century only Moscow and Yaroslavl had more households.
simp_chinese:
沃洛格达坐落在同名河畔的北方森林地带，从上伏尔加河通往苏霍纳河和白海的水路经过这里。它原是诺夫哥罗德的边地，1264年的条约中提到了它，1273年遭特维尔公爵斯维亚托斯拉夫攻击；城中发现的最古老的桦树皮文书，写于约1320年至1340年。位于河道交会处的位置，使它成为诺夫哥罗德、特维尔与莫斯科之间战争的争夺目标。瓦西里一世于1397年以武力将其并入莫斯科，1462年起小安德烈公爵将其作为自己的封地，1481年转归伊凡三世。

伊凡四世时期，沃洛格达成为俄国经苏霍纳河与北德维纳河同英国、荷兰贸易的枢纽。1555年，英国商人在此开设商馆。1565年沙皇选定沃洛格达为特辖区的都城，下令挖掘壕沟，并规划了一座打算比莫斯科克里姆林大一倍的石造克里姆林。1568至1570年，仿照莫斯科克里姆林圣母安息大教堂的圣索菲亚大教堂建成。1571年，伊凡下令停工并永远离开此地。1608年，该城向第二伪德米特里宣誓效忠，随后起事反抗他的总督；1612年，莫斯科公司把总部迁到这里。十七世纪末，只有莫斯科和雅罗斯拉夫尔的户数多于沃洛格达。

english:
Volok, later known as Volokolamsk, grew at a portage between waterways leading toward the Volga and the Moskva River. Its name recalls the hauling of boats across the watershed. Novgorodians used the route in their dealings with the lands farther south, and the settlement appears in chronicles in 1135.

In the fifteenth century Volokolamsk was a princely seat on the western approaches to Moscow. Its white-stone Resurrection Cathedral was built in the latter half of the century, while Joseph of Volokolamsk founded his monastery nearby in 1479.
