During the Time of Troubles the town’s position again exposed it to warfare; in 1613 it resisted a siege by the forces of the Polish-Lithuanian king. It became a district town in 1781, long after the old portage had given it its name.
simp_chinese:
沃洛克后来称沃洛科拉姆斯克，兴起于连接通往伏尔加河与莫斯科河水路的拖船路旁。地名令人想起船只被拖过分水岭的情景。诺夫哥罗德人曾利用这条路线与南方地区往来，聚落于1135年见于编年史。

十五世纪，沃洛科拉姆斯克是莫斯科西方门户上的诸侯驻地。白石复活主教座堂建于该世纪后半叶；沃洛科拉姆斯克的约瑟夫则于1479年在附近创建修道院。动乱时期，城镇因其位置再次遭遇战争；1613年，它抵御了波兰立陶宛国王军队的围攻。1781年，城镇成为县治，此时古老拖船路赋予的名字已流传许久。

english: Volosovichy lies in the wooded country near Chachersk, east of the Sozh. A burial ground of numerous mounds near the village testifies to settlement in the area long ago. The surrounding Chachersk lands formed part of the principality of Chernihiv and later the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, before passing to Russia in the first partition of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth in 1772.
simp_chinese: 沃洛索维奇位于恰切尔斯克附近、索日河以东的林地。村庄附近的众多古墓丘见证了这一带久远的居民活动。周围的恰切尔斯克地区曾属于切尔尼戈夫公国，后来归立陶宛大公国；1772年波兰立陶宛联邦第一次被瓜分后，地区转归俄国。

english: Volosovskaya lies in the forest and lake country west of Lacha. The Lyokshma flows from Lyokshmozero toward Lacha, whose outlet is the Onega. A parish stood on the northern shore of Lyokshmozero, while small villages occupied the woods and clearings around these waters. The river system linked this rural district to Kargopol and, farther downstream, to the White Sea coast.
simp_chinese: 沃洛索夫斯卡亚位于拉恰湖以西的森林湖泊地区。列克什马河从列克什莫泽罗湖流向拉恰湖，后者的出口是奥涅加河。列克什莫泽罗湖北岸有一处教区，小村庄则散布在水域周围的森林和开垦地中。河流系统将乡村地区与卡尔戈波尔，以及更下游的白海海岸联系起来。

english:
Volterra crowns a hill in Tuscany, enclosed by walls that recall its long history. Known as Velathri to the Etruscans, it was one of their major cities and later became the Roman Volaterrae. Its bishop held considerable authority in the Middle Ages, while ancient and medieval remains still mark the hilltop town.

Deposits of alum helped draw the interest of Florence, which brought Volterra under its rule. Resistance culminated in the war of 1472: after the town surrendered on 16 June following a siege of twenty-five days, soldiers under Federico da Montefeltro plundered it and committed violence against its local inhabitants. Wealthy families left and property was seized. In 1530 Volterra passed under the Medici and followed the history of the Tuscan state.
simp_chinese:
沃尔泰拉高踞托斯卡纳的一座山丘，城墙见证了它漫长的历史。伊特鲁里亚人称它为韦拉特里，它是该民族的重要城市之一，后来成为罗马的沃拉特拉埃。中世纪时，当地主教拥有相当大的权力，古代和中世纪遗迹仍遍布山城。

明矾矿藏帮助吸引了佛罗伦萨的注意，后者将沃尔泰拉置于自己统治之下。反抗最终导致1472年的战争：城镇经过25天围攻，于6月16日投降后，费代里科·达蒙特费尔特罗麾下的士兵洗劫城市，残害居民。富裕家族离去，财产被夺。1530年，沃尔泰拉归美第奇家族控制，此后与托斯卡纳国家命运相连。

english:
Spread across a fertile plateau in the hills near the later city of Meknes, Volubilis was the Roman #italic Walīlī#!, a western capital of the province of Mauretania Tingitana and a wealthy provincial city of triumphal arches, basilicas, oil presses, and fine mosaics at the very edge of the Roman world. Though the legions withdrew in late antiquity, the town endured under its Berber inhabitants, and it was nearby that Idrīs ibn 'Abdallāh took refuge in 788 and was acclaimed the founder of the first Muslim dynasty of Morocco. As the 14th century begins, the once-great Roman city is a field of crumbling ruins beside a modest settlement, its toppled columns a reminder of the empires that have risen and fallen upon this ground.

The life of the place had long since moved a few kilometres up the mountain slope to Moulay Idriss, where Idris lay buried. Under the Marinids his memory revived: in 1318 his remains were said to have been found there, to the excitement of the whole district, and an annual festival in his honour began to take shape each August. The sharifian sultans who followed made still more of him, and between 1719 and 1721 Moulay Ismail pulled down the old mausoleum and rebuilt it on a grander scale. The Roman ruins fared worse. They stood largely intact until the earthquake of 1755 shook them down, and afterwards Moroccan rulers carted off their stone to build Meknes.
simp_chinese:
沃吕比利斯坐落在在后来的梅克内斯城附近山丘上的一片肥沃高原上，罗马人称为#italic 瓦利利#!，廷吉塔纳毛里塔尼亚行省的西部首府，一座拥有凯旋门、巴西利卡、榨油坊和精美马赛克的富裕省城，位于罗马世界的最边缘。尽管军团在古代晚期撤离，这座城镇在柏柏尔居民手中存续了下来，788年伊德里斯·伊本·阿卜杜拉就是在附近避难，并被拥戴为摩洛哥第一个穆斯林王朝的奠基人。到14世纪初，这座曾经伟大的罗马城市已是一片倾颓的废墟，旁边是一个不大的定居点，那些倒下的柱子提醒着人们曾在这片土地上兴起又衰亡的帝国。

这里的人烟早已移到几公里外山坡上的穆莱伊德里斯，伊德里斯就葬在那里。马林王朝时期，人们重新尊崇这位奠基者：1318年据说在那里找到了他的遗骨，一时轰动四乡，每年8月纪念他的节庆也由此渐渐成形。此后的谢里夫王朝更加推崇他，1719至1721年，穆莱·伊斯梅尔拆掉旧陵墓，按更宏大的规模重建。罗马遗址的命运则要坏得多。它们大体完好地立到1755年，那年的地震把它们震倒，此后摩洛哥统治者又把石料运走，用来修建梅克内斯。

english: Vonitsa lies on the southern shore of the Ambracian Gulf, beneath a castle overlooking the sheltered waters. Nearby stood ancient Anactorium, founded by Corinthians in the seventh century BC and diminished when Rome settled its inhabitants at Nicopolis after the battle of Actium. Vonitsa itself grew in Byzantine times and became the last mainland stronghold of the Despotate of Epirus. The Ottomans took it in 1479; Venice later held it from 1684 until the republic's fall in 1797.
simp_chinese: 沃尼察位于安布拉基亚湾南岸，城堡俯瞰着平静的海湾。附近曾有古城阿纳克托里翁，公元前七世纪由科林斯人建立；阿克提乌姆战役后，罗马人将居民迁往尼科波利斯，古城随之衰落。沃尼察本身兴起于拜占庭时期，成为伊庇鲁斯专制国在大陆上最后的据点。1479年奥斯曼人占领此地；1684年以后，威尼斯又统治沃尼察，直到共和国于1797年灭亡。

english: Võnnu lies southeast of Tartu in an old parish of the country once known as Ugandi. Its church, dedicated to St James, served the surrounding villages and became one of the largest churches in the Estonian countryside. The parish appears in medieval records under the German name Wenden, while the settlement itself is recorded under related forms in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries. The church was rebuilt more than once, preserving the importance of this rural centre through the changing fortunes of the Bishopric of Dorpat and the lands that succeeded it.
simp_chinese: 文努位于塔尔图东南方，属于古代乌甘迪地区的一个老教区。献给圣雅各伯的教堂服务周围村落，后来成为爱沙尼亚乡间最大的教堂之一。中世纪文献以德语名文登记载此教区，十六至十七世纪又以相关名称记载当地聚落。教堂多次重建；随着多尔帕特主教区及其继承者的命运更迭，这里仍是一个重要的乡村中心。

english: Vopnafjörður opens into a mountainous bay on Iceland's northeastern coast. Its name, the “fjord of weapons,” is linked to the settler Eyvindur vopni. Feuds between local chieftains in the tenth century became the subject of Vopnfirðinga saga, written in the thirteenth. In later centuries foreign merchants sailed into the bay, and Vopnafjörður was one of eastern Iceland's trading ports during the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries. Its harbor connected the farms and settlements around the fjord to ships crossing the North Atlantic.
simp_chinese: 沃普纳菲厄泽是冰岛东北海岸的一处多山海湾。它的名字意为「武器峡湾」，与定居者埃温杜尔·沃普尼有关。十世纪当地首领之间的争斗成为十三世纪写成的《沃普纳峡湾人萨迦》的题材。后来的几个世纪里，外国商船驶入海湾，沃普纳菲厄泽在十七、十八世纪是冰岛东部的贸易港口之一。港湾将周围农场与聚落同横越北大西洋的船只联系起来。

english: Vörå lies in the farming country of Ostrobothnia, inland from the Gulf of Bothnia. Its parish emerged from districts once shared among Pedersöre, Storkyro and Korsholm. A wooden church was completed here in 1626, its timber construction reflecting the resources of the surrounding forests. In 1777 the church was enlarged into a cruciform building to accommodate its congregation.
simp_chinese: 沃罗位于波的尼亚湾内陆的博滕农区。当地教区从曾由佩德舍勒、斯托尔许鲁和科什霍尔姆分管的地区形成。1626年，一座木教堂在此建成，建筑材料来自周围的森林。1777年，教堂扩建为十字形，以容纳教众。

english:
Vordingborg stands on the southern coast of Zealand, where routes across the Danish islands meet waters leading toward the western Baltic. Its castle overlooks cultivated land, coastal settlements and sea passages. Farming, fishing, crafts and local commerce supported the town, while its position made it useful for movement between islands and neighbouring shores.

In the Middle Ages, Vordingborg became an important royal fortress and residence. Its castle and surviving Goose Tower recall the power of Danish kings in the kingdom and Baltic region. Royal gatherings and military planning gave the town importance beyond its size. Later political changes reduced some royal functions, while markets and rural production continued to sustain local life.
simp_chinese:
沃尔丁堡位于西兰岛南岸，丹麦诸岛间的道路在此接近通往波罗的海西部的水域。城堡俯瞰耕地、沿海聚落和海上通道。农业、捕鱼、手工业及地方贸易支持城镇，海路则连接附近岛屿与海岸。

中世纪，沃尔丁堡成为重要的王室堡垒和居所。城堡及留存至今的鹅塔见证丹麦国王在国内与波罗的海地区的权力。王室集会和军事规划使城镇具有超出其规模的重要性。后来的政治变化削弱了部分王室职能，市场和乡村生产仍继续支持当地生活。

english: The Vorkuta River flows through the northern tundra to join the Usa from the right. The Usa in turn enters the Pechora, carrying these waters toward the Arctic. The river crosses a landscape of open country and long winters on the western side of the northern Urals. Its basin belongs to the northern drainage network that connects the mountains and tundra with the lower Pechora.
simp_chinese: 沃尔库塔河流经北方苔原，从右岸汇入乌萨河。乌萨河又注入伯朝拉河，将河水带往北冰洋。这里位于北乌拉尔西侧，地势开阔，冬季漫长；河流所在的北方水系将山脉和苔原与伯朝拉河下游联系起来，河谷也是北方各条支流汇聚的地带。

english:
Voronezh stands on the river of the same name, above its junction with the Don. Established as a fortress in 1586, it guarded the southern approaches to the Russian state. Its river connected the wooded country around the town with the Don and the distant Sea of Azov, a connection that would transform the frontier fortress into a centre of shipbuilding.

Peter I's first campaign against the Ottoman fortress of Azov failed in 1695. To prevent the defenders from receiving supplies by sea, he ordered ships built for a renewed assault. At Voronezh, craftsmen worked through the winter of 1695–1696, assembling galleys and building other vessels. The flotilla sailed down the Don and helped blockade Azov, which surrendered in July 1696.

After the victory, the Boyar Duma decided in October 1696 that sea-going ships should be built. New yards followed along the Voronezh and its tributaries, including those at Chizhovka and Ramon. The campaign made the yards of Voronezh a foundation of the Azov fleet. On the galley Principium, Peter drew up rules for the fleet; in 1700 the ship Goto Predestinatsiya was launched at the Voronezh yard. The building of vessels drew labour, timber and expertise to the river town. Its importance lay in a waterway that carried ships from an inland frontier to the struggle for the southern seas.
simp_chinese:
沃罗涅日坐落在同名河流畔，位于该河汇入顿河之处的上游。1586年建立的要塞守卫着俄罗斯国家的南方门户。河流将城镇周围的林地与顿河及远方的亚速海连接起来，这条水路后来使边疆要塞变成造船中心。

彼得一世于1695年首次进攻奥斯曼要塞亚速，但未能取胜。为了阻止守军从海上获得补给，他下令建造船只，准备再次进攻。1695至1696年的冬季，工匠在沃罗涅日组装桨帆船并建造其他船只。舰队沿顿河驶下，协助封锁亚速；要塞于1696年7月投降。

胜利之后，波雅尔杜马于1696年10月决定建造海船。沃罗涅日河及其支流沿岸随后出现新的船场，包括奇若夫卡和拉蒙的船场。这场战役使沃罗涅日的船场成为亚速舰队的基础。彼得在桨帆船「普林齐皮乌姆」号上拟定舰队规章；1700年，「天意」号战舰在沃罗涅日船场下水。造船将劳力、木材和技术引向这座河畔城镇。此地的重要性源于那条水路，它使船只从内陆边疆驶向南方海域的争夺之地。

english:
Voronich was a fortified dependency of Pskov and part of the chain of strongholds guarding its southwestern frontier. It resisted a three-week siege by the Lithuanian army of Vytautas in 1426. In the fifteenth century the town had more than four hundred houses, as well as Orthodox churches and monasteries, and it grew into one of the principal settlements of the Pskov lands.

The forces of King Stephen Báthory destroyed Voronich during the Livonian War in 1581, and the town was not restored to its former standing. In 1610 Alexander Lisowski's Polish-Lithuanian detachment used the fortress as a base for raids into the Pskov region. Its lands and those of neighboring religious foundations later passed into the tsar's estate; in 1719 Voronich was assigned to Opochka.
simp_chinese:
沃罗尼奇是普斯科夫所属的设防城镇，也是保卫其西南边境的一系列要塞之一。1426年，它抵住了维陶塔斯所率立陶宛军队长达三周的围攻。十五世纪，城内有四百多座房屋，以及东正教堂和修道院，逐渐发展为普斯科夫地区的主要聚落之一。

1581年利沃尼亚战争期间，斯特凡·巴托里国王的军队摧毁了沃罗尼奇，城镇此后未能恢复昔日地位。1610年，亚历山大·利索夫斯基的波兰—立陶宛部队以堡垒为据点，袭击普斯科夫地区。沃罗尼奇及周围宗教机构的土地后来归入沙皇领地；1719年，它被划归奥波奇卡。

english: Voronizh lies near the Shostka in the Severian lands, not far from Hlukhiv. The settlement grew in the early seventeenth century and became a Cossack company town with earthworks and towers. Its merchants traded manufactured goods, including silk and woollen cloth, with neighbouring towns. During the Great Northern War Peter I was here in 1708 when news reached him of the capture of Baturyn.
simp_chinese: 沃罗尼日位于谢韦里亚地区的肖斯特卡河附近，离格卢希夫不远。居民点在十七世纪初发展起来，成为设有土垒和塔楼的哥萨克百人队城镇。商人与邻近城镇交换制成品，包括丝织品和呢绒。大北方战争期间，彼得一世于1708年在此获知巴图林被攻占的消息。

english: Vorontsovo lies near the Shangina basin on the northern side of the Alazeya Plateau. The Shangina descends from the plateau into a broad, lake-filled floodplain before joining the Indigirka from the east. It remains frozen from early October until late May or June.
simp_chinese: 沃龙佐沃位于阿拉泽亚高原北侧，靠近尚吉纳河流域。尚吉纳河从高原流入湖泊密布的宽阔泛滥平原，随后从东面汇入因迪吉尔卡河；河流从十月初封冻至次年五月末或六月。

english:
Vorotynsk stood in the upper Oka country near the Vyssa, where earthworks mark an old fortified site. The Vorotynsky princes held lands between the Oka and Ugra under Lithuanian authority before entering the service of Moscow. Their estates occupied a frontier where rivers and forts separated competing powers.

In 1480 Khan Ahmad halted near New Vorotynsk before the confrontation on the Ugra with Ivan III’s forces. The opposing armies withdrew without a general battle. Soon afterwards the Vorotynsky princes transferred their allegiance to Moscow. Prince Dmitry Vorotynsky is associated with the foundation of the Saviour monastery near the mouth of the Ugra, probably in the early sixteenth century. Its churches stood close to the river landscape made famous by the stand of 1480.
simp_chinese:
沃罗滕斯克位于奥卡河上游维萨河附近，土垒标示着古老设防遗址。沃罗滕斯基诸侯曾在立陶宛权威下拥有奥卡河与乌格拉河之间的土地，后来转而效力莫斯科。他们的产业坐落在诸强以河流和堡垒分界的边地。

1480年，阿赫马德汗在与伊凡三世军队于乌格拉河对峙之前，曾在新沃罗滕斯克附近停留。双方没有进行大会战便撤退。此后不久，沃罗滕斯基诸侯转投莫斯科。德米特里·沃罗滕斯基亲王与乌格拉河口附近的救世主修道院创建有关，修道院很可能建于十六世纪初。其教堂位于1480年对峙所使之闻名的河流地带。

english: The Zusha valley near Novosil contains an old fortified site at Vorotyntsevo. The town of that name appears in a chronicle under 1155 among the possessions of the Chernigov princes. The surrounding Novosil lands later formed a small principality on the upper Oka frontier. After Tatar attacks in the 1370s, its princely centre moved to Odoyev, while the branches of the family continued to hold and contest estates across the region.
simp_chinese: 诺沃西利附近祖沙河谷的沃罗滕采沃有一处古老设防遗址。同名城镇于1155年见于编年史，被列入切尔尼戈夫诸侯的领地。周围的诺沃西利土地后来形成奥卡河上游边境的小公国。1370年代遭鞑靼人袭击后，诸侯中心迁至奥多耶夫，而家族各支系继续在当地占有并争夺土地。

english: Voskresenskoye lies on the Vetluga, a forest river flowing south to the Volga. The village is recorded in 1614, in a district of woods and waterways north of the great river. The Vetluga gave its settlements a route toward the Volga, while forests supplied timber and formed a broad belt between the cultivated clearings. Its riverbank position placed Voskresenskoye within the long history of settlement along the Vetluga valley.
simp_chinese: 沃斯克列先斯科耶位于韦特卢加河畔，这条林区河流向南注入伏尔加河。村庄见于1614年的记载，地处伏尔加河以北森林与水道交错的地区。韦特卢加河为沿岸聚落提供通往伏尔加河的道路，森林则供应木材，并在开垦地之间形成广阔的林带。河岸的位置使村庄成为韦特卢加河谷长期聚居历史的一部分。

english:
Vosporo stands on the Kerch Strait, where the Black Sea narrows into the passage to the Sea of Azov. Miletian Greeks founded Panticapaeum here in the 7th century BC, and it became the capital of the Bosporan kingdom; the acropolis crowned the hill later called Mount Mithridat. The medieval town was Byzantine, then Khazar, then part of the Russian principality of Tmutarakan, before the Mongols took Crimea in 1239.

In 1318 the town passed to the Genoese, who knew it as Vospro or Cerchio and ruled it from Kaffa as part of their Black Sea colonies. Genoese records show Circassian princes governing it under them. Townspeople worked the salt pans and fishing grounds along the strait. When the Ottomans took the Genoese colonies in 1475, the town fell into decay, served as a slave market and suffered repeated raids by Zaporozhian Cossacks. In 1701 the Ottomans began the fortress of Yeni-Kale on the strait to watch the passage. Russian troops entered in 1771, and by the Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca in 1774 the town and Yeni-Kale were ceded to Russia, nine years before the rest of Crimea.
simp_chinese:
沃斯波罗位于刻赤海峡边，黑海在此收窄为通往亚速海的水道。公元前7世纪，来自米利都的希腊人在这里建立潘提卡彭城，它后来成为博斯普鲁斯王国的都城，卫城坐落在后来称为米特里达特山的高地上。中世纪的城镇先属拜占庭，后属可萨人，又并入罗斯的特穆塔拉坎公国，1239年蒙古人占领克里米亚。

1318年，此地归于热那亚人，他们称之为沃斯波罗或切尔基奥，作为黑海殖民地的一部分由卡法管辖。热那亚文献记载，当地的实际治理者是在热那亚人之下的切尔克斯诸公。居民在海峡沿岸经营盐田和渔场。1475年奥斯曼人夺取热那亚殖民地后，城镇逐渐衰败，成为奴隶市场，并屡遭扎波罗热哥萨克劫掠。1701年，奥斯曼人开始在海峡边修建耶尼卡莱要塞，监视通道。1771年俄军进入此地，1774年《屈楚克凯纳尔吉条约》把这座城镇和耶尼卡莱割让给俄罗斯，比克里米亚其余地区早了九年。

english:
Set among the mountains east of Bergen, Voss lies beside a lake at a junction of valleys leading towards the fjords and the interior. Its stone church at Vangen gives the district a particularly striking landmark. Dedicated to Saint Michael in 1277, it replaced an older wooden church at the urging of King Magnus the Lawmender.

The church served generations of farming communities spread through the valleys. During the seventeenth century its old stone tower was replaced by a wooden one, changing the silhouette of the medieval building while its stone walls continued to shelter the local congregation for centuries. In 1814 the church was among the Norwegian polling places where electors were chosen for the constituent assembly that would meet at Eidsvoll.
simp_chinese:
沃斯位于卑尔根以东的群山之间，湖畔数条山谷在此汇合，通向峡湾和内陆。旺恩的石教堂是当地最醒目的地标之一。它在国王马格努斯·拉加伯特的敦促下取代了一座木教堂，并于1277年献给圣米迦勒。

这座教堂世代服务于散居山谷中的农民。17世纪，古老的石塔被木塔取代，改变了中世纪建筑的轮廓，石墙则继续庇护着当地的教众。1814年，这里也是挪威的选举教堂之一，选民在此推选代表参加埃兹沃尔制宪会议。

english:
Vostitsa, the medieval name of modern Aigio, lies on the northern coast of the Peloponnese facing the Gulf of Corinth. After the Crusader conquest, it became the centre of one of the original baronies of the Principality of Achaea, established around 1209. The barony was associated with the Charpigny family and initially comprised eight knights' fiefs.

Vostitsa remained in Latin hands into the fourteenth century as Byzantine power expanded elsewhere in the peninsula. Its lordship changed hands repeatedly, passing to Nerio Acciaioli in 1363 and later to the Navarrese Company. In 1428 it fell to Theodore Palaiologos, despot of the Morea, who transferred it to his brother Constantine.
simp_chinese:
沃斯蒂察是今日埃伊翁的中世纪名称，位于伯罗奔尼撒北岸，面向科林斯湾。十字军征服后，这里成为亚该亚公国最初一批男爵领之一的中心，男爵领约于1209年设立，由沙尔皮尼家族持有，最初包含八个骑士封地。

到14世纪，拜占庭势力在半岛其他地区扩张时，沃斯蒂察仍由拉丁领主持有。领地随后数次易手，1363年转至内里奥·阿恰约利，后来被纳瓦拉佣兵团占据。1428年摩里亚专制公西奥多·巴列奥略夺取此地，再将其交给兄弟君士坦丁。

english:
Votkinsk grew around an ironworks founded by Count Pyotr Shuvalov on the Votka in 1757. A large dam was built below the mouths of the Sharkan and Berezovka, and skilled workers and thousands of assigned peasants took part in construction. The first iron was produced in 1759. Hard conditions for assigned peasants contributed to unrest, and the Kama works passed to the state mining administration in 1763.

Pugachev's forces captured the settlement and works in June 1774, damaging buildings and drawing some workers into the rebellion. The plant was restored the following year. From 1779 it took up the manufacture of anchors for the navy, with Admiralty craftsmen helping to establish a dedicated forge. Its first Admiralty-pattern anchors were produced in 1782. In 1813 the works settlement received the status of a mining town.
simp_chinese:
沃特金斯克围绕彼得·舒瓦洛夫伯爵1757年在沃特卡河建立的炼铁厂发展起来。沙尔坎河与别廖佐夫卡河口下方修筑了大坝，技术工匠和数千名附籍农民参与建设。1759年工厂产出第一批铁。附籍农民处境艰苦，引发不满；1763年，卡马河地区的工厂转由国家矿业机构管理。

1774年6月，普加乔夫部队攻占聚落和工厂，破坏建筑，一部分工人加入了起义。次年工厂得到修复。1779年起，它开始为海军制造船锚，海军部工匠协助建立专门的锻造车间，1782年产出首批海军式样船锚。1813年，厂区聚落获得矿业城镇地位。

english: Vovchansk lies on the Vovcha, or Wolf River, a tributary of the Siverskyi Donets. The Cossack sloboda of Vovchi Vody was founded in 1674 by Ukrainian settlers led by Martyn Starochudny, on the riverbank upstream from the later town centre. Like other settlements of Sloboda Ukraine it grew along the frontier's wooded rivers. In 1780 it became a district town under the name Vovchansk.
simp_chinese: 沃夫昌斯克位于沃夫查河畔，河名意为“狼河”，它是北顿涅茨河的支流。1674年，马尔廷·斯塔罗丘德尼率领乌克兰移民在河岸建立沃夫奇沃迪哥萨克斯洛博达，地点位于后来的城镇中心上游。它与斯洛博达乌克兰的其他聚落一样，沿边疆林木繁茂的河谷成长。1780年，这里以沃夫昌斯克之名成为县城。

english: Vowpa lies on the Volpyanka, a tributary of the Ros in the Grodno country. In 1449 Grand Duke Casimir granted the estate to Olekhno Sudimontovich, later chancellor of Lithuania. In 1624 Lew Sapieha acquired it for his son Kazimierz. A magnificent wooden synagogue rose in the town in the early eighteenth century, its carved interior a testament to the craft and religious life of the Jewish community. In 1792 King Stanisław August granted Vowpa Magdeburg rights and a coat of arms bearing a beaver on a blue field.
simp_chinese: 沃夫帕位于格罗德诺地区的沃尔皮扬卡河畔，这条河是罗斯河的支流。1449年，卡齐米日大公将庄园赐予后来担任立陶宛大臣的奥列赫诺·苏季蒙托维奇。1624年，莱夫·萨皮哈为儿子卡齐米日购得此地。十八世纪初，镇上兴建了一座宏伟的木造犹太会堂，雕刻精美的内部见证了犹太社群的工艺与宗教生活。1792年，斯坦尼斯瓦夫·奥古斯特国王授予沃夫帕马格德堡法及蓝底海狸城徽。

english: The Voyampolka flows westward to the Sea of Okhotsk between banks thick with dwarf pine and willow. Rich in fish, the river has long supported communities along its course. Its Koryak name has been interpreted as the “river of the drowned,” recalling its swift current and dangerous whirlpools. Vladimir Atlasov's party recorded this region during its passage through Kamchatka at the end of the seventeenth century.
simp_chinese: 沃亚姆波尔卡河向西注入鄂霍次克海，河岸长满偃松与柳树。河中鱼类丰富，长久以来养育着沿岸社群。其科里亚克语名称被解释为“溺亡者之河”，令人想起湍急水流与危险漩涡。十七世纪末，弗拉基米尔·阿特拉索夫的队伍穿越堪察加时曾记述这一地区。

english: Voykarsky Sor is a broad lake formed where the Voikar spreads across the floodplain before entering the Malaya Ob. Two opposing points divide its waters into western and eastern reaches. The lake expands with the spring flood, linking mountain runoff from the Polar Urals with the channels of the lower Ob. Its shallow waters are part of the rich fishing landscape of this northern river system.
simp_chinese: 沃伊卡尔索尔是沃伊卡尔河在注入马拉亚鄂毕之前，漫过泛滥平原形成的宽阔湖泊。两个相对伸出的岬角将湖水分为东西两片。春汛使湖面扩大，把极地乌拉尔山的径流与鄂毕河下游水道相连；浅水湖泊也是北方河系丰富捕鱼景观的一部分。

english: The Vozhega flows west through forest and low hills to Lake Vozhe, dividing into several channels near its mouth. Its tributaries include the Chuzhga and Tavenga, and old groups of villages took their names from these rivers. In the seventeenth century the basin belonged to the Charonda district, whose inhabitants farmed the clearings and used the waterways leading to the lake and the Onega.
simp_chinese: 沃热加河向西穿过森林和低丘流入沃热湖，河口附近分成数条水道。其支流包括丘日加河和塔文加河，沿岸的一些旧村落群以河流命名。十七世纪，这片流域属于恰龙达地区；居民在林间开垦土地，并利用通往湖泊和奥涅加河的水路。

english: Voznesenskoye belongs to the forest country of the Northern Dvina, north of the Toyma rivers. In the seventeenth century the surrounding Irshchina formed part of the Lower Toyma district of the Vaga lands. The rivers joined scattered villages to the Northern Dvina, the great route by which goods and people travelled between the interior and the White Sea. The later Afanasyevskaya district grew from this group of northern settlements.
simp_chinese: 沃兹涅先斯科耶属于托伊马诸河以北的北德维纳林区。十七世纪，周围的伊尔希纳地区属于瓦加土地中的下托伊马地方区。河流将分散的村庄与北德维纳河连接起来，货物和旅人沿这条重要水道往返于内陆与白海之间。后来的阿法纳西耶夫斯卡亚地方区便从这些北方聚落发展而来。

english: At Voznesenye the Svir leaves Lake Onega and begins its westward course to Lake Ladoga. A monastery dedicated to the Ascension was founded on the river’s right bank in 1563, giving the place its name. Burned by Swedish forces some two decades later, it was restored in 1628 and subsequently became a convent. The monastery was abolished in 1764, leaving a churchyard at the head of the river. Fishing huts and a few houses stood along these shores before a larger settlement developed.
simp_chinese: 在沃兹涅谢尼耶，斯维里河流出奥涅加湖，向西奔向拉多加湖。1563年，河右岸建立了一座基督升天修道院，地名由此而来。约二十年后，瑞典军队烧毁了修道院；1628年它得到重建，后来又改为女修道院。1764年修道院遭裁撤，河源处留下了一座教堂村。在较大的聚落形成之前，湖河岸边散布着几所房屋和渔民小屋。

english: The Ayakagitma depression is a low basin in the Kyzylkum Desert, among broad stretches of sand and salt-bearing ground. Its lowest parts include salt marshes and hard clay flats known as takyrs, where water can collect after rainfall before evaporating in the dry climate. Archaeological sites in the depression preserve traces of human occupation extending back into the Stone Age, revealing a long history in a landscape now marked by aridity.
simp_chinese: 阿亚卡雷特马洼地位于克孜勒库姆沙漠，是大片沙地与盐碱地之间的一处低盆地。洼地最低处有盐沼和称为塔基尔的坚硬黏土平地；雨后水可在此汇集，继而在干燥气候中蒸发。洼地内的考古遗址保存着远至石器时代的人类活动痕迹，见证了这片干旱土地悠久的居住史。

sources.title: 661a26f9d33c8   Halophytes of the Aralkum Saline Desert- (Low resolution).pdf

english: Vranje lies in the valley country of the South Morava, between the central Balkans and the roads leading towards Macedonia. Anna Komnene first mentioned it in the eleventh century, when the Serbian ruler Vukan briefly took it from Byzantium. The town later became part of the Serbian state and gave its name to a district of villages and pastures. Trade with the mining town of Novo Brdo encouraged settlement in the surrounding countryside. The Ottomans captured Vranje in 1455 and made it the seat of a district.
simp_chinese: 弗拉涅位于南摩拉瓦河的谷地地区，介于巴尔干中部与通往马其顿的道路之间。安娜·科穆宁在十一世纪的记述中首次提到此地，当时塞尔维亚统治者武坎曾短暂从拜占庭人手中夺取它。城镇后来成为塞尔维亚国家的一部分，并以其名字命名周围的村庄与牧地辖区。与矿城新布尔多的贸易促进了乡间聚落发展。1455年奥斯曼人攻占弗拉涅，将它设为一个辖区的治所。

english:
Beneath the sheer cliffs of the Leva River gorge, Vratsa grew at the foot of the western Balkan Mountains. The mountains held deposits of copper, lead, silver and gold, and the town became known for the skill of its metalworkers. Its goldsmiths fashioned jewelry and church objects, while vineyards and farms spread through the surrounding country.

Under Ottoman rule Vratsa's craftsmen and merchants supplied markets far beyond the town. Goldsmiths worked precious metals into crosses, book covers and other objects, while households raised silkworms and produced silk. Local notables built substantial towers in the 16th and 17th centuries, visible signs of the wealth and insecurity of their age. The town's trades included clothmaking and leatherworking, with goods reaching such distant cities as Bucharest, Vienna and Constantinople.
simp_chinese:
弗拉察坐落在莱瓦河峡谷陡峭的岩壁之下，发展于巴尔干山脉西段的山麓。山中蕴藏着铜、铅、银和金，当地金属工匠的技艺使城镇声名远扬。金银匠制作首饰和教会用品，葡萄园与农庄则分布在周围的乡野。

奥斯曼统治时期，弗拉察的工匠与商人向远方市场供应货物。金银匠用贵金属制作十字架、书籍封饰和其他器物，居民还养蚕缫丝。地方显贵在16至17世纪建造了坚固的塔楼，显示出那个时代的财富与不安。城镇的行业还包括毛呢制造和制革，产品远销布加勒斯特、维也纳和君士坦丁堡等城市。

english: Vṛddha Ratnapura was a Cham religious centre in the northern reaches of Champa, remembered by an inscription found at Đại Hữu. The surviving fragment records the establishment of a silver image of Ratnalokesvara, a form of the bodhisattva Avalokitesvara. Other Buddhist sculptures from the site testify to a tradition of devotion in this coastal region. Together with the monastery at Đồng Dương farther south, it illustrates the place of Mahayana Buddhism in the religious life of the Cham courts.
simp_chinese: 弗栗陀剌那补罗是占婆北部的宗教中心，其名称保存在大有发现的一块铭文中。残存碑文记载了以白银铸造宝观自在像之事；宝观自在是观自在菩萨的一种形象。当地出土的其他佛教造像，也见证了这片沿海地区的信仰传统。它与更南方的同阳佛寺一道，反映了大乘佛教在占婆宫廷宗教生活中的地位。

english: Vrhbosna was a medieval district in the Sarajevo field, surrounded by the mountains of central Bosnia. A thirteenth-century royal charter mentions the district and a cathedral of Saint Peter at Brdo. In the fifteenth century the Ottoman commander Isa-beg Ishaković established religious and commercial endowments in the valley; his deed of 1462 records foundations that helped shape the growing town of Sarajevo. The older name Vrhbosna continued to appear in western records.
simp_chinese: 维尔赫博斯纳是萨拉热窝平原上的中世纪地区，四周环绕着波斯尼亚中部群山。一份十三世纪王室文书提及此地及布尔多的圣彼得主教座堂。十五世纪，奥斯曼将领伊萨贝伊·伊沙科维奇在谷地设立宗教与商业捐产；他的1462年捐赠文书记载了促成萨拉热窝城镇发展的设施。维尔赫博斯纳这个旧名此后仍见于西方文献。

english: The shore near Vrilya Point lies on the western side of Cape York Peninsula, facing the Gulf of Carpentaria. Beaches and low coastal country meet the shallow sea south of Torres Strait. In 1606 Willem Janszoon’s Duyfken charted part of the western Cape York coast during a voyage from the East Indies.
simp_chinese: 弗里利亚角附近海岸位于约克角半岛西侧，面向卡奔塔利亚湾。海滩与低矮沿岸地带在托雷斯海峡以南接连浅海。1606年，威廉·扬松的杜伊夫肯号从东印度群岛航来，测绘了约克角西岸的一部分。

english:
Vshchizh belongs to the Bryansk and Severian country, where river valleys and forests supported settlements within the medieval Rus world.
Vshchizh was a princely centre in the twelfth century. Archaeological evidence has been interpreted as indicating its destruction during the Mongol invasion in 1238, after which the old city did not recover. The wider Severian region subsequently experienced changing Lithuanian and Muscovite rule.
simp_chinese:
弗希日属于布良斯克与谢韦里亚地区，河谷和森林在中世纪罗斯世界中支持聚落。
弗希日曾是十二世纪的诸侯中心。考古证据被解释为该城在1238年蒙古入侵时遭毁，旧城此后未再恢复。更广阔的谢韦里亚地区后来经历立陶宛与莫斯科统治的变化。

english: Vstrechny lies in the Enmynveem river country of western Chukotka, among the uplands of the Little Anyuy basin. Hills and branching valleys lead toward the rivers that ultimately feed the Kolyma. The northern climate imposes a long season of frozen ground and snow; streams generally freeze in autumn and open again in late spring or early summer, after the coldest months have passed.
simp_chinese: 相遇河位于楚科奇西部的恩梅恩韦姆河地区，处在小阿纽伊河流域的高地之间。丘陵与分岔河谷通向最终汇入科雷马河的水道。北方气候带来漫长的冻土与积雪季节；溪流通常在秋季冻结，待最寒冷的月份过去，到晚春或初夏才重新解冻。

english:
Vũ Ninh is an old name for part of the northern Red River plain, in the country later known as Kinh Bắc. The Cầu River borders the area to the north, linking it with the waterways east of Thăng Long. A district bearing the name existed in the Lý period; villages and cultivated fields spread across the low ground between the river and the hills of the northern frontier.

The later city of Bắc Ninh lies here.
simp_chinese:
武宁是红河北部平原一部分的古称，位于后来称为京北的地区。梂河流经其北面，将这里与升龙以东的河流交通联系起来。李朝时期已有名为武宁的州，村落和田地散布在梂河沿岸和北方边疆山丘之间广阔而低平的土地上，形成了红河平原的一部分。

后来的北宁市即位于此地。

english:
Vukovar stands where the Vuka flows into the Danube. In the Middle Ages it was the seat of Vukovo County, with a royal fortress above a suburb of merchants and craftsmen near the harbour. Duke Coloman granted the settlement the privileges of a free royal town in 1231, and its river location helped make it one of Slavonia's important urban centres.

Ottoman forces took Vukovar in 1526, and the town became a centre of a judicial district in the Sanjak of Syrmia. The retreating Ottomans burned much of it in 1687, and further fighting damaged it in the years that followed. In the eighteenth century a new town developed on the left bank of the Vuka, while merchants and craftsmen occupied the older settlement on the right. The Eltz family acquired the estate and built a grand residence between 1749 and 1751.
simp_chinese:
武科瓦尔坐落在武卡河汇入多瑙河的地方。中世纪时，它是武科沃郡的中心，王室堡垒下方的港口附近有商人和工匠居住的城区。1231年，科洛曼公爵授予当地自由王室城市的特权，河畔位置使它成为斯拉沃尼亚的重要城镇之一。

奥斯曼军队于1526年攻占武科瓦尔，此地成为锡尔米亚桑贾克一个司法辖区的中心。1687年撤退时，奥斯曼军队焚毁了城镇的大部分，随后的战事又造成进一步破坏。十八世纪，武卡河左岸发展出新城，商人和工匠则居住在右岸的旧城区。埃尔茨家族取得当地庄园，并于1749年至1751年建造了一座宏大的宅邸。

english: Vukvylgayat, also called the Ukelayat, flows from the northeastern Koryak highlands to the Bering Sea. Glaciers in its mountain basin feed the river, whose swift upper reaches descend toward a lower valley and a branching delta. Its Koryak name has been associated with falling stones, an apt image for a watercourse born among steep and rocky highlands.
simp_chinese: 武克维尔加亚特河又称乌克埃拉亚特河，从科里亚克高地东北部流向白令海。山地流域的冰川为河流补给水源，湍急的上游向下游河谷和分汊的三角洲倾泻。其科里亚克语名称与落石有关，适合形容这条发源于陡峭多石高地的河流。

english: The Vuktyl is a tributary of the Pechora in the forested country west of the northern Urals. Its name has been linked to an old Finno-Ugric word for a river, channel or portage, with a Komi element meaning a stream. The Pechora carries its waters northward through a wide basin to the Arctic sea. The forests and river valleys here belong to the northern landscape through which the Pechora and its many tributaries flow.
simp_chinese: 武克特尔河是北乌拉尔以西林地中伯朝拉河的一条支流。河名被认为与古芬兰—乌戈尔语中河流、水道或拖舟通道的词有关，后半部分可能含有科米语“溪流”的成分。伯朝拉河穿过广阔流域向北流入北冰洋，森林和河谷构成了它及众多支流流经的北方景观。

english: Vulvyveyem is the upper course of the Amguema in the mountainous interior of Chukotka. Here the river runs swiftly through gorges and over rapids before turning toward the wider valley that leads to the Chukchi Sea. Its banks belong to the tundra country traversed by reindeer herders, who moved between coastal pastures and the interior as the seasons changed.
simp_chinese: 武尔维维耶姆是楚科奇山地内陆的阿姆古埃马河上游。在这里，河水湍急地穿过峡谷与急流，随后转向通往楚科奇海的宽阔河谷。河岸属于驯鹿牧民穿行的苔原地区，他们随季节变化在沿海牧场与内陆之间迁徙。

english: Vumba Kuu was a Swahili settlement near the coast south of Mombasa, among creeks and mangrove-lined shores. Its stone buildings and pottery mark a community connected to the other towns of the East African coast. During the seventeenth century Vumba developed a distinct identity in the changing political world of the coast, where local rulers and merchants negotiated alliances with neighbouring ports and overseas powers.
simp_chinese: 文巴库是蒙巴萨以南海岸附近的一座斯瓦希里聚落，周围分布水道与红树林海岸。石造建筑和陶器见证了它与东非其他海岸城镇相连的社群。十七世纪，文巴在不断变化的海岸政治世界中发展出鲜明身份，地方统治者和商人与邻近港口及海外势力协商联盟。

english:
Vuriloche belongs to the country around Lake Nahuel Huapi, where forests and mountain passes connect the two sides of the Andes. The name was applied to Indigenous people of the eastern side of the mountains and survives in the name of a pass through the range.

Puelche and Poya communities lived near the lake before the arrival of Jesuit missionaries from Chiloé. Jesuit missionaries established a mission at Nahuel Huapi in 1670 and returned to the lake in 1703. Nicolás Mascardi founded the first establishment, and Felipe Laguna later headed the renewed mission. They sought routes toward Chiloé, including the Vuriloche passage known to Indigenous travellers. The mission was abandoned in 1717, but the lake and its mountain approaches remained part of an extensive Indigenous world of movement and exchange.
simp_chinese:
武里洛切位于纳韦尔瓦皮湖一带，森林和山口连接安第斯山两侧。这个名称曾用于指山脉东侧的原住民，也保留在一处穿山隘口的名称中。

来自奇洛埃的耶稣会士到来之前，普埃尔切人和波亚人生活在湖区附近。耶稣会士于1670年在纳韦尔瓦皮湖建立传教站，1703年又返回湖区。尼古拉斯·马斯卡尔迪建立了第一座传教站，费利佩·拉古纳后来主持了重建的传教站。他们寻找通往奇洛埃的道路，包括原住民旅人所熟悉的武里洛切通道。传教站于1717年被放弃，但湖泊和通往它的山路仍属于原住民广阔的迁徙与交换世界。

english:
Vuta Chadihue is the great salt country of the Pampas, associated with the Salinas Grandes. Its shallow salt basins stand out in a landscape of grassland and low woodland. The Chadiches, whose name is connected with salt, were among the Indigenous communities associated with this area; salt and the routes leading to it made the salinas a significant landmark in the interior.

The later city of Santa Rosa lies here.
simp_chinese:
武塔查迪韦是潘帕的大片盐地，与大盐沼相联系。浅浅的盐盆在草地和低矮林木的景观中十分醒目。查迪切人是与这一带有关的原住民群体之一，其名称与盐有关；盐和通往盐地的道路使这片盐沼成为内陆的重要地标。

后来的圣罗莎即位于此地。

english: Vyada lay in the forest and wetland country south of Slonim, near the old Vyhanashchanskaye Lake. The village is recorded from the fifteenth century and gave its name to a district of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. By 1508 the district of Vyada was among the possessions administered for a member of the grand ducal family. Its place among the scattered settlements of this waterlogged region recalls a countryside where woodland and lakes formed the setting for local lordship, rather than the walled towns of the Neman valley.
simp_chinese: 维亚达位于斯洛尼姆以南的森林与湿地中，靠近古老的维戈诺夫斯科耶湖。村庄自十五世纪见于记载，立陶宛大公国的一个地方辖区也以此命名。到1508年，维亚达辖区已属于为大公家族成员管理的领地之一。这里散布着湿润地区的聚落，林地与湖泊构成地方领主统治的背景，与涅曼河谷的设防城镇有所不同。

english:
Vyadhapura is the old name tradition gives to the country around Ba Phnom, a 139-metre mound on the east bank of the Mekong in Prey Veng, about seventy-eight kilometres east of Phnom Penh. Excavations show it was a cultural centre of Funan and a sacred hill where Shiva was worshipped, and it kept its sacred character through the Angkor age, with traces of Buddhist and spirit rites.

When the Khmer kings left Angkor under Siamese pressure in the fifteenth century, they settled east at Phnom Penh, Longvek and Oudong. Prey Veng itself was thought dangerous because it lay too near Annam, yet an army was raised at Ba Phnom in 1473 to defend against a Siamese invasion. From the seventeenth century the Vietnamese pushed down the Mekong delta, and the king in Cambodia swung between his two big neighbours. In late 1833 a Siamese army marched through Cambodia to install rival princes against the pro-Vietnamese king Ang Chan, but Vietnamese forces threw it back at the battle of Vam Nao in January 1834. In 1835 Vietnam annexed Cambodia as Tran Tay province.
simp_chinese:
毗耶陀补罗是传说中对巴山一带的古称。巴山是湄公河东岸波雷文省内一座139米高的土丘，在金边以东约78公里。发掘表明，这里是扶南的文化中心，也是敬奉湿婆的圣丘，到吴哥时代仍保持神圣的地位，并有佛教和精灵崇拜的痕迹。

十五世纪高棉诸王迫于暹罗压力离开吴哥，向东迁往金边、龙维克和乌栋。波雷文本身被视为危险之地，因为离安南太近，但1473年还是在巴山集结了一支军队，防御暹罗入侵。十七世纪起越南人沿湄公河三角洲南下，柬埔寨国王在两个大邻国之间摇摆。1833年末，一支暹罗军队穿过柬埔寨，想扶植对立的王子取代亲越南的国王昂占，但越军于1834年1月在永诺之战中将其击退。1835年，越南把柬埔寨并为镇西省。

english:
Vyatka stands on the river of the same name, in a region where Novgorodian settlers, other Slavs and Finno-Ugric peoples met. The town is first mentioned in a chronicle in 1374, when river raiders plundered it on their way to Bolghar. Like Novgorod and Pskov, Vyatka was governed by an assembly, and its militias raided neighboring lands. During the fifteenth century Moscow repeatedly sought to subdue the self-governing Vyatka country; in 1489 it was finally annexed.

Known as Khlynov under Russian rule, the town gradually became more prominent as a center of trade. In the seventeenth century the Semenovskaya fair attracted merchants from Siberia, the Urals and the northern coast. The Vyatka diocese was established in 1657, and the town's kremlin was rebuilt under Tsar Aleksei. Its five-domed Dormition Cathedral was completed in 1689. Local makers became known for clay figures and whistles. In 1780 Catherine II restored the name Vyatka and made the town a provincial center. It also served as a place of exile. Grain, cloth, flax and other goods passed through its markets, linking the Vyatka valley to trade across the Russian interior.
simp_chinese:
维亚特卡位于同名河畔，诺夫哥罗德移民、其他斯拉夫人和芬兰—乌戈尔人曾在这一地区相遇。1374年，编年史首次记载这座城镇，当时河上劫掠者在前往保加尔途中洗劫此地。与诺夫哥罗德和普斯科夫一样，维亚特卡由民众大会治理，其民兵也袭击邻近土地。十五世纪，莫斯科屡次试图制服自治的维亚特卡地区，最终于1489年将其吞并。

俄罗斯统治下，城镇称为赫雷诺夫，贸易地位逐渐上升。十七世纪，谢苗诺夫斯卡亚集市吸引来自西伯利亚、乌拉尔和北方海岸的商人。1657年，维亚特卡教区成立；沙皇阿列克谢在位时，城中克里姆林得到重建。五圆顶的圣母安息主教堂于1689年建成，当地工匠也以陶塑和哨子闻名。1780年，叶卡捷琳娜二世恢复维亚特卡之名，使城镇成为省级中心。它也曾是流放地。粮食、布匹和亚麻等货物在市场上交易，将维亚特卡河谷与俄罗斯内陆各地联系起来。

english: Vyatskiye Polyany stands on the Vyatka River, in a region once inhabited by Udmurts, Mari and Tatars under the Kazan Khanate. In 1595 Tsar Fyodor Ivanovich granted lands here to the Vyatka Dormition Monastery. A log monastery dedicated to the Nativity was built the following year, and fugitive serfs from central Russia began to settle around it. In 1759 villages of the district were assigned to the new Izhevsk and Votkinsk works, supplying labor for the growing metalworking enterprises.
simp_chinese: 维亚茨基耶波利亚内位于维亚特卡河畔。这一地区曾有乌德穆尔特人、马里人和鞑靼人居住，属于喀山汗国。1595年，沙皇费奥多尔·伊万诺维奇将此地土地赐给维亚特卡安息修道院。次年建起一座木造圣诞修道院，来自俄罗斯中部的逃亡农奴开始在周围定居。1759年，地区村庄被划归新建的伊热夫斯克和沃特金斯克工厂，为不断扩大的金属加工企业提供劳力。

english:
Vyazma stands on the river of the same name between Smolensk and Moscow. First mentioned in a chronicle in 1230, it became a centre of trade and crafts and the seat of an appanage principality. In 1403 the local princes were expelled as Lithuania took control; in 1494 Vyazma passed to the Grand Principality of Moscow.

The town suffered repeated devastation during the Time of Troubles. Its fortress walls were rebuilt with six towers in 1631–1634, and a church dedicated to Our Lady of Smolensk was consecrated in 1638. During the French invasion of Russia in 1812, Russian forces fought the retreating French army near Vyazma.
simp_chinese:
维亚济马位于斯摩棱斯克与莫斯科之间的同名河畔。它于1230年首次见于编年史，后来发展为贸易和手工业中心，也是一个分封公国的首府。1403年立陶宛取得控制并驱逐当地诸侯；1494年维亚济马转归莫斯科大公国。

动乱时期城镇多次遭到破坏。1631至1634年，当地重建了带有六座塔楼的城墙；供奉斯摩棱斯克圣母的教堂于1638年祝圣。1812年法军入侵俄国期间，俄军在维亚济马附近与撤退的法军交战。

english:
Founded in 1293 by the Swedish marshal Torkel Knutsson during the Third Swedish Crusade against the Karelians, Vyborg was raised as a great stone castle on a rocky islet off the Karelian coast, the easternmost outpost of the Swedish realm and the principal fortress guarding the new frontier against Novgorod. From its walls the Swedish governors directed campaigns against Karelian and Russian raiders for thirty years, until the Treaty of Nöteborg in 1323 finally fixed the frontier between Sweden and Novgorod, leaving Vyborg as the unchallenged eastern bastion of the Swedish king. Around the castle a growing merchant town developed, drawing the trade of Karelian furs, Russian wax, and Finnish goods to its quays and serving as the eastern terminus of the Baltic shipping lanes.

Eric of Pomerania granted the town its charter in 1403, and Vyborg grew into one of the chief trading places of Finland and the centre of its eastern lands. In the 1470s Eric Axelsson Tott, lord of the castle, ringed the town with stone walls and towers, and they were soon put to the test: in the Russo-Swedish War of 1496–97 Daniil Shchenya laid a long siege to Vyborg and failed to take it. The town stayed Swedish for two more centuries and beat off a Russian siege as late as 1706, but in 1710 Peter the Great's army forced it to surrender after 77 days. The Treaty of Nystad confirmed the loss in 1721, and Vyborg became the seat of a Russian province, until in 1812 Alexander I joined it to his new Grand Duchy of Finland.
simp_chinese:
维堡由瑞典元帅托克尔·克努特松于1293年在瑞典针对卡累利阿人的第三次十字军期间建立，位于卡累利阿海岸外的一座岩石小岛上。这座石堡是瑞典王国最东端的前哨站，也是抵御诺夫哥罗德的主要堡垒。三十年间，瑞典总督从城墙上指挥对抗卡累利阿和俄罗斯劫掠者的军事行动，直到1323年《讷特堡条约》最终划定了瑞典与诺夫哥罗德的边界，使维堡成为瑞典国王无可争议的东方堡垒。城堡周围发展起一座日益兴盛的商贸城镇，吸引卡累利阿毛皮、俄罗斯蜂蜡和芬兰商品来到码头，并成为波罗的海航运路线的东部终点。

1403年，波美拉尼亚的埃里克授予维堡城镇特许状，此后它成长为芬兰主要的贸易城镇之一，也是芬兰东部的中心。1470年代，城堡领主埃里克·阿克塞尔松·托特为城镇筑起石砌城墙和塔楼，这道防线很快经受了考验：1496至1497年的俄瑞战争中，丹尼尔·谢尼亚长期围城，始终未能攻下。此后两百年维堡一直属于瑞典，1706年还打退过一次俄军围攻，但1710年彼得大帝的军队围城77天，迫使守军投降。1721年的《尼斯塔德条约》确认了这一割让，维堡成为俄国一个省的治所，直到1812年亚历山大一世把它并入新设的芬兰大公国。

english: Vydreya lies in the wooded country south-east of Vitebsk, west of Liozno. The name is shared by a small settlement and nearby villages around the Vydreyka stream. Mixed woods of pine, birch, alder and aspen surround the locality, part of the countryside between the Western Dvina and the upper Dnieper. Its modest settlements sit within the old Vitebsk lands, whose history was long tied to the principality and voivodeship centred on the river city.
simp_chinese: 维德列亚位于维捷布斯克东南、廖兹诺以西的林地。一处小聚落和维德列伊卡溪附近的村庄都使用这一名称。松树、桦树、桤木与白杨混生的林地环绕着这里，属于西德维纳河与第聂伯河上游之间的乡野。这些小聚落处于古维捷布斯克地区之内，其历史长期与这座河港城市所辖的公国和省相连。

english: Vydritsa was a settlement on the river of the same name in the lake country east of Sebezh. The river, later called the Idryanka, flows into the Velikaya. Sixteenth-century records of the Polotsk district preserve the older form of its name, and a settlement named Vydritsa existed here in that century. The name thus belongs to a landscape of rivers and lakes on the northern edge of the old Polotsk lands.
simp_chinese: 维德里察是塞别日以东湖区的一处聚落，名称取自流经此地的河流。这条河后来称为伊德良卡河，注入韦利卡亚河。16世纪波洛茨克辖区的文书保留了河流名称的旧形式，同一时期此地也有名为维德里察的聚落。这个地名因此与古波洛茨克地区北缘的河湖景观紧密相连。

english: Vygozero lies among the forests and lakes of central Karelia. The Upper Vyg flows into it from the south, while the Lower Vyg carries its waters northward to the White Sea. Its intricate shores and islands formed part of a water route through the interior. In 1702 Peter the Great used a portage across the region to move ships from the White Sea toward Lake Onega during his campaign against Sweden.
simp_chinese: 维戈泽罗湖位于卡累利阿中部的森林与湖泊之间。上维格河从南方流入湖中，下维格河则将湖水向北送入白海。曲折的湖岸和岛屿构成了穿越内陆水路的一部分。1702年，彼得大帝在对瑞典的战争中利用横穿这一地区的陆上拖船路，将船只从白海运往奥涅加湖方向。

english:
Vyshny Volochyok takes its name from the upper portage between the Tvertsa and the Tsna, across the watershed separating the Volga from the Baltic drainage. Boats and their cargoes once had to pass overland here before continuing toward the Msta, Lake Ilmen and Novgorod. The crossing made the settlement an important point on a much longer route between central Russia and the north-west.

In 1471 the army of Prince Obolensky-Striga passed through on its campaign against Novgorod, leaving devastation in its wake. By the seventeenth century the settlement served as a postal station. Peter I ordered a canal between the Tvertsa and Tsna in 1703, seeking a water route to supply his new capital at St Petersburg. The first works proved inadequate, and the merchant Mikhail Serdyukov improved the canals and water controls to regulate the supply of water. The resulting system joined the Volga to the waterways leading to Lake Ladoga and the Neva. Boats still faced the difficult Borovichi rapids on the Msta, but the watershed itself could now be crossed by water. Vyshny Volochyok received town status in 1770, its growth closely bound to the traffic passing through the canals.
simp_chinese:
上沃洛乔克得名于特韦尔察河与茨纳河之间的「上拖船路」，这里的分水岭将伏尔加河流域与波罗的海水系分开。船只和货物过去须经陆路拖运，才能继续前往姆斯塔河、伊尔门湖与诺夫哥罗德。这处渡越点因而成为俄国中部通往西北漫长水路上的重要节点。

1471年，奥博连斯基—斯特里加亲王的军队在进攻诺夫哥罗德途中经过此地，留下荒废的土地。到十七世纪，聚落已是一处驿站。彼得一世于1703年下令开凿特韦尔察河与茨纳河之间的运河，以便为新都圣彼得堡供应物资。最初工程效果不佳，商人米哈伊尔·谢尔久科夫后来改进了运河与调水设施。由此形成的水运系统将伏尔加河与通往拉多加湖、涅瓦河的水路连接起来。船只仍须应对姆斯塔河上的博罗维奇急流，但分水岭本身已可经水路越过。上沃洛乔克于1770年获得城市地位，其发展与运河上的船运息息相关。

english:
Vyškov lies on the Haná at a crossroads of routes from Brno towards Olomouc and Kroměříž. First mentioned in a bishop's deed in 1141, it came into the hands of the bishops of Olomouc in the thirteenth century and became a town. Fortifications followed in the fourteenth century, with stone walls built in the fifteenth.

The Hussites captured and ravaged Vyškov, which recovered under Bishop Tas of Černá Hora later in the fifteenth century. The Thirty Years' War brought another disaster: Swedish troops took the town twice and plundered it in 1643, leaving only about a third of its houses and inhabitants. Bishop Karl II von Liechtenstein-Kastelkorn rebuilt and enlarged the castle and its garden, earning Vyškov the name of the Moravian Versailles. A great fire burned the town and castle in 1753; in 1805 the emperors of Austria and Russia met at the castle before the Battle of Austerlitz.
simp_chinese:
维什科夫位于哈纳河畔，是布尔诺通往奥洛穆茨和克罗梅日什的道路交会处。1141年的主教文书首次提及此地；十三世纪，奥洛穆茨主教取得维什科夫，聚落也成为城镇。十四世纪修建了防御工事，十五世纪又筑起石墙。

胡斯派攻陷并破坏了维什科夫，十五世纪后期城镇在恰尔纳霍拉的塔斯主教统治下复苏。三十年战争又带来灾难：瑞典军队两次攻占此地，1643年彻底洗劫城镇，仅约三分之一的房屋与居民幸存。卡尔二世·冯·列支敦士登—卡斯特尔科恩主教重建并扩建城堡与花园，使维什科夫获得“摩拉维亚凡尔赛”之名。1753年大火焚毁城镇和城堡；1805年奥斯特里茨战役前，奥地利和俄国皇帝在城堡会面。

english:
Vysokoye stood on the Guslitsa at the crossing of roads from Moscow to Kasimov and from Kolomna to Vladimir. Its church of St George gave the village another name, Yegory Vysoky. Sixteenth-century records name the priest Ivan and others serving the church, a centre for the surrounding rural district.

Ivan IV granted Vysokoye to Moscow’s Chudov monastery in the 1560s. The village later became a market for the surrounding country, with grain brought from Kolomna and southern districts and goods including hops, leather and wooden vessels exchanged at fairs. In 1778 Catherine II made Vysokoye a district town under the name Yegoryevsk. The town stood at an advantageous crossing of roads, and the older name remained in descriptions of its origins.
simp_chinese:
维索科耶位于古斯利察河畔，莫斯科通往卡西莫夫与科洛姆纳通往弗拉基米尔的道路在此交会。村里的圣乔治教堂使它又有了叶戈里维索基的名字。十六世纪的文书记载了司祭伊凡等教堂人员，这座教堂是周围乡村的中心。

伊凡四世于1560年代将维索科耶赐给莫斯科的奇迹修道院。村庄后来成为周围地区的集市：粮食从科洛姆纳和南方运来，啤酒花、皮革和木制器皿等商品也在集市上交换。1778年，叶卡捷琳娜二世将维索科耶升为县城，并命名为叶戈里耶夫斯克；城镇仍坐落在交通便利的路口，旧名也留在有关其起源的记载中。

english: Vytegra stands on the river of the same name, south of Lake Onega, on an old water and portage route between the northern lakes and the Volga basin. A trading and craft settlement known as Vyanginskaya Pristan grew here at the mouth of the Vyang stream. Catherine II made it the town of Vytegra in 1773. The opening of the Mariinsky waterway in the early nineteenth century brought new traffic through the town, linking the Volga with Lake Onega and the Baltic approaches.
simp_chinese: 维捷格拉位于奥涅加湖以南的同名河畔，坐落在连接北方湖泊与伏尔加河流域的古老水路和拖船路上。维扬格溪河口曾形成名为维扬加码头的贸易与手工业聚落。1773年，叶卡捷琳娜二世在此设立维捷格拉城。19世纪初马林斯克水系通航后，新的船流经过这里，将伏尔加河与奥涅加湖及波罗的海方向相连。

english: The Vyya flows through wooded, rolling lowlands to join the Pinega from the left. Its valley belongs to the remote river country between the Northern Dvina and the Mezen, where settlement followed the watercourses through the forest. Communities on the Vyya and upper Pinega drew on the forest for hunting as well as on the river itself. The Pinega carried the waters of the Vyya westward towards the Northern Dvina and the White Sea.
simp_chinese: 维亚河流经林木覆盖、起伏和缓的低地，从左岸汇入皮涅加河。河谷属于北德维纳河与梅津河之间偏远的河流地带，聚落沿穿越森林的水道分布。维亚河及皮涅加河上游的居民依靠森林狩猎，也利用河流资源。皮涅加河将维亚河的水流向西带往北德维纳河及白海。

english: Wa lies in the wooded savanna of the Black Volta country. It became the centre of Wala, a kingdom whose inhabitants included farming communities, Muslim clerics and merchants. Routes through the region carried goods between the western Sudan and the forest lands to the south; Dyula traders brought Islamic learning as well as commercial connections. The rulers of Wa drew upon these relationships while maintaining their authority among the varied communities of the surrounding country.
simp_chinese: 瓦阿位于黑伏尔塔河地区的林地草原，曾是瓦拉王国的中心。居民包括农业社群、穆斯林教士和商人。穿过地区的道路在西苏丹与南方森林地带之间运送货物；迪乌拉商人带来了商业联系，也传播伊斯兰学问。瓦阿统治者利用这些关系，同时维持对周围多样社群的权威。

english: Waahukaahaanu is a recorded name for the Yellowstone River, a major tributary of the Missouri. From its mountain headwaters the river crosses Montana, gathering waters from the Tongue and Powder rivers before meeting the Missouri near the eastern edge of the northern Plains. Its name in English refers to yellow rock, a translation of an older designation for the river. The wide valley links the mountain country to the Missouri basin.
simp_chinese: 瓦胡卡哈努是黄石河的一个记载名称，它是密苏里河的重要支流。河流从山中源头横贯蒙大拿，汇集通河与保德河的水流，随后在北部平原东缘附近与密苏里河交汇。英文名称意为“黄石”，译自河流的一个旧称。宽阔的河谷将山地与密苏里河流域连接起来。

english: Waaninawawangang lies near Marchington Lake in northwestern Ontario's forest country. Here the Sturgeon and North rivers meet the Marchington River, which passes through a chain of lakes on its way into the Hudson Bay drainage. The surrounding waterways lead towards the larger waters of Lac Seul to the west.
simp_chinese: 瓦尼纳瓦万冈位于安大略西北部的森林地带，靠近马钦顿湖。斯特金河与北河在这里汇入马钦顿河，河水穿过一连串湖泊，流入哈德孙湾水系。周围的水道向西通往更广阔的瑟尔湖水域。

english: Waanyi country spans inland riverlands south of the Gulf of Carpentaria and across the Northern Territory–Queensland borderlands. Its waterways include parts of the Nicholson River catchment. The Waanyi are among the Aboriginal peoples whose country connects the dry interior with rivers flowing toward the gulf.
simp_chinese: 瓦尼人的土地横跨卡奔塔利亚湾以南的内陆河流地区以及北领地与昆士兰交界一带。水道包括尼科尔森河集水区的一部分。瓦尼人是将干旱内陆与流向海湾河流连接起来的原住民族之一。

english:
Waawiiyaataanong lies on the Detroit River, the strait linking Lake St Clair and Lake Erie. The waterway connects the upper Great Lakes to the lower lakes and the St Lawrence. Its French name, Détroit, means “strait”; the settlement beside it became a centre of trade among Indigenous peoples and Europeans.

In 1701 Antoine de la Mothe Cadillac and Alphonse de Tonty founded Fort Pontchartrain du Détroit. France lost the post to Britain after the Seven Years' War, and it remained under British control for years after American independence. The British departed in 1796, but war returned in 1812 when American commander William Hull surrendered Detroit to British forces. Control of the strait remained a major concern to the powers contesting the Great Lakes.
simp_chinese:
瓦维雅塔农位于底特律河畔。这条水道连接圣克莱尔湖与伊利湖，将五大湖上游、下游及圣劳伦斯河联系起来。法语名称底特律意为“海峡”；河边的聚落成为原住民与欧洲人之间的贸易中心。

1701年，安托万·德拉莫特·卡迪亚克和阿方斯·德通蒂建立底特律的蓬夏特兰堡。七年战争后法国将据点交给英国，美国独立后英国仍控制这里多年。英军于1796年撤离，但1812年战争再次到来，美军指挥官威廉·赫尔将底特律交给英军。海峡的控制权始终是争夺五大湖地区的各方所关注的要事。

english: Wabamun Lake spreads across the wooded parkland west of the North Saskatchewan River. Its Cree name means “mirror,” a fitting image for the broad surface of the water. Lake whitefish and northern pike inhabit the lake, while gently rolling hills rise beyond its southern shore. At the southeastern end, Wabamun Creek carries water from the lake toward the North Saskatchewan, although the flow is intermittent.
simp_chinese: 瓦巴蒙湖位于北萨斯喀彻温河以西的林草交错地带。湖名在克里语中意为“镜子”，描绘出宽阔的水面。湖中有湖白鲑和北美狗鱼，南岸之外则是和缓起伏的丘陵。湖的东南端流出瓦巴蒙溪，溪水间歇地流向北萨斯喀彻温河。

english:
The forested hills south of the Saint Lawrence are part of Ndakina, the homeland of the Wabanaki, or Abenaki people. Their name evokes the land of the rising sun. Families travelled seasonally through the watersheds, hunting and fishing in the forests and gathering along the rivers. The Saint-François, called Alsigontekw in Abenaki, offered a route north to the Saint Lawrence and to exchange with other peoples.

Wars with the English colonies in the late seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries brought Abenaki families northward within their homeland. Communities on the Saint-François and Bécancour rivers became places of refuge and allies of the French. At Saint-François a fortified mission grew around an existing Abenaki settlement. In 1759 Robert Rogers and his rangers attacked and burned the village; its inhabitants rebuilt, and the community endured at Odanak.
simp_chinese:
圣劳伦斯河南方的森林丘陵是恩达基纳的一部分，这是瓦巴纳基人，也称阿贝纳基人的家园。他们的名字使人联想到太阳升起的土地。家庭随季节穿行于各条河流的流域，在森林中狩猎、捕鱼，也在河岸聚集。阿贝纳基人称圣弗朗索瓦河为阿尔西贡特克，这条河通向北方的圣劳伦斯河，为他们与其他民族交换提供了道路。

十七世纪末至十八世纪初，同英国殖民地的战争促使阿贝纳基家庭在自己的家园内向北迁移。圣弗朗索瓦河与贝坎库尔河畔的社群成为避难之地，也与法国人结盟。圣弗朗索瓦一处已有的阿贝纳基聚落发展为设防的传教村。1759年，罗伯特·罗杰斯率领游骑兵袭击并焚毁村庄；居民重建家园，社群在奥达纳克延续下来。

english: The Wabasca River winds north through the boreal forest to join the Peace River. Its name comes from Cree, and the wooded country around its waters forms part of the homelands of Cree and neighbouring peoples. At its mouth, the river deposits gravel and other material in a fan along the Peace. Downstream lie the Vermilion Chutes, a stretch of rapids that presents a formidable obstacle to travel on the great river.
simp_chinese: 瓦巴斯卡河蜿蜒向北，穿过北方森林，汇入和平河。河名源于克里语，河流周围的林地是克里人及邻近族群的家园之一。河口处，河水沿和平河沉积出扇形的砾石和其他物质。再往下游便是弗米利恩急流，这段水流给和平河上的旅程带来极大障碍。

sources.title: 3-1996-Northern River Basins Study-Report to the Ministers.pdf

english: Wabaseemoong lies in the Anishinaabe homeland along the Winnipeg and English river systems. The wooded country north of Lake of the Woods is threaded by lakes, rapids and connecting rivers. For centuries its waters and forests have provided the people of Wabaseemoong with their livelihood and identity. The Winnipeg River also formed a major canoe route from Lake of the Woods toward the interior.
simp_chinese: 瓦巴西蒙位于阿尼希纳贝人的故土，处在温尼伯河与英格利希河水系一带。林中之湖北方的森林地带遍布湖泊、急流和相连的河道。数百年来，这里的水域与森林为瓦巴西蒙人提供生计，也与他们的身份紧密相连。温尼伯河还是从林中之湖通往内陆的重要独木舟路线。

english:
The Wabash River flows through the North American interior towards the Ohio and Mississippi, linking the Great Lakes approaches with the lands to the south. Its name comes from a Miami-Illinois word associated with white or shining water. Miami, Wea, Piankashaw and other peoples lived along the valley, whose waterways and carrying places later drew French traders and missionaries.

In 1717 the French built Fort Ouiatenon on the middle Wabash near Wea villages, followed by a post at Vincennes farther downstream. American forces destroyed Ouiatenon and nearby Indigenous settlements in 1791. In 1808 the Shawnee leaders Tecumseh and Tenskwatawa established a new community near the junction of the Tippecanoe and Wabash; fighting there in 1811 marked another stage in the struggle over the valley.
simp_chinese:
沃巴什河流经北美内陆，通向俄亥俄河和密西西比河，将五大湖方向的通道与南方土地连接起来。河名源自迈阿密—伊利诺伊语，与洁白或闪亮的水有关。迈阿密、韦阿、皮安卡肖等民族居住在河谷沿岸，水道和搬运路线后来吸引法国商人和传教士到来。

1717年，法国人在沃巴什河中游的韦阿村庄附近修建维亚特农堡，随后又在更下游设立文森斯据点。1791年，美军摧毁维亚特农及附近原住民聚落。1808年，肖尼领袖特库姆塞与滕斯克瓦塔瓦在蒂珀卡努河与沃巴什河交汇处附近建立新社群；1811年当地的战斗成为河谷争夺的又一阶段。

english:
Isoco lies near the Looking Glass River, a tributary of Michigan's Grand River. An Ojibwe village called Wabwahnahseepee stood on the river's north bank near the later settlement of DeWitt. When American settlers arrived, its leaders included Wahkonoguay and his son Conobway, and its dwellings included bark-covered houses. In 1835 David Scott purchased land near the village as settlement advanced into the district.

The later city of Lansing lies here.
simp_chinese:
瓦贝纳西比靠近密歇根格兰德河的支流卢金格拉斯河。奥吉布瓦村落瓦布瓦纳西皮曾位于河北岸、后来德威特聚落附近。美国移民到来时，村落领袖包括瓦科诺圭及其子科诺布韦，居民住在以树皮覆盖的房屋中。1835年，随着移民向此地扩展，戴维·斯科特购买了村落附近的土地。

后来的兰辛即位于此地。

english: Wabezi, the Swan River, flows east through the lake country of central Minnesota to meet the Mississippi below the mouth of the Crow Wing. Its name is recorded as an Ojibwe word for swan. The river leaves Big Swan Lake and passes through Little Swan Lake before reaching the larger river. In 1805 the American expedition led by Zebulon Pike camped near its mouth while travelling up the Mississippi.
simp_chinese: 瓦贝齐即天鹅河，穿过明尼苏达中部的湖泊地带向东流去，在鸦翼河口下方汇入密西西比河。其名称被记为奥吉布瓦语中的天鹅。河水从大天鹅湖流出，经过小天鹅湖后抵达大河。1805年，泽布伦·派克率领的美国探险队沿密西西比河上行时，曾在河口附近扎营。

sources.title: Report intended to illustrate a map of the hydrographical basin of the upper Mississippi river (IA reportintendedto00nico).pdf

english: Wabigoon lies in the wooded lake country of northwestern Ontario. The Wabigoon River flows through Wabigoon Lake and continues west and north toward the English River system, passing lakes and falls along its course. These waterways lie within a landscape long used by Anishinaabe peoples, whose fishing and harvesting places extended across the region’s interconnected lakes and forests.
simp_chinese: 瓦比贡位于安大略西北部的森林湖区。瓦比贡河流经瓦比贡湖，随后转向西北，穿过湖泊与瀑布，流向英格利希河水系。这里长期为阿尼希纳贝人所使用，他们的渔场和采集地分布在相互连接的湖泊与森林之间。

english: The Wabigoon Uplands lie among the forests and waters of northwestern Ontario. The Wabigoon River drains a chain of lakes and runs toward the English River, crossing the rocky country of the Canadian Shield. To the north, Lac Seul and its watershed form part of the traditional homeland of the Obishikokaang Anishinaabe, whose territory includes the shores of Minnitaki and Sturgeon lakes.
simp_chinese: 瓦比贡高地位于安大略西北部的森林与水泽之间。瓦比贡河汇集一连串湖泊的水流，穿过加拿大地盾的多岩地带，流向英格利希河。北方的苏尔湖及其流域是奥比希科康阿尼希纳贝人的传统故土，其地域还包括明尼塔基湖与斯特金湖的湖岸。

english: Wabimeig is a lake and creek in the wooded interior of the Albany River basin, far from the river's mouth on James Bay. Their name is of Ojibwe origin. The waterways lie in a country long used by Indigenous families for hunting and travel. In 1743 the Hudson's Bay Company established Henley House at the junction of the Albany and Kenogami rivers, giving inland hunters a trading post closer than the forts on the bay.
simp_chinese: 瓦比梅格是一座湖和一条溪流的名称，位于奥尔巴尼河流域的森林内陆，远离河流在詹姆斯湾的入海口。地名源自奥吉布瓦语。原住民家庭长期在这一带狩猎和旅行。1743年，哈得孙湾公司在奥尔巴尼河与克诺加米河汇合处建立亨利贸易站，内陆猎人因此有了一处比湾边堡垒更近的交易地点。

english: Wabinosh Bay lies at the northwestern end of Lake Nipigon, where the Wabinosh River enters the great lake. The river formed the beginning of a canoe route north towards the Albany River. In 1794 John McKay moved a Hudson's Bay Company post to the bay, where it operated for at least several years. The company sought furs from the surrounding country while competing with North West Company traders in the Nipigon region.
simp_chinese: 瓦比诺什湾位于尼皮贡湖西北端，同名河流在此注入大湖。瓦比诺什河是向北通往奥尔巴尼河的独木舟路线的起点。1794年，约翰·麦凯将一座哈得孙湾公司商站迁到湖湾，商站至少经营了数年。公司从周围地区收购毛皮，同时在尼皮贡地区与西北公司的商人竞争。

english: Wabuk lies along the low coast of Hudson Bay near Wabuk Point, east of the Winisk River mouth. Here the shore is edged by tidal flats and marsh, while ponds and muskeg spread across the flat land behind it. The western Hudson Bay coast is a staging ground for migratory shorebirds and waterfowl, and its wetlands also form part of the range of woodland caribou.
simp_chinese: 瓦布克位于哈得孙湾的低平海岸，靠近温尼斯科河口以东的瓦布克角。海岸边缘分布着潮滩和沼泽，岸后平地则遍布池塘与泥沼。哈得孙湾西岸是迁徙滨鸟和水禽的中途停歇地，这里的湿地也是林地驯鹿活动范围的一部分。

english:
The Waccamaw lived along the river that bears their name and in the neighbouring Pee Dee country. Their villages stood among wooded waterways and swamps of the Carolina coastal plain. As English settlement spread, the Waccamaw dealt with colonial traders and with neighbouring peoples whose alliances were changing amid conflict and the trade in captives.

In 1715, during the Yamasee War, the Cheraw sought Waccamaw support against the English. A colonial trading post was established at Euaunee the following year, but in 1720 a short war brought death and captivity to Waccamaw men, women and children. By the middle of the eighteenth century, some Waccamaw and Peedee were living among colonial settlements, and officials urged several small nations to join the Catawba.
simp_chinese:
沃卡莫人居住在以他们命名的河流沿岸及邻近的皮迪地区。村庄坐落在卡罗来纳沿海平原林木繁茂的水道与沼泽之间。英国殖民地扩张时，沃卡莫人既要与殖民商人往来，也要面对因战争和俘虏贸易而不断改变联盟的邻近民族。

1715年亚马西战争期间，彻劳人寻求沃卡莫人支持，共同对抗英国人。次年，殖民者在尤奥尼建立贸易站；但1720年一场短暂战争使沃卡莫男女老少遭到杀害或俘虏。到世纪中叶，一些沃卡莫人和皮迪人生活在殖民聚落中，官员则劝说数个小民族加入卡托巴人。

english: Waccasassa Bay lies on Florida’s Gulf coast, where the Waccasassa River flows through low woodland and marsh to the sea. Fresh and salt water mingle in the broad estuary, creating a landscape of tidal creeks, wetlands and sheltered shallows. The river winds through the coastal forest before reaching the bay, while the open Gulf extends to the west. Fish and shellfish inhabit these rich coastal waters.
simp_chinese: 瓦卡萨萨湾位于佛罗里达墨西哥湾海岸，瓦卡萨萨河穿过低地林地与沼泽，在此入海。淡水与海水在宽阔河口交汇，形成潮汐溪流、湿地和受庇护浅水的景观。河流蜿蜒穿过沿海森林抵达海湾，西面则是开阔的墨西哥湾；鱼类与贝类栖息于这片富饶水域。

english: Wachigari lies beside the Murray River near Corowa, in country associated with the Bangerang. The river supplied Murray cod and shellfish, while its waters also provided a route through the floodplain. Upstream of Corowa a line of rocks across the river was used by Aboriginal fishers to help spear fish. The Murray here runs between wooded banks and bends westwards from the country around Albury towards the lower river.
simp_chinese: 瓦奇加里位于科罗瓦附近的墨累河畔，处在与班格朗人相联系的土地上。河中有墨累鳕和贝类，河水也是穿越洪泛平原的通道。科罗瓦上游有一道横跨河面的岩石，原住民渔人利用它来帮助叉鱼。这里的墨累河流经林木覆盖的河岸，从奥尔伯里附近向西弯曲，奔向下游。

english: Wachilmezi is the Abenaki word for the white oak, associated with the river known in French as the Rivière du Chêne. The river flows through the wooded lowlands south of the St. Lawrence. French records mention a right to build mills on its waters in 1638. In 1672 the neighbouring lands were granted as the seigneury of Lotbinière, and by 1681 families had settled near the river as well as farther along the shore.
simp_chinese: 瓦希尔梅兹是阿贝纳基语中白栎树的名称，与法语称为橡树河的河流相联系。河流穿过圣劳伦斯河南岸的林木低地。1638年的法国记录已提到在河上建造磨坊的权利。1672年，附近土地被授为洛特比尼耶领地；到1681年，已有家庭定居在河边和更远的沿岸地区。

english:
The Waco were a Wichita people whose agricultural village stood near the meeting of the Brazos and Bosque rivers. Their fields and grass-covered houses formed part of a network of Wichita settlements in central Texas. They cultivated crops beside the river and hunted bison on the plains, maintaining ties with the related Tawakoni and other neighboring communities.

Wichita groups moved south into Texas during the eighteenth century. In 1824 the Waco village on the Brazos was reported to have between five and six hundred inhabitants. Around 1830 Cherokee newcomers displaced the Waco from the village, and by the middle of the decade it had been abandoned. In 1837 Texas Rangers established a short-lived military outpost nearby, on the site of the former settlement.
simp_chinese:
瓦科人是威奇托民族的一支，其农耕村落位于布拉索斯河与博斯克河交汇处附近。他们的田地和覆草房屋属于得克萨斯中部威奇托聚落网络的一部分。居民在河边种植作物，到平原猎取野牛，并与亲缘相近的塔瓦科尼及其他邻近社群保持联系。

十八世纪，威奇托各群体向南迁入得克萨斯。据1824年的记载，布拉索斯河畔的瓦科村有五百至六百名居民。约1830年，迁入的切罗基人迫使瓦科人离开，至1830年代中期村落已被遗弃。1837年，得克萨斯骑警在旧聚落附近建立了一座短暂存在的军事哨所。

english: Wad Madani lies on the Blue Nile in the Gezira, the broad plain between the Blue and White Niles. The town takes its name from Muhammad Madani, a teacher associated with the spread of Islamic learning along the river. Its early history belongs to the era in which the Funj kingdom of Sennar came to dominate the region. The Blue Nile brought water from the Ethiopian highlands through this agricultural country before joining the White Nile farther north.
simp_chinese: 瓦德迈代尼位于青尼罗河畔的杰济拉地区，坐落在青、白两条尼罗河之间的广阔平原上。城镇以穆罕默德·迈代尼得名，这位教师与沿河传播伊斯兰学问的历史有关。其早期历史属于森纳尔丰吉王国逐渐统领该地区的时代。青尼罗河将埃塞俄比亚高地的水带过这片农业地区，在更北方与白尼罗河汇合。

english:
Wadadli is an indigenous name associated with Antigua, where low hills, cultivated land, reefs, and coastal waters support a Caribbean island environment. Fresh water can be limited, making rainfall and storage important. Fishing and local resources supported earlier island communities, while canoe routes connected them with neighboring Lesser Antillean societies. The surrounding sea offered access and exchange as well as exposure to storms.

European colonization transformed the island during the early modern centuries, especially through English settlement and the expansion of sugar plantations. Enslaved Africans and their descendants supplied the labor on which this economy depended, facing coercion and harsh conditions. Plantations required mills, fuel, provisions, and shipping connections, linking local land use with Atlantic markets. Harbors and fortifications became important to British naval and commercial interests, while imperial warfare threatened trade.

The later city of St. John's lies here.
simp_chinese:
瓦达德利是与安提瓜相关的原住民名称，低丘、耕地、礁盘和沿海水域构成加勒比岛屿环境。淡水可能有限，雨量、储水因此重要。捕鱼、地方资源支持较早社区，独木舟路线将其连接到小安的列斯邻近社会。海洋提供通行、交换，也使岛屿承受风暴，资源利用必须兼顾土地和周围水域。

近代早期，欧洲殖民改变了岛屿，特别是英国殖民聚落及蔗糖种植园的扩展。被奴役的非洲人及其后裔提供了这一经济所依赖的劳力，承受强制和严酷条件。种植园需要磨坊、燃料、补给与航运，将岛上的土地使用同大西洋市场联系起来。港湾和防御设施对英国海军及商业利益十分重要，帝国战争则威胁着贸易。

后来的圣约翰即位于此地。

english: The Wadadokado were Northern Paiute people of the Harney Basin, whose homeland included the shores and wetlands of Malheur Lake. Their name is associated with wada, a plant whose seeds were an important food. The shallow lake and marshes also supported fish and waterfowl, while the surrounding dry country offered roots and game. Seasonal journeys connected the basin with the mountains and river valleys beyond, linking a wide range of food grounds within the Paiute homeland.
simp_chinese: 瓦达多卡多是哈尼盆地的北派尤特人，其故土包括马卢尔湖的湖岸和湿地。他们的名称与瓦达植物有关，其种子是重要食物。浅湖和沼泽还出产鱼类、水禽，周围干燥土地则提供根茎和猎物。季节性旅程把盆地与外围山脉、河谷连接起来，将派尤特故土中广泛的食物产地联成一体。

english: Wadan, also called Ouadane, is an old caravan town on the Adrar plateau. Its stone houses, mosque and palm groves occupy a rocky desert setting where wells sustained travellers crossing the Sahara. The town became a centre of trade and Islamic learning, linked to routes leading north to the Maghreb and south towards the Niger. In 1487 the Portuguese established a trading post at Wadan in an attempt to reach the commerce carried across the desert. The post did not last long, but its presence illustrates the attraction of Saharan exchange to merchants arriving by sea. The older town continued to reflect the lives of oasis residents, scholars and caravan traders in the western Sahara.
simp_chinese: 瓦丹又称瓦丹内，是阿德拉尔高原上的古老商队城镇。石屋、清真寺和棕榈林分布在岩石荒漠中，水井为横渡撒哈拉的旅人提供补给。城镇成为贸易与伊斯兰学术中心，道路北通马格里布，南往尼日尔河流域。1487年，葡萄牙人在瓦丹设立商站，试图接触穿越沙漠的贸易。商站存在时间不长，却显示撒哈拉交换对海上来客的吸引力。古城继续反映绿洲居民、学者与商队商人在西撒哈拉的生活。

english: The Wadbilliga mountains rise behind the southeastern coast of Australia, forming part of the Great Dividing Range. Forested ridges and river valleys separate the coastal lowlands from the Monaro tableland. The country is associated with Aboriginal communities of the south coast and inland, whose paths and relationships crossed the mountains.
simp_chinese: 瓦德比利加山地在澳大利亚东南岸后方升起，是大分水岭的一部分。森林山脊和河谷将沿海低地与莫纳罗高原分隔。这片土地与南岸及内陆的原住民社群有关，他们的小径与社会关系跨越山脉。

english: The Wadden Sea stretches along the low North Sea coast behind a chain of barrier islands. Twice each day the tide exposes broad flats of mud and sand, leaving winding channels between islands and mainland. Marshes and embanked land border its southern shores. Storm floods repeatedly changed this coast: settlements and fields could disappear beneath the water even as communities built dikes and reclaimed ground. The Christmas Flood of 1717 was among the destructive surges that struck the Wadden coast and its inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 瓦登海沿北海低平海岸延伸，外侧是一列屏障岛。潮水每日两度退去，露出广阔的泥滩和沙滩，曲折水道穿行于岛屿与大陆之间。南岸是盐沼和筑堤围护的土地。风暴潮一再改变海岸：居民筑堤垦地，村庄和田野却也可能被海水吞没。1717年的圣诞洪水就是袭击瓦登海沿岸及其居民的灾难之一。

sources.title: 11 Understanding the cultural historical value of the Wadden Sea region OCMA.pdf

english: Wadh lies in a mountain valley of the Jhalawan country, south of Khuzdar and north of the Las plain. Ridges and passes divide this part of the Baluch highlands into separate valleys, through which routes descend towards the coast. Archaeological sites in the Wadh valley testify to settlement in a landscape whose dry hills and seasonal watercourses shape the available land. The road through the highlands links the interior with Bela and the lowlands near the Arabian Sea.
simp_chinese: 瓦德位于贾拉万地区的山谷中，北接胡兹达尔，南望拉斯平原。山岭与隘口将俾路支高地分隔成不同谷地，道路由此向海岸延伸。瓦德谷地的考古遗址见证了当地的聚居历史；干燥山丘与季节性河道塑造着可利用的土地。穿越高地的道路将内陆同贝拉及阿拉伯海附近低地连接起来。

english: Wadi el Melik is a long dry watercourse running from Kordofan towards the Nile near al-Dabba. Its broad channel crosses an arid landscape where water flows only intermittently. The wadi has served as a corridor between the Nile valley and the western Sudan since antiquity: Meroitic burial sites have been found along its course, and medieval remains near Jebel al-Ain testify to later occupation of the route.
simp_chinese: 瓦迪迈利克是一条漫长的干河谷，从科尔多凡通向达巴附近的尼罗河。宽阔河道穿过干旱地区，只有间歇性的水流。自古以来，这条河谷就是尼罗河谷与苏丹西部之间的通道：沿途发现过麦罗埃时期的墓葬，杰贝勒艾因附近的中世纪遗迹也见证了后来人们在这条道路上的活动。

english:
Wadi El Natrun is a desert depression west of the Nile Delta, named for the natron gathered from its salt lakes. Known to Christian monks as Scetis, it became a major centre of Egyptian monastic life in late antiquity. Saint Macarius settled in the region in the fourth century, and communities of hermits and monasteries grew around it.

The monasteries faced raids and built enclosed walls and towers for protection, but monastic life continued through the Middle Ages. The monastery of John the Little, named for a renowned desert father, remained active for centuries before its community dwindled in the fourteenth century. Other foundations, including those of Saint Macarius, Saint Bishoi and the Syrians, preserved the valley's religious and literary traditions.
simp_chinese:
奈特伦谷是尼罗河三角洲以西的一处沙漠洼地，得名于盐湖中采集的天然碱。基督教修士称这里为斯凯提斯；古代晚期，它成为埃及修道生活的重要中心。圣马卡里乌斯于四世纪来到这一地区，周围逐渐形成隐修者和修道院的群体。

修道院遭遇袭击，因而修筑围墙和塔楼自卫，但修道生活在中世纪延续下来。以著名沙漠教父小约翰命名的修道院活跃了几个世纪，直到十四世纪其群体逐渐衰落。圣马卡里乌斯、圣比绍伊及叙利亚人修道院等其他机构则保存了山谷的宗教与文字传统。

english: Wadian lay northeast of Tengchong, among the wooded valleys of the western Yunnan mountains. The Ming established a native commandery here in 1427, placing it under the military administration of Jinchi. In 1522 it was assigned to Yongchang Prefecture. Its position in the highlands put it near routes between Tengchong and the Nu River, where mountain communities and the authorities at the frontier town maintained long-standing connections.
simp_chinese: 瓦甸位于腾冲东北的林木山谷之间。1427年，明朝在此设长官司，隶属金齿军民司；1522年改属永昌府。这里靠近腾冲与怒江之间的山地道路，山中社群与边地城镇的官府长期保持联系。

english: The forested ranges of northeastern New South Wales descend eastward toward the Clarence River and the Pacific coast. The wider coastal region is home to Gumbaynggirr communities, whose country extends from the Nambucca toward the Clarence and inland to the Great Dividing Range. Rivers cut through the highlands on their way to the sea.
simp_chinese: 新南威尔士东北部的森林山地向东下降至克拉伦斯河与太平洋海岸。广大沿海地区是甘拜恩吉尔社群的土地，从南布卡河延伸至克拉伦斯河一带，并向内陆抵达大分水岭。河流穿过高地流向海洋。

sources.title: Draft Regional Water Strategy - North Coast - March 2021.pdf

english: Wadjigu country lies in the inland ranges of central Queensland, west of the Dawson River. The Wadjigu language is also known as Wadja, and its region includes the Comet River and the Expedition Range. These uplands and waterways form part of the broad Fitzroy River basin.
simp_chinese: 瓦吉古人的土地位于昆士兰中部的内陆山地，在道森河以西。瓦吉古语也称瓦贾语，其地区包括彗星河与探险山脉。这些高地与水道属于广阔的菲茨罗伊河流域。

english: Waerhdje is a monastic site in the mountains of Muli, beneath the sacred mountain Dorje. Its great monastery became an early Gelug foundation in a region inhabited by Tibetan and Pumi communities. Accounts of Muli's religious history place its establishment in the 1580s, following a local delegation's appeal to the Third Dalai Lama at Litang. The family of Muli's later hereditary rulers traced its origins to lamas of this monastery.
simp_chinese: 瓦尔寨是木里山地的一处寺院所在地，位于多吉神山之下。瓦尔寨大寺是藏族、普米族聚居地区早期的格鲁派寺院。木里宗教史记载，1580年代当地代表赴理塘拜见第三世达赖喇嘛，请求在木里建寺传法。后来木里世袭统治者的家族溯源于这座寺院的喇嘛。

english: Västbo was a hundred in western Småland and part of the old district of Finnveden. Its court met at Ölmestad in Reftele parish, serving a broad countryside of woods and lakes. In 1616 peasants rose against the bailiff Lars Andersson, whose conduct in collecting the crown's dues had provoked anger. The district's rural customs were later described by the eighteenth-century clergyman Petrus Gaslander in his account of the manners and character of the Swedish peasantry.
simp_chinese: 韦斯特布是斯莫兰西部的一个百户区，属于古老的芬韦登地区。法庭设在雷夫特勒堂区的厄尔梅斯塔德，服务于广阔的森林和湖泊乡村。1616年，农民因地方官拉尔斯·安德松征收王室款项时的行为而愤怒，发动起义。十八世纪，牧师彼得鲁斯·加斯兰德在描写瑞典农民性格与习俗的著作中记录了这一地区的乡土生活。

english: The Tao'er leaves the forested eastern slopes of the Greater Khingan and descends towards the Nen River. Near this stretch it receives the Guiliu, another long river from the mountains to the west. The Tao'er's gravel bed and changing flow mark the transition from the uplands to the broad plains below.
simp_chinese: 洮儿河从大兴安岭东麓的森林流出，向嫩江方向流去。在这一河段附近，它接纳来自西面山地的归流河。洮儿河床多沙砾，水量随季节变化，河道由高地向下游广阔的平原过渡。

english: Waga lies west of the Kitakami River, where mountain streams enter the broad valley of northern Mutsu. The Waga family lost its lands in Toyotomi Hideyoshi's settlement of 1590, and the Nanbu took possession. In 1600 Waga Tadachika rose with support from Date Masamune and attacked Hanamaki Castle. The assault failed, and after holding out at Iwasaki Castle his forces were defeated the following year.
simp_chinese: 和贺位于北上川以西，山溪在此汇入陆奥北部宽阔的河谷。1590年丰臣秀吉处置奥羽诸领主时，和贺氏失去领地，此地转归南部氏。1600年，和贺忠亲在伊达政宗支持下起兵，进攻花卷城未果，随后据守岩崎城，次年被击败。

english: Wagiman country lies along the Daly River and neighboring tributaries in northern Australia. The river flows through woodland and floodplain toward the Timor Sea. Wagiman speakers share boundaries and long-established relationships with neighboring Aboriginal communities, including the Malak Malak to the northwest.
simp_chinese: 瓦吉曼人的土地沿澳大利亚北部戴利河及邻近支流分布。河流穿过林地和洪泛平原，流向帝汶海。瓦吉曼语使用者与邻近原住民社群接壤，并有长期联系，其中包括西北方的马拉马拉人。

english: Wagowategok lies near the Yamaska River in the St. Lawrence lowlands. Abenaki hunters travelled the river through the country between the Richelieu and Chaudière watersheds. In 1748 the French crown granted the seigneury of Maska along both banks of the Yamaska; Jacques-Hyacinthe Delorme began clearing and cultivating land at Rapide-Plat in 1757.
simp_chinese: 瓦戈瓦特戈克位于圣劳伦斯低地，靠近亚马斯卡河。阿贝纳基猎人沿河往返于黎塞留河与肖迪埃尔河流域之间。1748年，法国王室在亚马斯卡河两岸授予马斯卡领地；1757年，雅克-亚桑特·德洛尔姆开始在拉皮德普拉开垦耕地。

english: Waha'tunkuo lies near the Niobrara River in the northern Nebraska plains. The river descends from Wyoming across high plains and canyons before meeting the Missouri. In this eastern part of its course, the Keya Paha joins it from the north, while smaller creeks drain the country south of the valley. The river forms a wooded corridor through grasslands on the northern edge of the Sandhills.
simp_chinese: 瓦哈通加位于内布拉斯加北部平原，靠近奈厄布拉勒河。河流从怀俄明向东穿过高平原与峡谷，最终汇入密苏里河。在较东的一段河道，基亚帕哈河从北方汇入，较小溪流则汇集谷地以南的水。河谷形成一条林木走廊，穿过沙丘北缘的草原。

english: Wahachee Creek flows through the wooded uplands of eastern Georgia to join the Broad River, a tributary of the Savannah. To the north, the valleys of the Tugaloo and its tributaries were home to Cherokee towns, including Tugaloo and Estatoe. Paths linked these settlements with Keowee to the northeast and with towns across the mountains. Streams and ridges formed part of a wider country traversed by Native travellers and traders.
simp_chinese: 瓦哈奇溪流经佐治亚东部林木茂密的高地，汇入萨凡纳河的支流布罗德河。北面的图加卢河及其支流谷地是切罗基村镇的家园，其中包括图加卢和埃斯塔托。道路将这些聚落与东北方的基奥威以及群山另一侧的村镇连接起来。溪流与山脊构成了原住民旅人和商人往来的广大地区的一部分。

english: Wahasah is one of the recorded names of the Powder River, a long tributary of the Yellowstone. It flows north across the dry plains from its headwaters in Wyoming, receiving streams from the surrounding basin before reaching the Yellowstone in eastern Montana. The English name recalls the dark, powdery sand found on its banks. Its broad valley forms a distinctive corridor through the prairie and broken hills.
simp_chinese: 瓦哈萨是保德河的一个记载名称，这条长河是黄石河的支流。它从怀俄明的源头向北流过干燥平原，汇集周边盆地的溪流，在蒙大拿东部注入黄石河。英文名称使人想起河岸上深色、粉末般的沙土。宽阔河谷在草原与崎岖丘陵之间形成一条鲜明的通道。

english: Lake Wahemen lies in the northern Otish country, among the headwaters of the Eastmain River. The lake feeds a branch that joins the young Eastmain as it begins its long course west towards James Bay. A Cree name recorded for the lake, Opémiska, refers to sandy narrows. Other lakes bear similar names, but this one belongs to the high interior south of Lake Nichicun.
simp_chinese: 瓦赫门湖位于奥蒂什山地北部，是伊斯特梅恩河的源头水域之一。湖水流入一条支流，与初成的伊斯特梅恩河汇合，后者随后向西长途奔流，直至詹姆斯湾。记载中的湖泊克里语名称 Opémiska 指沙质狭水道。其他湖泊也有类似名称，但这片湖位于尼希昆湖以南的内陆高地。

english: Wahgunyah waters lie along the southern Australian coast east of the limestone cliffs of the Great Australian Bight. Dunes and sandy shores border a sea exposed to Southern Ocean swells. The coast forms part of a broader Aboriginal landscape linking the bight with dry inland plains and neighbouring bays.
simp_chinese: 瓦冈亚水域位于澳大利亚南岸，在大澳大利亚湾石灰岩峭壁以东。沙丘和沙岸面向受南大洋涌浪影响的海域。这里属于更广阔的原住民景观，将海湾与干燥内陆平原及邻近海湾联系起来。

english: Wahíŋ Wakpá, “flint river” in Lakota, is a name for the Arkansas River. Rising in the Rocky Mountains, the river flows east across the plains, its valley offering water and a route through a dry region. Indigenous peoples including the Cheyenne, Kiowa and Lakota had their own names for its waters. During the nineteenth century traders travelling the Santa Fe Trail followed parts of the Arkansas valley between Missouri and New Mexico.
simp_chinese: 瓦欣瓦克帕在拉科塔语中意为“燧石河”，是阿肯色河的名称之一。这条河发源于落基山脉，向东流过平原，河谷为干旱地区提供水源和通道。夏延人、基奥瓦人和拉科塔人等原住民都有自己的河流名称。十九世纪，往返密苏里与新墨西哥的圣菲小道商人沿阿肯色河谷部分河段行进。

english: The Boston Mountains form the rugged southern edge of the Ozark Plateau. Streams have cut deep valleys into the high, forested plateau, leaving narrow ridges and steep slopes above the river country. The Osage, who call themselves Wahzhazhe, lived and hunted across the Ozarks and neighboring plains. Their name is associated with a high summit in these mountains, overlooking a landscape of wooded ridges and headwaters.
simp_chinese: 波士顿山脉构成奥扎克高原崎岖的南缘。溪流切入高耸的森林高原，形成深谷、狭窄山脊和陡坡，俯瞰下方河流地区。自称瓦扎哲的奥塞奇人在奥扎克及邻近平原生活和狩猎。他们的名字与山中一座高峰相联系，峰顶俯瞰着树木覆盖的山脊和河流源头。

english: Wai lies near San Sebastián Bay on the Atlantic shore of Tierra del Fuego. At low tide the bay exposes broad mudflats, feeding grounds for red knots and other shorebirds that travel to the island from the north. Behind the coast stretch the grasslands of the Selk'nam, whose hunters pursued guanaco and used its hide for clothing and shelter. The tides and the open steppe give this part of Karukinka two very different faces.
simp_chinese: 瓦伊靠近火地岛大西洋岸的圣塞瓦斯蒂安湾。退潮时，海湾露出宽广泥滩，红腹滨鹬等从北方迁来的岸鸟在此觅食。海岸后方是塞尔克南人的草原，猎人追捕原驼，用兽皮制作衣物和居所。潮汐与开阔草原使卡鲁金卡这一带呈现出两种截然不同的景观。

english: The Wai Islands, also called Poulo Wai, are a pair of small wooded islands in the Gulf of Thailand. They lie well offshore, southwest of the Bay of Kampong Som, with open water separating them from the Cambodian coast. Their position places them amid the sea routes crossing the gulf between the Malay Peninsula and the shores of Cambodia and the Mekong Delta. Trees cover the islands above their rocky shores.
simp_chinese: 外群岛又称普洛外，由泰国湾中两座树木茂密的小岛组成。它们远离海岸，位于磅逊湾西南方，与柬埔寨大陆之间隔着开阔海面。群岛处在横穿海湾的航路附近，这些航路连接马来半岛、柬埔寨海岸和湄公河三角洲。岛上岩岸之上覆盖着树林。

english: The outer Changshan Islands lie in the northern Yellow Sea off the southeastern coast of Liaodong. They form the southern group of an island chain that also includes the inner Changshan and Shicheng islands. Ocean Island and Zhangzi Island belong to this outer group; Ocean Island rises higher than the other islands of the wider chain. Channels of sea separate these rocky islands from one another and from the mainland.
simp_chinese: 外长山列岛位于辽东半岛东南岸外的黄海北部，是长山群岛的南部岛群。整个群岛还包括里长山列岛和石城列岛。海洋岛、獐子岛属于外长山列岛，其中海洋岛是长山群岛地势最高的岛屿。海峡将这些岩石岛屿彼此分开，也将它们与大陆隔开。

english:
Waidhofen an der Ybbs stands in the foothill country of Lower Austria, where the Ybbs River connects forested valleys with routes toward the Danube. Water power, woodland, and proximity to the iron producing Alpine region encouraged specialized crafts and commerce. The town's streets and fortified character reflect an urban community whose prosperity depended on both local resources and wider industrial connections.

Under the bishops of Freising, Waidhofen became a major centre of ironworking in the late Middle Ages. Its smiths traded metal goods well beyond the valley. Religious conflict disrupted the town: an imperial commission removed its Protestant council in 1587–1588, and many smithing families later left during forced recatholicisation.
